blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Dexterous robotic hands are increasingly coupled to large-scale human data and foundation models, yet progress in hardware, representation learning and evaluation is often assessed separately. This survey reviews work from January 2024 to early November 2026, with earlier studies included to establish technical lineages. We organize the literature into five interdependent layers: hardware; data collection and curation; cross-embodiment transfer; learning and foundation models; and evaluation and applications. Human hand-object understanding and tactile sensing provide two cross-cutting perspectives. A system-level architecture, comparative tables and five case analyses connect design choices across these layers. We distinguish within-study experimental comparisons from heterogeneous corpus statistics, vendor specifications and company-reported results. Three conclusions emerge. First, the value of human data depends on kinematic, visual and contact alignment, not recording volume alone. Second, shared action representations and foundation policies do not remove embodiment-specific constraints on force, latency and contact. Third, task completion is insufficient to establish physical correctness or deployment readiness. Evidence remains limited for zero-shot transfer of contact-rich skills between morphologically different hands, long-duration reliability, and cross-sensor tactile generalization. We identify eleven open problems and propose reporting interfaces and controlled comparisons that can make full-stack progress more measurable. The review is a structured narrative synthesis rather than a pooled performance ranking or an exhaustive systematic review.
blocks.zh: Dexterous的机器人手越来越多地与大规模的人类数据和基础模型结合,然而硬件,代表学习和评价方面的进展往往单独评估. 本次调查审查2024年1月至2026年11月初的工程,早期的研究包括建立技术线条. 我们把文献分为五个相互依存的层面:硬件;数据收集和整理;交叉表现转让;学习和基础模型;以及评价和应用。 人类的手物体理解和触觉感知提供了两个交叉视角. 一个系统一级的架构、比较表和五个案例分析将各层的设计选择联系起来。 我们把研究中的实验性比较与各种实体统计、供应商规格和公司报告的结果区分开来。 出现了三个结论。 第一,人类数据的价值取决于动能,视觉和接触对齐,而不是仅记录体积. 第二,共同行动说明和基础政策并不能消除对武力、时间和接触的具体限制。 第三,任务完成不足以确定实际正确性或部署准备。 证据仍然有限,无法在形态上不同的手,长时间的可靠性和跨传感器触觉一般化之间零射转移接触丰富的技能. 我们确定了11个尚未解决的问题,并提出了报告接口和可控制的比较,使全面进展更能衡量。 审查是结构化的叙述性综合,而不是集合业绩排名或详尽无遗的系统审查。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The human hand is the interface through which most of the built world is operated: tools, containers, fasteners, cables, keyboards and laboratory glassware are all designed around five fingers, opposable thumbs and a sense of touch. Building robot hands that can use this world without redesigning it has been a goal of robotics for decades [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] . For most of that time, progress was limited on three fronts at once. Anthropomorphic hands were expensive, fragile and hard to maintain (the Shadow Dexterous Hand [ 5 ] costs more than US$100k); data for multi-fingered manipulation were scarce because teleoperating 20 joints is slow and lacks force feedback; and learning methods for high-DoF hands were largely confined to single tasks trained with reinforcement learning (RL) in simulation [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 人手是大多数构建世界运行的界面:工具,容器,紧身衣,电缆,键盘和实验室玻璃器皿都围绕五个手指设计,可对抗的拇指和触摸感. 建造机器人手,可以使用这个世界而不重新设计,这几十年来一直是机器人的目标[1,2,3,4]. 在这段时间的大部分时间里,同时在三个方面进展有限。 Anthropomorphical hands昂贵,脆弱且难以维护(Shadow Dexterous Hands[5]成本超过100k美元);多指操纵的数据很少,因为遥测20关节的速度缓慢,缺乏武力反馈;高手的学习方法主要局限于在模拟中接受强化学习训练的单项任务[6,7,8,9].

blocks.en: Between 2024 and 2026 all three constraints loosened at the same time. On the hardware side, a 22-DoF hand became available for about US$6.5k [ 10 ] , a six-DoF linkage hand for under US$1k [ 11 ] , and open-source hands for a few hundred dollars [ 12 , 13 ] ; Chinese market trackers report shipments growing from about 19k units in 2025 to a forecast of 70k in 2026 [ 14 ] . On the data side, collection moved away from teleoperating a robot towards capturing humans directly: wearable exoskeletons and gloves that are kinematically matched to the robot hand [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] , and egocentric video with 3D hand tracking at the scale of 10 3 10^{3} – 10 5 10^{5} hours [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] . Industrial players report even larger corpora, with press reports of 270k to more than 500k hours of wearable data [ 23 , 24 ] and about ten million glove episodes collected in homes [ 25 ] . On the learning side, generalist VLA models [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] and world-action models [ 31 , 32 ] began to target high-DoF hands, with hierarchical systems that add a dedicated high-frequency contact layer below the policy [ 33 , 34 ] .
blocks.zh: 2024年至2026年间,所有三种约束同时放松. 硬件方面,一台22-DoF手可使用约6.5k [10]美元,六-DoF连接手可使用不到1k [11]美元,开源手可使用数百美元 [12,13];中国市场追踪器报告货运量从2025年的约19k单位增长到2026年的70k预测 [14]. 在数据方面,收集从远程操作机器人转向直接捕获人类:可穿戴的与机器人手[15,16,17,18]相匹配的外骨骼和手套,以及以3D手追踪为主的视频,比例为10 3 10^{3} — 10 5 10^{5]小时[19,20,21,22]. 工业玩家报道甚至更大型的蝎子,有媒体报道270k至500k小时以上的可穿戴数据[23,24],在家中收集的约1000万次手套事件[25]. 在学习方面,通论VLA模型[26,27,28,29,30]和世界行动模型[31,32]开始瞄准高手,分级系统在政策下方增加专用高频接触层[33,34].

blocks.en: These developments are tightly coupled. A hand whose kinematics and camera placement mirror a human’s can reuse human data with little retargeting error; data collected with a hand-specific exoskeleton usually require additional retargeting for reuse with a different hand; whether a unified action space is needed depends on how many embodiments a model must serve; and benchmark results only transfer if hardware, sensing and evaluation protocols are comparable. Recent evidence makes this coupling explicit. EgoScale reports a log-linear relation between human-pretraining hours and validation loss, alongside improved downstream completion [ 20 ] ; Liber-0 reports that, under identical post-training, 10k hours of glove data outperform 2M hours of web video, and that a more human-like robot benefits more from the same human data [ 35 ] ; DexWild finds that too much human data relative to robot data (1:5) hurts performance compared with 1:2 [ 17 ] . None of these findings can be understood from the data layer alone.
blocks.zh: 这些发展是紧密结合的。 一个手的动能和相机定位镜可以重用人类数据而很少重定向错误;用手特定的Exoskeleton收集的数据通常需要额外的重定向,以便用不同的手进行重用;是否需要一个统一的动作空间取决于一个模型必须服务多少个化身;只有硬件、感知和评价协议具有可比性,基准结果才能转让。 最近的证据表明了这种结合。 Ego Scale报告人类预训时数和验证损失之间的对数线关系,同时改进了下游完成[20];Liber-0报告,在相同的后训练中,10k小时手套数据超过2M小时网络视频,一个更像人类的机器人从相同的人类数据中获得更多好处[35];DexWild发现,相对于机器人数据(1:5),人类数据过多会伤害性能,而1:2 [17]. 仅从数据层无法理解这些发现。

blocks.en: Figure 1 gives the complementary systems view: the survey follows the forward path from human or robot data to deployment, while treating failures, contact signals and benchmark results as feedback into the next design cycle.
blocks.zh: 图1给出了互补的系统视图:调查遵循从人类或机器人数据到部署的前进路径,同时将故障,联系信号和基准结果作为反馈,纳入下一个设计周期.

blocks.en: Classical surveys cover the mechanics of robot hands [ 2 , 3 ] , dexterous manipulation in general [ 1 , 4 ] , or a single learning paradigm such as RL [ 36 ] , in-hand manipulation [ 37 ] or imitation learning [ 38 ] . A recent survey organizes embodied data into a “pyramid” [ 39 ] without focusing on hands. In contrast, we treat the dexterous hand as a full stack and survey how its layers co-evolve. We focus on work released between January 2024 and early November 2026, and include earlier work where it defines a lineage (e.g., Dactyl [ 6 ] for sim-to-real in-hand reorientation, DexPilot [ 40 ] for vision-based retargeting).
blocks.zh: 古典调查涵盖了机器人手的力学[2,3],一般的自控操控[1,4],或单一的学习范式如RL[36],手动操控[37]或模仿学习[38]. 最近的一项调查将包含的数据整理成一个“金字塔”[39],而不侧重于手。 与此相反,我们把柔软的手当作一个完整的堆栈,并调查其层是如何共同演化的。 我们专注于2024年1月至2026年11月初之间发布的作品,并包括了早期它定义一个血统的作品(例如Dactyl [6]用于sim-to-real in hand reforming,DexPilot [40]用于基于视觉的重定向).

blocks.en: This is a structured narrative review of sources released between January 2024 and 4 November 2026, with earlier work included for foundational methods. The source collection covers arXiv, major robotics, learning and vision venues, project pages, company technical blogs and trade press. Core studies concern multi-fingered hands; adjacent gripper and whole-body studies are included when they motivate a transferable component and are identified as such. Although reference-checking notes accompany the source collection, a complete search log, screening counts and an independent dual-review record are not available. We therefore do not claim exhaustive coverage or systematic-review completeness. Publication, language, company-disclosure and positive-result biases may affect the synthesis.
blocks.zh: 这是对2024年1月至2026年11月4日期间发布的来源的有条理的叙事回顾,早期的工作包括了基础方法. 源集涵盖arXiv,主要机器人,学习和视觉场所,项目页面,公司技术博客和贸易报刊. 核心研究涉及多指手势;相邻的夹手和全身研究在激发可转移成分时也包括在内,并被确定为可转移成分。 虽然来源收集时附有查询说明,但没有完整的搜索记录、筛选清点和独立的双重审查记录。 因此,我们并不主张全面覆盖或系统审查的完整性。 出版物、语言、公司披露和正面效果的偏见可能影响综合。

blocks.en: We separate the source of a claim (paper/preprint, company technical report, or secondary press) from the setting in which it was measured (simulation, real robot, or deployment). These are distinct axes: a large real-world result can still be company-reported, and peer review does not make two benchmarks comparable. Reported percentages retain their original success or progress semantics; missing trial counts, error bars and uncertainty cannot be reconstructed from headline scores. Within-study ablations support local comparisons, whereas cross-paper plots summarize reported scale or cost and are not leaderboards. Recommended architectures, maturity assessments and the kitchen design are explicitly our synthesis, not independently validated deployments.
blocks.zh: 我们把索赔的来源(纸张/预印本、公司技术报告或次级新闻)与所测量的设定(模拟、真正的机器人或部署)分开。 这些是不同的轴心:一个巨大的现实世界成果仍然可以由公司报告,同行审议不能使两个基准具有可比性。 报告的百分比保留了最初的成功或进步语义;缺失的试数,错误栏和不确定性不能从头条分数中重建. 研究内部安排有助于进行地方比较,而跨纸块则总结了报告的规模或成本,不是领导板。 建议的架构、成熟度评估和厨房设计显然是我们的合成,而不是独立验证的部署。

blocks.en: 2 A Full-Stack Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 2 全面分类

blocks.en: Figure 1: The five-layer stack as a closed system. Hardware constrains capture, alignment and execution; evaluation informs the next data and adaptation cycle. This is a conceptual synthesis of the reviewed literature, not the implementation of a particular product. The arrows indicate dependencies rather than guaranteed causal improvements.
blocks.zh: 图 1:五层堆栈作为封闭系统. 硬件限制捕获,对齐和执行;评价为下一个数据和适应周期提供信息. 这是对所审查文献的概念性综合,而不是对某一特定产品的实施。 箭头表示依赖性,而不是保证因果改进。

blocks.en: Figure 1 organizes the survey around three questions: what information survives the mapping from a human to a robot; which decisions can be shared across hands; and which failures require feedback close to the hardware? The five layers answer these questions jointly. Human data are useful only after their observations and action semantics are aligned; a shared policy still needs feasible target-hand commands; and a high task score does not establish reliable contact or deployment readiness.
blocks.zh: 图1围绕三个问题组织调查:从人到机器人的绘图中有哪些信息能幸存下来;哪些决定可以相互分享;哪些失败需要接近硬件的反馈? 五层共同回答了这些问题. 人类数据只有在观测和行动语义一致后才有用;共享政策仍然需要可行的目标手令;高任务分数不能建立可靠的接触或部署准备状态.

blocks.en: Table 2: Glossary of terms used in this survey.
blocks.zh: 表2:本调查所用术语表。

blocks.en: Table 2 defines terms used throughout.
blocks.zh: 表2界定了整个用语。

blocks.en: A hand is characterized by its actuation route (where the motors are and how force reaches the joints), its kinematics (number and arrangement of joints), its sensing (joint encoders, motor current, tactile skins, in-palm cameras) and its maintainability. We distinguish total DoF (all joints, including passive or coupled ones) from active or actuated DoF (independently controlled inputs). Vendors mix these conventions; for example, a widely used linkage hand has 6 active and 12 total DoF [ 11 ] . Unless stated otherwise, we report active DoF.
blocks.zh: 手的特点是其动脉路线(马达所在和力如何到达关节),动脉(关节的数目和安排),感应(联合编码器,运动电流,触觉皮肤,阴部相机)及其可维护性. 我们区分了总的DoF(所有关节,包括被动的或偶联的关节)和主动的或激活的DoF(独立控制的输入). 销售商将这些公约混为一谈;例如,广泛使用的联系手有6个活动方和12个DOF[11]。 除非另有说明,我们报告正在运行的财政部。

blocks.en: Data sources differ in how close they are to the deployed robot. Following the “data pyramid” view [ 39 ] , the top of the pyramid is robot teleoperation (directly executable, expensive), followed by wearable robot-free capture (human hands act directly, hardware approximates the robot), egocentric human video (cheapest and largest, but with the largest gap), simulation and generative data, and general vision-language data at the base.
blocks.zh: 数据来源在与部署的机器人的距离有多近方面有所不同. 在"数据金字塔"视图[39]之后,金字塔的顶部是机器人远程操作(直接可执行,昂贵),然后是可穿戴的机器人无阻捕捉(人手直接行动,硬件与机器人相近),以自我为中心的人类视频(最便宜和最大,但差距最大),模拟和基因数据,以及基地的一般视觉语言数据.

blocks.en: We call the mismatch between a data source and the target robot the embodiment gap . For hands it has five components: morphology (finger count, DoF, coupling, thumb design, size); action semantics (joint order and meaning); observation (camera placement, appearance of the hand, tactile sensor type and layout); dynamics (torque limits, stiffness, friction, backlash); and timing (latency, control rate, action-chunk length). The gap arises both between humans and robots and between different robot hands.
blocks.zh: 我们称数据源与目标机器人之间的不匹配为"化身差距". 对于手来说,它有五个组成部分:形态学(指数,DoF,耦合,拇指设计,大小);动作语义学(联合顺序和意义);观察(相机放置,手的外观,触觉感应类型和布局);动力学(屈折极限,僵硬,摩擦,反弹);以及时间学(距离,控制率,动作长度). 差距既发生在人和机器人之间,也发生在不同的机器人手之间.

blocks.en: Policies for dexterous hands are trained with RL (mostly in simulation), imitation learning from demonstrations, large-scale pretraining of VLA or world-action models, or combinations of these. Architectures increasingly split control into layers running at different frequencies.
blocks.zh: 用RL(主要是模拟),从演示中学习模仿,对VLA或世界行动模型进行大规模预训,或这些模型的组合,来培训对手具有弹性的政策. 建筑越来越将控制分为不同频率运行的层.

blocks.en: Benchmarks, competitions and field deployments define what “dexterous” means in practice. We organize them by atomic skills (grasping, in-hand reorientation, tool use, bimanual coordination, articulated objects, deformable and fragile objects, insertion and assembly, force-controlled dosing) and by application domains.
blocks.zh: 基准、竞争和实地部署界定了“极端”的实际含义。 我们通过原子技术(编织、手动调整、工具使用、双人协调、清晰的物体、变形和脆弱的物体、插入和组装、武力控制的剂量)和应用领域来组织它们。

blocks.en: 3 Layer 1: Hardware
blocks.zh: 3 层1: 硬件

blocks.en: 3.1 A brief lineage
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 简短的血统

blocks.en: Today’s design debates echo earlier generations of hands [ 2 , 3 ] . The Robonaut 2 hand placed all 16 finger and 2 wrist actuators in the forearm and drove 12 hand DoF through braided tendons, using n + 1 n{+}1 tendons for n n DoF in the primary fingers, and reached fingertip forces of about 2.25 kg and payloads above 9 kg [ 58 ] , the template for today’s forearm-actuated humanoid hands. DLR’s line, from Hand II to the Awiwi hand, was designed from the functions of the human hand rather than its anatomy [ 59 ] ; Awiwi’s antagonistic elastic drive survived a 500 g hammer strike and reached finger speeds of about 3,500 deg/s, more than five times what its motors alone provide, and its designer argued explicitly that such robustness would allow learning by trial and error without costly damage [ 60 ] , an argument that Section 3.7 shows is more relevant than ever. EthoHand approximated the human hand with seven motors around a tendon-driven ball-joint thumb and could pass a ball between fingers while texting on a phone held in the same palm [ 61 ] . Underactuated prosthetic designs contributed double-stage underactuation and reconfigurable thumbs [ 62 ] , and the Pisa/IIT SoftHand family showed that adaptive synergies with a single actuator achieve robust grasping [ 63 ] . Soft pneumatic hands reached the full grasp taxonomy and maximal Kapandji score with RBO Hand 3, which has 16 independent degrees of actuation, an actuated palm and finger spreading [ 64 ] ; DManus covered palm and fingertips with magnetic skin at low cost [ 65 ] . LEAP Hand [ 66 ] and its hybrid rigid–soft successor [ 67 ] brought this lineage to the learning community.
blocks.zh: 今天的设计辩论回响了前几代人的手[2,3]. Robonaut 2手将全部16个手指和2个腕动器放在前臂,并用n+1n===================================================================================================================================================================================================================================== 从Hand II到Awiwi手,DLR的线是从人体手的功能而不是解剖学[59]设计出来的;Awiwi的对立弹性驱动力在500克锤击中幸存下来,达到约3,500 deg/s的手指速度,是其单马达提供的5倍多,其设计师明确认为,这种稳健性将允许通过试验和错误学习,而不造成代价高昂的损害[60],第3.7节所显示的论点比以往任何时候都更加相关。 EthoHand用7个马达近似于人手,绕着一根垂体驱动的球-关节拇指,可以在手指间传递一球,同时在握在同一个手掌上的手机上发短信[61]. 功能不足的假肢设计促成了双阶段的功能不足和可重塑拇指[62],比萨/IIT软汉家族显示,与单个助动器的适应性协同实现强力把握[63]. 软气手与RBO Hand 3达到全把握分类和最大卡潘吉分数,它具有16个独立的激活度,一个振动的手掌和手指展开[64];DManus用低价的磁皮肤覆盖手掌和指尖[65]. LEAP Hand [66] 及其混合刚性-柔性接班人 [67] 给学习界带来了这种血统.

blocks.en: 3.2 Actuation and transmission routes
blocks.zh: 3.2 引爆和传输路线

blocks.en: Where the motors sit and how they move the joints determines a hand’s weight, strength, backdrivability, maintainability and, importantly for learning, how simple the mapping from motor commands to joint angles is. Six routes coexist ( Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 电动机的坐落位置和如何移动关节,决定了手的重量,强度,后驾性,可维持性,更重要的是,对于学习来说,从电动机指令到关节角的绘图有多简单. 六道并存(表3).

blocks.en: Each joint has its own micro-motor and gearbox inside the finger or palm. Joints are independently controllable, backlash is low and the hand can be backdrivable, which keeps the motor-to-joint map simple and simplifies sim-to-real transfer. Recent examples include the Wuji Hand (20 active DoF, under 600 g, a vendor-claimed endurance of more than 300k grasp cycles) [ 68 ] , BrainCo Revo 3 (21 DoF, backdrivable) [ 69 ] , a 20-DoF fully direct-drive hand rated for a 30 kg payload [ 11 ] , the DH-Robotics ADH-5-13 (13 DoF, modular sensors replaceable without disassembling a finger) [ 70 ] and the Sharpa Wave (22 active DoF, 1:1 human size, a dynamic tactile array on each finger) [ 42 ] . The academic MIDAS hand (13 active of 16 joints, 283 three-axis taxels, BOM below US$3k) ships with a simulation model and teleoperation pipeline [ 43 ] . The main limitations are heat, limited per-finger force and the cost of 16–20 small motors.
blocks.zh: 每个关节在手指或掌上都有自己的微型运动器和变速箱. 关节是独立可控的,反弹低,手可反驾,这保持了运动对联合图的简单,简化了sim-to-real的传输. 近期的例子包括:武吉手(20个活跃的DOF,低于600g,一个供应商声称的超过300k抓取周期的耐力)[68],BrainCo Revo 3(21个DOF,可后驾)[69],一个20个DOF完全直接驱动的手被评为30公斤有效载荷[11],DH-Robotics ADH-5-13(13个DOF,模块式传感器可替换而不拆卸一根手指)[70]和夏帕波(22个活跃的DOF,1个人尺寸,每个手指上一个动态触觉阵列)[42]. 学术MIDAS手型(16个关节的13艘活动,283个三轴分类器,BOM低于3k美元),具有模拟模型和远程操作管道[43]. 主要限制是热力,每指力有限,以及16~20个小马达的成本.

blocks.en: Micro linear actuators drive coupled linkages, typically giving 6 active of 11–12 total DoF. Linkage hands are stiff, strong, durable and cheap, and dominate early humanoid deployments; their coupling limits in-hand dexterity and abduction. A six-DoF hand of this type is sold for about US$930 [ 11 ] , and the ByteDexter hand uses linkages at 20 DoF for teleoperated data collection [ 71 ] . Recent academic designs show that linkages are not inherently limited to a few actuators: DexLink drives 20 joints with 16 independent actuators at 320 g and below US$400 while reaching the maximum Kapandji score and all 33 grasp types [ 72 ] , and SyLink uses motion capture to find human joint correlations and decouples flexion from abduction with a spherical four-bar mechanism, driving 19 joints with 11 actuators at 520 g [ 73 ] .
blocks.zh: 微型线性引爆器驱动着连结,通常给6个活跃的DOF总量11–12。 连结手力坚硬、强健、耐用和廉价,并主导了早期人造物的部署;它们的连结极限是手动的自制和绑架。 该型号的6-DoF手售价约930[11]美元,ByteDexter手则使用20 DOF的链接进行远程操作数据收集[71]. 最近的学术设计表明,联系本身并不限于几个推动者: DexLink以320g和低于400美元的速度驱动20个关节,16个独立动因子,同时达到卡潘吉最高分数和所有33个抓取类型[72],SyLink使用运动捕捉法寻找人类的联动关联,用球形四巴机制解开绑架时的弹性,驾驶19个关节,11个动因子以520g[73].

blocks.en: Motors in the forearm pull tendons (often sheathed) that act on the fingers, as in the Shadow Hand [ 5 ] . This keeps the hand light and compliant and makes high DoF counts feasible, at the price of friction, creep, slack and a non-linear joint–motor map that needs tensioning and calibration. Tesla’s Optimus V3 hand, according to patent analyses, moves 22 hand DoF onto 25 forearm actuators per arm and introduces a wrist routing that limits tendon-length change under combined yaw and pitch [ 74 ] . Open-source tendon hands focus on maintainability: ORCA uses joints that dislocate before they break, self-calibrating tendon routing and a ratchet tensioner, and ran 10,000 consecutive cycles without failure [ 41 ] ; RUKA uses an underactuated tendon design and RUKA-v2 adds a parallel wrist [ 75 , 76 ] ; MM-Hand moves the motors to a remote housing with quick-release tendon connectors and analyzes sheath friction [ 77 ] ; CRAFT combines soft joints with rigid links for under US$600 [ 13 ] ; and a 17-DoF antagonistic design drives both flexion and extension without return springs [ 78 ] . The tendon-to-joint map is increasingly handled with learning and proprioception rather than hand-tuned friction models: a transformer that predicts tendon forces within 3% of maximum motor force reduces the sim-to-real gap by 41% and improves fingertip tracking of an RL controller by 50% on real tendon-driven fingers [ 79 ] ; series-elastic tendons estimate contact timing, joint angles and object stiffness without vision or touch [ 80 ] ; model-based estimation recovers joint positions from tendon displacement and tension [ 81 ] ; and the DexHand 021 (12 active and 7 passive DoF, 1 kg) uses proprioceptive compliance control with force estimation errors below 0.2 N [ 82 ] . Artificial muscles are another remote-actuation option: electrohydraulic Peano-HASEL actuators in the forearm drive an inherently compliant musculoskeletal hand that detects grasps from operating current alone [ 83 ] .
blocks.zh: 前臂的汽车牵引线(通常被套住)在手指上作用,如"影子手"[5]. 这保持了手的光度和合规性,使高水平的DoF计数成为可行,其代价是摩擦、蠕动、松懈以及非线性联合机动图,需要张力和校准。 根据专利分析,特斯拉的Optimus V3手将22只手 DoF移动到每只手臂的25个前臂起动器上,并引入了手腕路由法,限制在结合的yaw和pitch下线长变化[74]. 开源的手侧重于可维护性: ORCA使用在断裂前脱落的关节,自校对的导线和扭矩拉伸器,连续运行10000个周期没有故障[41];RUKA使用不适的导线设计,RUKA-v2增加一个平行的手腕[75,76];MM-Hand将电动机移动到一个有快速放电的导线连接器并分析 Sheth 摩擦[77];CRAFT将柔性关节与硬链结合,在600美元[13]美元以下;以及17-DO对抗性设计驱动双弹性和延伸而无回弹簧[78]. 斜向对联图越来越多地用学习和自控而不是手调摩擦模型处理:预测最大电动机力3%范围内的斜向力的变压器将斜向对实际差距缩小41%,并在实际斜向驱动的手指上将RL控制器的指尖跟踪率提高50%[79];系列斜向对接触时间、联合角度和物体僵硬性进行估计,而无视觉或触觉[80];基于模型的估计从斜向分散和张力中恢复了联合位置[81];DexHand 021(12个主动和7个被动 DoF,1公斤)使用斜向合规控制,其强度估计误差低于0.2 N [82]。 人工肌肉是另一种远程激活选择:前臂中的电水合物Peano-HASEL激活器驱动一个内在符合的肌肉骨骼手,从单电流操作中检测到抓取[83].

blocks.en: 2026 product launches show a clear shift to hybrids: tendons for high-force flexion and in-palm direct drive or linkages for abduction and opposition. Xiaomi’s 21-DoF hand uses 26 motors with tendon-tension control and was designed from an analysis of 1,827 factory standard operating procedures [ 84 ] . Research hands explore other hybrids, such as shape-memory-alloy extension combined with motor-driven flexion [ 85 ] , or a split of five forearm motors for grip force and ten palm motors for fine manipulation in a 15-DoF, 1.4 kg hand [ 86 ] .
blocks.zh: 2026产品发布显示明显转向混合体:用于高强度弹性和棕榈直接驱动或连接绑架和反对的倾向. Xiaomi的21-DOF手型采用26台马达,并具有调压控制功能,由1,827工厂标准操作程序分析[84]设计. 研究手探索其他杂交体,如形状-模态-合金扩展与运动驱动的弹性结合[85],或用5个前臂马达进行握力分拆,用10个棕榈马达进行精细操纵,在15-DoF,1.4公斤手[86].

blocks.en: Sanctuary AI’s 21-DoF hand uses miniature hydraulic valves and was shown performing zero-shot in-hand cube reorientation using only the fingertips [ 87 ] ; in academia, DexCo uses soft hydraulic actuation with hydrostatic compliance modeling and reports 34.4 N repeatable fingertip force and 0.03 mm repeatability [ 88 ] . At the other end, servo-based open hands such as LEAP [ 66 ] , Aero Hand Open [ 12 ] and AmazingHand [ 89 ] trade anthropomorphic proportions and strength for very low cost and easy repair.
blocks.zh: Sanctuary AI的21-DoF手使用微型液压阀,被显示只使用指尖进行零镜头的手立方体重定向[87];在学术界,DexCo采用软液压振动,采用水静态合规模型和报告 34.4 无重复的指尖力和0.03毫米的重复性[88]. 另一方面,基于servo的开放手,如LEAP[66],Aero Hand Open[12]和AndianHand[89]贸易人类形态比例和强度,成本非常低,修复容易.

blocks.en: 3.3 How many degrees of freedom?
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 多少度的自由吗?

blocks.en: Commercial hands are marketed with anywhere from 6 to 42 DoF, but flagship designs are converging on roughly 20–22 active DoF (Sharpa Wave 22 [ 42 ] , Dex5-S 22 [ 10 ] , Optimus V3 22 [ 74 ] , Revo 3 21 [ 69 ] , Xiaomi 21 [ 84 ] ). The most explicit evidence comes from Xiaomi’s industrial study, which reports that across 1,827 factory procedures, hands with 17–21 DoF achieved 15–38% higher average stable-grasp success than 6–15-DoF hands, with diminishing returns beyond 23 DoF, and that joints with correlation above 0.8 (e.g., the distal interphalangeal joint following roughly one third of the proximal one) are good candidates for underactuated coupling [ 84 ] . This is a vendor study rather than a controlled academic experiment, but it is consistent with the grasp coverage results of open hands: CRAFT and an antagonistic 17-DoF hand cover all 33 grasp types of the GRASP taxonomy [ 112 , 13 , 78 ] . Grasp-taxonomy coverage, however, no longer discriminates between designs: low-cost tendon and linkage hands now routinely complete all 33 grasp types [ 110 , 72 , 13 ] . More informative are fingertip force (a 16-DoF open tendon hand completes every grasp type yet averages only 2.14 N peak fingertip force [ 110 ] ), opposition range and durability.
blocks.zh: 商业双手的市场范围从6到42个DOF,但旗舰设计在大约20到22个活跃的DOF(沙帕波22 [42],Dex5-S 22 [10],Optimus V3 22 [74],Revo 3 21 [69],小米21 [84])上趋同. 最明确的证据来自小米的工业研究,该研究报告说,在1 827个工厂程序中,手持17–21 DoF的手取得了比6–15-DoF手高15–38%的稳定增殖平均成功率,回报率在23 DoF之后不断下降,而且与0.8以上相关联的关节(例如,大约三分之一的近缘性关节连接)是低效耦合[84]的良好候选人。 这是一项销售商研究,而不是一个受控制的学术实验,但它与开放手的把握覆盖结果是一致的:CRAFT和一个对立的17-DoF手覆盖了巨猿类分类的所有33种把握类型[112,13,78]. 然而,Grasp-taxonomy的涵盖范围不再区分设计:低成本的手和连接手现在例行地完成所有33种抓取类型[110、72、13]。 更多的信息是指尖力(16-DoF的开关手完成每个抓取类型,平均只有2.14个)。 N高峰指尖力[110],反对范围与耐久性.

blocks.en: The thumb remains the hardest joint. BiDexHand misses two of eleven Kapandji poses because of limited carpometacarpal range [ 110 ] ; a soft biomimetic saddle-joint thumb scores 9/10 [ 113 ] ; and design methods place the thumb by workspace analysis [ 114 ] or make it reconfigurable [ 62 ] . Optimizing phalanx length ratios against manipulability and workspace metrics shows that phalanges do not contribute equally to dexterity [ 115 ] . The palm and wrist are becoming design variables: ISyHand’s articulated palm significantly outperforms a fixed-palm variant of the same hand in RL cube reorientation [ 111 ] , and wrists are integrated into synergy hands [ 116 ] or added to low-cost tendon hands with quantified ranges [ 117 , 76 ] . Whether anthropomorphism itself is necessary is contested: a review of 125 papers from 2019–2025 concludes that in-hand manipulation does not benefit from anthropomorphic design and that mechanism complexity correlates with task breadth [ 118 ] , whereas musculoskeletal designs argue that anatomical priors help identify which structures matter for control [ 119 ] . For learning from human data, the relevant question is narrower: how closely the hand’s kinematics and camera placement must match a human’s for human data to transfer ( Section 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 拇指仍然是最难的 BiDexHand错过了11个Kapandji的2个姿势,因为Carpometacarpal范围有限[110];一个软的生物模具鞍-联合拇指得分9/10[113];设计方法通过工作空间分析将拇指放置[114]或使其可重新配置[62]. 优化phalanx长度与可操纵性和工作空间度量比表明phalanges不能同样促进dexterity [115]. 手掌和手腕正在成为设计变量:ISyHand的清晰的手掌显著超过RL立方体重定向中同一手的固定手掌变体[111],手腕被整合到协同手[116]或加入到成本低廉的垂体手中,以量化的范围[117,76]. 人类形态论本身是否必要受到质疑:对2019–2025年125篇论文的审查认为,人工操纵不能从人类形态设计中受益,机制的复杂性与任务宽度相关[118],而肌肉骨骼设计则认为解剖学前科有助于确定哪些结构具有控制意义[119]. 对于从人类数据中学习,相关问题比较狭窄:手的动能和相机的放置必须在多大程度上与人类数据传输相匹配(第4.6节)。

blocks.en: We expect two tiers to persist: 6–12-DoF hands for high-throughput industrial grasping and 20–22-DoF hands for research, data collection and general-purpose humanoids.
blocks.zh: 我们期望两个层次继续存在:高通量工业抓取的6-12-DoF手和研究、数据收集和一般用途人造物的20-22-DoF手。

blocks.en: A related design question is where the actuators live . Humanoid makers increasingly move large motors into the forearm, as in Optimus V3 [ 74 ] , yielding an integrated arm–hand module with low distal inertia. Hands sold as standalone products, by contrast, mostly keep actuation in the palm so that they can be mounted on arbitrary arms.
blocks.zh: 与此相关的一个设计问题,是引爆者住在哪里。 如Optimus V3 [74] 中,人造人越来越多地将大型马达移入前臂,产生一个具有低分量惯性的综合手动模块。 相比之下,作为独立产品出售的手大多保持手掌的振动,以便可以挂在任意的手臂上。

blocks.en: 3.4 Soft, compliant and variable-stiffness hands
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 柔软、合规和可变的坚韧手

blocks.en: Compliance protects hands and objects and simplifies teleoperation and learning. Beyond RBO Hand 3 [ 64 ] , recent examples include the Tactile SoftHand-A, a 3D-printed underactuated hand with antagonistic tendons to open and close actively and an integrated vision-based tactile sensor [ 120 ] ; a LEGO-based educational synergy hand at the lowest end of the cost spectrum [ 121 ] ; pneumatic hands with single-step printed exoskeletons [ 122 ] ; and soft–rigid hybrid fingers whose stiffness is set by control gains rather than hardware, which completed 28 of 33 grasp postures and supported diffusion-policy learning from glove teleoperation [ 123 ] . Variable-stiffness joints based on beaded-string jamming span 0.48–1.95 Nm/rad and a gripper integrating the joint reached 60% higher peg-in-hole success than a rigid one [ 124 ] . Co-design is moving from simulation to physical validation: a genetic algorithm with policy transfer evaluated nearly 400 soft-hand designs and validated them with more than 900 teleoperated tasks [ 125 ] , and multi-parameter benchmarking of candidate fingers (joint, bone, skin and sensor placement) precedes assembling a full hand [ 126 ] .
blocks.zh: 遵义保护手和物体,简化远程操作和学习. 除了RBO Hand 3 [64]之外,最近的例子包括Tactile SoftHand-A, 3D打印的低效手持对立倾向打开和关闭,综合视线触觉传感器[120];基于LEGO的教育协同手在成本谱中最低端[121];带有单步打印的外骨骼的肺动手[122];以及软-刚性混合手指,其硬度由控制增益而不是硬件决定,它完成了33个控制姿势中的28个,并支持从手套远程操作中学习传播政策[123]。 基于珠弦干扰的可变悬索关节跨度0.48-1.95 Nm/rad 和一个集成电路的钳子 成功率比僵硬的[124]高60%。 共同设计正在从模拟转向物理验证:一个具有政策转移的遗传算法对近400个软手设计进行了评价,并用900多个远程操作任务加以验证[125],对候选手指(联合、骨骼、皮肤和传感器的放置)进行多参数基准设定,然后组装全手[126]。

blocks.en: 3.5 Tactile sensing
blocks.zh: 3.5 触控感应

blocks.en: Touch moved from an option to a selling point in 2026. Products advertise full-palm coverage: 1,500 taxels on Xiaomi’s hand [ 84 ] , 1,140 Hall-effect cells on the PaXini DexH13 [ 102 ] , fingertip visuo-tactile sensors plus more than 300 palm taxels on the AGILINK OmniHand 3 [ 96 ] , and a dynamic tactile array per finger on the Sharpa Wave, with a full-hand tactile successor [ 42 , 101 ] . Sanctuary reports a barometric tactile sensitivity of 5 mN [ 87 ] , and Figure 03 reports fingertip force sensing at the 3 g level [ 99 ] . Three sensing principles dominate: piezoresistive skins (cheap, fast and simple, and the mainstream choice for mass production), capacitive and magnetic/Hall arrays, and visuo-tactile sensors that image the deformation of an elastomer with an internal camera (highest spatial resolution, used for fragile objects and slip). Academic hands increasingly integrate distributed sensing at the phalanges [ 107 ] and full-hand arrays [ 43 ] . Full coverage is not always necessary: task-driven pruning reduced a Shadow Hand array from 92 to 21 sensors while retaining 93% of performance, with thumb, ring and little-finger sensors contributing most [ 127 ] . The fragmentation of sensor types is a major obstacle to reusing tactile data across hands; we discuss sensors, simulation and tactile learning in depth in Section 7 .
blocks.zh: 触摸在2026年从一个选项转移到一个销售点. 产品广告全面覆盖:小米手上1500个计时器[84],PaXini DexH13[102]上的1,140个霍尔效应电池,指尖粘度-活性传感器加AGILINK OmniHand 3[96]上的300多个棕榈分类器,夏帕波上每个手指上一个动态触觉阵列,一个全手触觉的继任者[42,101]. Sanctuary报告气压触觉灵敏度为5mN[87],图03报告指尖力感应到3g级[99]. 三种感知原理占主导地位:皮革(便宜、快捷和简单,以及大规模生产的主流选择)、电容和磁/霍尔阵列以及用内部照相机(最高的空间分辨率,用于脆弱物体和滑动)来描绘一个弹性体的变形的粘着式传感器。 学术手越来越多地将分布式传感器集成在phalanges[107]和全手阵列[43]. 并非总需要全覆盖:任务驱动的冲压将一个Shadow Hand阵列从92个传感器减少到21个,同时保留93%的性能,其中拇指,环形和小指传感器的贡献最大[127]. 传感器类型的分裂是跨手重用触觉数据的一个主要障碍;我们在第7节中深入讨论了传感器、模拟和触觉学习。

blocks.en: 3.6 Open-source and academic hands
blocks.zh: 3.6 开源和学术之手

blocks.en: Open-source hands have evolved from “it moves” to “it is ready for learning”. LEAP (2023) introduced a universal metacarpophalangeal abduction mechanism, about US$2k and a four-hour assembly, and outperformed the Allegro Hand at roughly one eighth of its cost [ 66 ] . Since 2025, designs ship with what a learning pipeline needs: simulation models (Aero Hand Open is released “simulation-ready” at US$314 [ 12 ] ; MIDAS includes control and tactile APIs, retargeting and teleoperation [ 43 ] ), integrated touch (ORCA’s tactile variant [ 41 , 106 ] ), wrists (RUKA-v2 [ 76 ] ), in-hand stereo cameras (MM-Hand [ 77 ] ) and maintainability features. Some designs are being commercialized: ORCA offers 9-, 17-DoF and tactile versions at US$1.5k–6.1k [ 106 ] . Hands are also being co-designed with data collection and with policies: RAPID Hand co-optimizes hand, perception and teleoperation interface [ 108 ] , and House of Dextra pretrains a morphology-conditioned policy over many generated hand shapes to evaluate candidate designs [ 128 ] .
blocks.zh: 开放源码的手已经从“它移动”演变为“它准备学习”。 LEAP(2023年)引入了通用的元卡波帕朗格绑架机制,约2k美元和4小时的组装,并以约八分之一的成本超过了Allegro Hand[66]. 自2025年以来,设计载有学习管道需要的船舶:模拟模型(Aero Hand Open发布 " 模拟准备 " ,为314美元[12];MIDAS包括控制和触觉API、重新瞄准和远程操作[43])、综合触觉(ORCA的触觉变体[41,106])、手腕(RUKA-v2 [76])、手提立体摄像机(MM-Hand [77])和维护特性。 一些设计正在商业化:ORCA提供9-,17-DoF和触觉版本,价格为1.5k-6.1k [106]. 与数据收集和政策共同设计了手: 拉皮德语 手配合优化手,感知和远程操作接口[108],Dextra House在很多生成的手形上预先设定了形态条件的政策,用以评价候选设计[128].

blocks.en: 3.7 Durability, cost and supply chain
blocks.zh: 3.7 可重复性、成本和供应链

blocks.en: Integrators report that some popular hands fail after about 50 grasps of a 5 kg object; a warehouse robot performs 8,000–10,000 grasps per day while leading products are rated for 300k–500k cycles, which suggests a potential mismatch with continuous duty, but cannot by itself establish replacement intervals without matched loads and failure definitions [ 92 ] . Figure reported that the forearm was the most common failure point in its BMW pilot [ 99 ] . Vendor claims of 300k cycles [ 68 , 97 ] sit near today’s passing line; industrial deployment will require million-cycle lifetimes, load-specified test conditions and modular quick-swap designs.
blocks.zh: 集成商报告说,一些流行的手在大约50次抓住5公斤物体后会失败;一个仓库机器人每天完成8000-10000次抓取,而主要产品则被评为300k-500k循环,这表明可能与连续任务不匹配,但本身不能在没有匹配负载和故障定义的情况下建立替换间隔[92]. 图中报告,前臂是其宝马试验机最常见的故障点[99]. 供应商对300k周期[68,97]的索偿在今天的过线线附近;工业部署需要百万周期的寿命、特定载荷的试验条件和模块式快速扫描设计。

blocks.en: A complete low-cost bimanual research platform illustrates where money goes: about US$5k for two robot hands, US$7k for the teleoperation system and US$16k for two arms [ 129 ] . Figure 3 plots reported prices against actuated DoF. Reported prices span a wide range across products: established research hands are quoted around US$16k–100k or more [ 5 , 90 , 68 ] , while the 22-DoF Dex5-S is reported at about US$6.5k [ 10 ] , while open-source BOMs reach a few hundred dollars [ 12 , 89 , 13 ] . The dexterous hand is still among the most expensive single components of a humanoid. Its cost is dominated by 16–20 coreless micro-motors (6–8 mm diameter) per high-DoF hand, a market led by a few European suppliers; domestic Chinese alternatives are reported at 30–40% of import prices but still trail at the smallest sizes [ 130 ] .
blocks.zh: 一个完整的低成本双人研究平台说明了资金流向何方:两只机器人手约5k美元,远程操作系统约7k美元,两只手臂约16k美元[129]. 图3 图3 报告的价格相对于已激活的DOF。 报告的价格在产品之间很广:固定的研究手被引用在16k-100k或以上[5、90、68]美元左右,而22-DOF Dex5-S被报告在6.5k [10]美元左右,而开源的BOM达到数百美元[12、89、13]。 柔软的手仍然是人体最昂贵的单体成分之一. 其成本主要为每只高手16–20个无芯微电动车(直径6–8毫米),这个市场由少数欧洲供应商主导;据报道,中国国内的替代品为进口价格的30–40%,但最小尺寸仍然有轨迹[130].

blocks.en: Beyond motors, transmission components (micro lead screws and planetary roller screws for linear drives, tendons and sheaths) and sensing components (six-axis force sensors, electronic skins, joint encoders) form the rest of the bill of materials, and hand makers increasingly develop actuators in-house to control cost [ 130 , 91 ] . Industry analyses describe an “impossible triangle” among dexterity, payload and cost [ 131 ] , a market that is fragmented with small revenues per vendor, and valuations that run ahead of revenue [ 132 ] . Expert opinion converges on roughly 20 DoF as necessary for human-level dexterity, with six-DoF hands not strictly dexterous and 40+ DoF largely redundant [ 133 ] . Tactile sensors attracted dozens of financing rounds in 2025–2026 [ 134 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了马达之外,传输组件(微铅螺丝和用于线性驱动器、导线和螺纹的行星滚子螺丝)和感应组件(六轴力传感器、电子皮肤、联合编码器)构成材料的其余部分,手工业者在内部越来越多地开发起动器以控制成本[130,91]。 工业分析描述了一种“不可能的三角形”在弹性、有效载荷和成本[131]之间,这个市场支离破碎,每个销售商的收入很少,而且估值比收入高[132]。 专家意见将大约20个DOF作为人类层面的dexterity所必需,6-DOF手不严格为dexterous,40+DOF基本上冗余[133]. Tactile传感器在2025–2026年吸引了数十轮融资回合[134].

blocks.en: Market trackers estimate 19.2k hands sold in China in 2025, with forecasts of 70.2k in 2026 and 430k by 2030 [ 14 ] ; individual vendors report cumulative shipments in the 10k range [ 91 ] . These figures are not audited and should be read as indicators of momentum rather than market size.
blocks.zh: 市场追踪器估计2025年中国销量为19.2k手,2026年预测销量为70.2k手,2030年预测销量为430k手 [14];个体销售商报告累计发货量为10k范围[91]. 这些数字未经审计,应理解为势头指标而不是市场规模指标。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Reported cost and actuated DoF for selected hands, with commercial prices separated from open-source BOM/kit costs [ 94 , 10 , 68 , 90 , 5 , 89 , 12 , 13 , 66 , 43 ] . Approximate or upper/lower-bound source figures are plotted at their stated reference values; Shadow is reported above US$100k, CRAFT below US$600 and MIDAS below US$3k. Costs differ in included components, support, assembly and date, so these are not equivalent procurement quotes. The cross-sectional plot does not establish a temporal price decline or a performance frontier.
blocks.zh: 图3:报告某些手部的成本和启动的DOF,商业价格与开源BOM/Kit成本分开[94、10、68、90、5、89、12、13、66、43]。 大约或上/下限源数字按其说明的参考值绘制; 阴影报告在100k美元以上,CRAFT低于600美元,MIDAS低于3k美元。 成本在包括的组成部分、支助、组装和日期方面各不相同,因此这些不是等同的采购报价。 跨部门地块没有确定时价下跌或性能前沿.

blocks.en: Takeaway. Hardware is converging on ∼ \sim 20–22 active DoF with hybrid actuation and full-hand touch for high-end hands, while 6–12-DoF linkage hands serve industrial picking. Cost is falling fast; durability under realistic loads, not DoF, is now the binding constraint. For learning, backdrivable direct-drive joints and human-like proportions and camera placement make sim-to-real and human-data reuse easier ( Section 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 外卖 硬件在 \sim 20 – 22 活动 DoF 上汇合,其混合激活和全手触动用于高端手,而 6–12-DoF 链接手为工业采摘服务. 成本迅速下降;在现实的负载下耐久性,而不是DOF,现在是约束性的制约. 对于学习而言,可折返式直接驱动关节和类似人的比例和相机的放置使模拟到现实和人的数据再利用更容易(第4.6节)。

blocks.en: 4 Layer 2: Data
blocks.zh: 4 层2: 数据

blocks.en: Data for dexterous manipulation can be organized by how close the recorded actions and observations are to those of the deployed robot. Closer sources are more directly usable but more expensive per hour; more distant sources scale better but require bridging an embodiment gap ( Section 6 ). Table 6 summarizes representative systems, Figure 5 the reported data scales, and Table 7 a qualitative comparison of routes.
blocks.zh: 可以按照所记录的动作和观测与所部署的机器人的动作和观测相距有多近来组织关于非曲直操纵的数据. 更接近的来源更直接可用,但价格更昂贵;更远的来源范围更好,但需要弥补浮雕差距(第6节)。 表6汇总了代表性系统,图5为报告的数据尺度,表7为路线质量比较。

blocks.zh: 表6:具有代表性的十足的数据收集系统和数据集(2024-2026年)。 比例表报告;“h” =小时,“demos”=示威。

blocks.en: Table 7: Qualitative comparison of data routes. “+” favorable, “ − - ” unfavorable.

blocks.en: 4.1 Teleoperation
blocks.zh: 4.1 电信业务

blocks.en: In teleoperation a human controls the robot and the robot’s own observations and joint commands are recorded, which gives directly executable data with no embodiment gap. Interfaces fall into three groups.
blocks.zh: 在远程操作中,人类控制机器人和机器人自己的观测和联合指令被记录下来,这提供了直接可执行的数据,没有浮雕缺口。 界面分为三组.

blocks.en: Headsets such as Apple Vision Pro and Meta Quest provide stereo video and hand keypoints, which are retargeted to robot joints [ 40 , 152 ] . Representative systems include OPEN TEACH [ 153 ] , Open-TeleVision with head-following active stereo [ 45 ] , Bunny-VisionPro with vibrotactile feedback and collision constraints [ 135 ] , HATO for bimanual visuotactile teleoperation with repurposed prosthetic hands [ 104 ] , monocular whole-body shadowing [ 154 , 155 ] , and phone-based interfaces [ 156 ] . These systems are cheap and fast to deploy, but finger tracking jitters under occlusion and there is no force feedback, so contact-rich tasks suffer: in the DexDirect user study, a vision-based baseline achieved zero success on whiteboard wiping and typing, and DexDirect collected 3.2 × \times more successful demonstrations than TeleDex and 17.2 × \times more than AnyTeleop [ 145 ] .
blocks.zh: Apple Vision Pro和Meta Quest等头像提供立体声视频和手键点,这些头像重定向为机器人关节[40,152]. 代表系统包括:Open TeACH [153],带头跟随活性立体声的Open-Television [45],有紫外活性反馈和碰撞约束的Bunny-VisionPro [135],用重装假手进行双人对定额远程操作的HATO [104],单体全体阴影[154,155],以及电话接口 [156]. 这些系统价格便宜,部署速度快,但是在隔离下,手指跟踪颤抖且没有强力反馈,因此接触量大的任务受到影响:在DexDirect用户研究中,一个基于视觉的基线在白板擦拭和打字上取得了零成功,DexDirect收集了3.2×\时间比TeleDex更成功的演示,17.2×\时间比AnyTeleop [145].

blocks.en: Commercial electromagnetic gloves track 25 skeletal joints at 120 Hz without optical occlusion and have become a de facto standard in industry [ 157 ] ; they are, however, sensitive to nearby metal and motors. Research gloves add force or tactile feedback at low cost: DOGlove [ 137 ] , CDF-Glove [ 158 ] , the tactile-feedback-array glove TAG [ 159 ] , and Glovity, which renders wrist wrenches [ 160 ] . Wrist pose is tracked separately with trackers, arm exoskeletons or SLAM cameras.
blocks.zh: 商业电磁手套轨道 25 骨骼关节,120 Hz没有光学隔离,已经成为工业中事实上的标准[157];然而,它们对附近的金属和马达敏感. 研究手套以低价增加强力或触觉反馈:DOGlove [137],CDF-Glove [158],触觉-feedback-array手套 TAG [159],和Glovity,这使得手腕扭伤[160]. 手腕姿势用跟踪器,手臂外骨骼或SLAM相机分别跟踪.

blocks.en: Exoskeletons give joint-level, low-latency mappings and can provide force feedback, at the cost of being tied to one target hand. The lineage runs from ACE [ 136 ] , HOMIE [ 161 ] , NuExo [ 162 ] and Exo-ViHa [ 163 ] to MILE, which co-designs a mechanically isomorphic exoskeleton and robot hand with sub-degree joint error and shows that fingertip visuo-tactile sensing raises success by 25% on average [ 138 ] . DITTO maps a motorized exoskeleton one-to-one onto a kinematically equivalent 7-DoF hand, unifying handheld collection and bilateral teleoperation with joint force feedback [ 147 ] ; DITTO-X adds reverse teleoperation for DAgger-style interventions [ 148 ] . DexterityGen takes a complementary route: a pretrained RL controller executes low-level finger motion while the operator only provides high-level intent [ 164 ] .
blocks.zh: Exoskeletons提供联合水平,低纬度的映射,并可以提供力反馈,代价是被绑在一个目标手上. 该系系从ACE [136],HOMIE [161],NuExo [162]和Exo-ViHa [163]到MILE,它们共同设计了机械异形的外骨骼和机器人手,并带有亚度联合误差,并显示指尖偏振动感知平均能提高25%的成功率[138]. DITTO将一对一的摩托式外骨骼图映射到一个动能等效的7-DoF手上,将手持式采集和双边远程操作与部队联合反馈统一起来[147];DITTO-X为Dagger式干预增加了反向远程操作[148]. 数据交换 Gen采取互补路线:预训的RL控制器执行低水平的手指运动,而操作员只提供高水平的意向[164].

blocks.en: Hand teleoperation for learning goes back to mixed-reality headset tracking with non-parametric imitation (Holo-Dex, six dexterous tasks learned within hours) [ 165 ] , single-RGB-camera imitators trained on internet hand video (Robotic Telekinesis) [ 166 ] , and DIME, which sidesteps unstable retargeting by fitting a per-user simulated hand to the operator and converting trajectories to different real hands afterwards [ 167 ] . For arms, kinematically matched leader devices such as GELLO proved more reliable and efficient than VR controllers or space mice [ 168 ] , and wearable arm exoskeletons showed that 3 minutes of teleoperation plus in-the-wild data can match more than 20 minutes of teleoperation alone [ 169 ] ; AirExo-2 adds visual and action adaptors that turn in-the-wild exoskeleton data into pseudo-robot demonstrations with 1.7 mm action error, on a US$600 platform [ 170 ] . Bidex extends ALOHA-style leader–follower setups to two dexterous hands on arms (more than 50 DoF in total) with mocap gloves and teacher arms, collecting better data faster than headset-based systems [ 129 ] ; modular mobile teleoperation interfaces [ 171 ] and whole-body humanoid systems with learned, tuning-free hand retargeting [ 172 ] broaden coverage. Kinesthetic hand-over-hand teaching is another route: KineDex transfers the operator’s finger motion directly to the hand with tactile signals, collects data more than twice as fast as teleoperation on two tasks and reaches 74.4% success on contact-rich tasks with force-controlled deployment [ 173 ] .
blocks.zh: 用于学习的手电传操作可追溯到使用非参数仿真(Holo-Dex,在数小时内学到的6个极致任务)的混合真实耳机跟踪[165],在互联网手电传视频(Robotic Telekinesis)[166]上训练的单RGB-相机仿真器[166],以及DIME,它通过给操作员安装一个每个用户模拟手,然后将轨迹转换到不同的真实手,从而避免不稳定的重定向[167]. 就武器而言,比起VR控制器或空间小鼠[168],诸如GELLO等运动匹配的领头装置被证明更加可靠和高效,可穿戴的臂外骨骼显示,3分钟的远程操作加全天候的数据可以单独匹配20多分钟的远程操作[169];AirExo-2增加了视觉和动作适配器,将全天候的Exkeleton数据转换为带有1.7毫米动作错误的伪机器人演示,在一个$600平台上[170]. Bidex将ALOHA式的领头人-跟随者设置扩展到两只手持摩顶手套和教师手臂(总共超过50个DoF),比基于耳机的系统收集得更快[129];模块化移动操作接口[171]和全身人造系统具有学习型,无调频手重定向[172]拓宽覆盖范围. KineDex用触觉信号将操作者的手指运动直接转移给手, 在两项任务上收集数据的速度是远程操作的两倍以上, 在部队控制的部署下接触量大的任务上成功率达到74.4%。

blocks.en: Teleoperation also underpins large multi-embodiment datasets such as RoboMIND [ 174 ] and AgiBot World (more than one million trajectories and 2,976 hours from 100 robots, some with six-DoF hands) [ 46 ] , and initial versions of industrial VLAs [ 33 ] . The common bottleneck is that throughput equals the number of robots times operating hours, collection is confined to labs or data factories, and operators do not touch the objects, so demonstrations lack human contact strategies.
blocks.zh: 远程操作还支撑了大型多表现数据集,如RoboMIND[174]和AgiBot World(超过100个机器人的100万轨迹和2,976小时,有些有6-DoF手)[46],以及工业VLA的初始版本[33]. 常见的瓶颈是吞吐量等于机器人运行时数的数量,收集仅限于实验室或数据工厂,操作员不接触物体,因此演示缺乏人类接触策略.

blocks.en: 4.2 Retargeting, haptics and shared autonomy
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 重新瞄准目标、不幸和共享自主权

blocks.en: Retargeting maps operator hand motion to robot joints in real time and is a hidden source of demonstration quality. A systematic ablation of the factors in retargeting objectives, together with a proposed combined objective, concludes that full reproduction of human motion is impossible because of mechanical differences [ 175 ] . Recent algorithms add structure: Kilohertz-Safe formulates retargeting as a convex quadratic program in joint-velocity space with linearized joint-limit and collision constraints and control barrier functions, achieving 9.05 ms average latency with more than 95% of frames meeting safety criteria on a 20-DoF hand [ 176 ] ; ResPilot learns a residual Gaussian-process correction on top of keypoint optimization from 24 calibration poses (about 4.5 minutes per operator), enlarging the reachable fingertip workspace enough to enable finger gaiting [ 177 ] ; EFOLD learns retargeting with deep RL, with command-following delay below 0.11 s [ 178 ] ; DexTwist recognizes tripod pinches and estimates the intended screw axis for twisting tasks [ 179 ] ; and offline pipelines add temporal consistency and contact maps for data generation [ 180 ] . Hardware-agnostic frameworks aim at “any arm, any hand, any input device” [ 181 , 152 ] .
blocks.zh: 重新瞄准操作员手动实时对机器人关节,是演示质量的隐藏来源. 在重新确定目标时,系统地消减各种因素,加上一个拟议的综合目标,得出的结论是,由于机械差异[175],人类运动不可能完全复制. 最近的算法增加了结构:Kilohertz-Safe在联合速度空间重新设定为对流四极程序,具有线化联合限制和碰撞约束以及控制屏障功能,在20-DoF手上达到安全标准的帧超过95%的平均潜伏度达到9.05毫秒[176];ResPilot从24个校准姿势(每名操作员约4.5分钟)的键位优化上学习到一个剩余的高斯式进程校正,将可到达的指尖工作空间扩大到足以使手指步[. ; EFOLD 学习用深RL重定向,指令跟随延迟低于0.11 s [178]; DexTwist 识别三脚架夹击并估计用于扭矩任务的预定螺旋轴 [179]; 离线管道为数据生成增加时间一致性和联系地图 [180]. 硬件不可知框架旨在“任何手臂、任何手、任何输入装置”[181、152]。

blocks.en: Feedback improves demonstrations, but the evidence base is small. Early gripper studies found that haptic feedback raised door-opening collection throughput by 6% and the success of resulting policies by about 11% [ 182 ] . On a dexterous hand, ViHaTeleop’s US$550 wrist-and-camera tracker with finger-wise vibrotactile feedback raised success by 2.2–15.6 percentage points across six contact-critical tasks with nine participants [ 183 ] . Richer feedback seems to matter: a capstan-driven glove rendering planar (two-axis) fingertip force reduced contact-force error compared with visual-only and single-axis feedback [ 184 ] , and a 32-DoF tactile fingertip display reduced the deviation between teleoperated and natural trajectories by 29–79%, compressing the state distribution of demonstrations in ways the authors link to better policy training [ 185 ] . Bilateral frameworks combine retargeting, multi-scale haptics, shared control and compliant arms [ 186 ] , and datasets collected with haptic teleoperation and fingertip touch are appearing [ 187 ] . No large- N N study yet links multi-finger haptic feedback to downstream policy performance.

blocks.en: Controlling 20+ DoF taxes operators, so control is increasingly shared. One system lets the human guide the arm in VR while an autonomous grasping VLA drives the fingers with tactile feedback, reaching 90% success including unseen objects [ 188 ] ; joint human–agent learning adjusts the control ratio while data are collected [ 189 ] . For corrections, abrupt takeovers cause “gesture jumps” in high-DoF hands; Hand-in-the-Loop blends human intent with policy execution, reducing intervention jitter by 99.8% and grasp failures by 87.5%, and policies trained on its corrections outperform those trained on standard teleoperation data by 19% [ 190 ] . These interfaces are the dexterous counterpart of DAgger-style intervention systems [ 148 , 191 ] .
blocks.zh: 控制20+DOF税收运营商,因此控制日益共享. 一个系统让人类在VR中引导手臂,而一个自主的抓住VLA则用触觉反馈驱动手指,成功率达到90%,包括隐形物体[188];在收集数据的同时,人类-代理人联合学习会调整控制比[189]. 就纠正而言,突然的收购导致高手的“年龄跳跃”;掌权者将人的意向与政策执行相结合,将干预焦虑率减少99.8%,抓住失败率增加87.5%;经过培训的纠正政策比接受标准远程操作数据培训者的业绩高出19%[190]。 这些接口是Dagger风格的干预系统[148,191]的直截了当的对应.

blocks.en: 4.3 Wearable, robot-free capture
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 可穿戴、无机器人捕获

blocks.en: In robot-free capture the human performs the task with their own hands while wearing hardware that makes the recording look like robot data, extending the handheld-gripper idea of UMI [ 192 ] to multi-fingered hands. This was the fastest-growing route in 2025–2026.
blocks.zh: 在无机器人捕捉中,人类用自己的手执行任务,同时佩戴使录音看起来像机器人数据的硬件,将UMI[192]的手持-gripper思想扩展到多指手. 这是2025–2026年增长最快的路线.

blocks.en: DexCap pioneered portable motion capture with a chest-mounted RGB-D and SLAM camera [ 44 ] . DexWild combines a glove, palm-mounted cameras mirrored on the robot, and single-camera wrist tracking; collectors gathered 9,290 demonstrations in 93 environments at 4.6 × \times teleoperation speed, and co-training at a robot-to-human ratio of 1:2 reached 68.5% success in unseen environments, about four times robot-only training [ 17 ] . DexViTac adds high-resolution touch and collects more than 248 demonstrations per hour [ 140 ] .
blocks.zh: DexCap率先采用胸架RGB-D和SLAM相机的便携式运动捕捉[44]. DexWild结合了手套,手掌挂相机镜照在机器人上,以及单相机手腕跟踪;采集者以4.6×x\时速在93个环境中聚集了9,290个演示,以1:2的机器人与人比进行协同训练,在隐形环境中取得了68.5%的成功,大约4倍于机器人的训练[17]. DexViTac增加了高分辨率触摸,每小时收集超过248次示威[140].

blocks.en: DexUMI constrains the human hand to the target hand’s workspace with a custom exoskeleton and removes the human hand from images by inpainting [ 15 ] . DEXOP’s “perioperation” paradigm mechanically links a passive hand exoskeleton to a passive robot hand, so the human directly drives the robot hand with natural force feedback; per task it was 2.4–8 × \times faster than teleoperation [ 16 ] . Wearable-first designs such as WHED [ 193 ] and DexEXO, which fits hand lengths of 140–217 mm without calibration and puts a passive demonstration hand in the wrist camera’s view so that no inpainting is needed [ 194 ] , focus on comfort and cross-operator use.
blocks.zh: DexUMI用定制的exoskeleton将人手限制在目标手的工作空间,并通过涂抹[15]将人手从图像中移除. DEXOP的“操作”范式在机械上将被动的手排骨与被动的机器人手联系起来,因此人类直接用自然力反馈驱动机器人手;每个任务比远程操作快2.4–8 ×\时间[16]. WHED[193]和DexEXO等可穿戴的第一设计,它们适合140-217毫米的手长而不校准,并将被动的演示手放在手腕相机的视野中,这样就不需要喷漆[194],专注于舒适和交叉操作的使用.

blocks.en: The most direct way to eliminate the gap is to collect with the very hand that will be deployed. RealDexUMI wears an 11-DoF (6 active) hand with in-hand camera and fingertip touch on the human hand, with a palm-side isomorphic glove; it reports 88.75% average success on eight tasks, falling to 70% without touch, and one checkpoint ran on three different arms [ 18 ] . DexPort [ 149 ] , DEX-PHD [ 195 ] , DEX-Mouse [ 142 ] and the co-designed Koala gripper [ 196 ] follow similar ideas. The trade-off is that the data are bound to one hand design.
blocks.zh: 消除这一差距的最直接办法是用将要部署的手来收集。 RealDexUMI穿着11-DoF(6 active)手持手相机和指尖触碰人手,手持棕榈侧异形手套;它报告在8项任务上平均成功88.75%,无触即跌至70%,1个检查站运行在3个不同的手臂上[18]. DexPort [149], DEX-PHD [195], DEX-Mouse [142] 和共同设计的科拉抓手 [196] 遵循了类似的想法. 权衡的是,数据与单手设计是绑定的.

blocks.en: Several programs operate at scale. XRZero-G0 replaces visual SLAM with VR tracking and closes a collect–check–train–evaluate loop with an 85% valid-data rate over more than 2,000 hours of collection [ 141 ] . World In Your Hands (WIYH) releases more than 1,000 hours with tactile signals and automatic annotation [ 139 ] . YUBI’s finger-aligned two-finger interface yields 8,434 hours and 1.2M episodes [ 143 ] . AdvDex/OmniShare uses a 29-encoder glove with Hall tactile arrays to collect more than 100k trajectories [ 146 ] . In industry, Sunday converts data from US$200 gloves whose geometry and sensors match its robot hand into robot data, and reports about ten million episodes from more than 2,000 contributors [ 150 , 25 ] ; Generalist collects with wearable pincer-style “data hands”, with press reports of growth from about 270k to more than 500k hours [ 23 , 24 ] ; Liber-0 uses a 131 g, 0.3 mm skin-colored glove with egocentric and two wrist cameras [ 35 ] ; and Genesis AI pairs a sensorized glove with a hand that mirrors it [ 197 ] . Collection-hardware product families are also appearing on the market [ 198 ] .
blocks.zh: 若干方案在规模上运作。 XRZero-G0 将视觉 SLAM 替换为 VR 跟踪, 关闭一个收集 - 检查 - 列车 - 评估循环 , 其有效数据率在2,000多小时的收集量中为 85% [141] 。 World In Your Hands(WIYH)发布超过1000小时的触觉信号和自动注释[139]. YUBI的指向双指界面输出8,434小时和1.2M集[143]. AdvDex/OmniShare使用带有Hall触觉阵列的29个编码手套来收集超过100k的轨迹[146]. 在工业中,星期天将200美元手套的数据转换为机器人数据,这些手套的几何和传感器与机器人的手相匹配,并报告2000多名贡献者约1 000万集[150,25];通用主义者收集可穿戴的披针手式“数据手”,新闻报道显示生长时间从270k小时左右增至500k小时以上[23,24];Liber-0使用一个131g,0.3mm的皮肤彩色手套,并配有利己心和两台手腕相机[35];创世纪AI将一个感官手套配对,并配有一只手照[197]。 收藏-硬件产品家族也在市场上出现[198].

blocks.en: 4.4 Egocentric human video
blocks.zh: 4.4 爱果中心人类视频

blocks.en: Egocentric data record humans performing everyday tasks with head-mounted cameras, glasses or headsets; actions are recovered from estimated 3D hand poses. General-purpose corpora such as Ego4D [ 199 ] , Ego-Exo4D [ 200 ] and HOT3D [ 201 ] provide limited hand annotation. EgoDex (829 h, 194 tasks) records native 3D hand and finger tracking from Apple Vision Pro and is the most hand-relevant public dataset [ 19 ] . Headset-based human data have also been co-trained directly with humanoid data [ 202 ] , and Figure pretrains on egocentric video collected in real homes [ 203 ] . Multi-institution platforms such as EgoVerse aggregate more than 1,300 hours [ 204 ] . At the pretraining scale, EgoScale uses 20,854 hours of action-annotated egocentric video [ 20 ] , UniHand-2.0 more than 35,000 hours across humans and 30 robots [ 21 ] , and DreamDojo about 44k hours for world modeling [ 22 ] . Meta’s Aria Gen 2 glasses provide on-device hand, head and eye tracking for researchers [ 205 ] . Egocentric data also serve as language-grounded pretraining for the high-level “brain”: PhysBrain converts egocentric video into large-scale VQA supervision [ 206 ] .
blocks.zh: 爱高中心数据记录人类用头架摄像机,眼镜或耳机执行日常任务;动作从估计的3D手姿势中恢复. Ego4D[199],Ego-Exo4D[200]和HOT3D[201]等通用蝎子提供了有限的手注音. EgoDex(829 h,194任务)记录了来自Apple Vision Pro的本地3D手和手指跟踪,是最与手相关的公共数据集[19]. 基于人头的人类数据也直接与人形数据[202] 和在真实家庭收集的以自我为中心的视频上的图预录[203] 进行了共同培训. EgoVerse等多机构平台累计1300多小时[204]. 在预训规模上,EgoScale使用20,854小时的动作附加说明的自我中心视频[20],UniHand-2.0超过35,000小时跨人和30个机器人[21],DreamDojo大约44k小时用于世界建模[22]. Meta的Aria Gen 2眼镜为研究人员提供了安装上的手,头和眼睛跟踪[205]. Egocentral数据也作为高层次"大脑"的基于语言的预训: PhysBrain将自我中心视频转换成大规模VQA监听[206].

blocks.en: Converting egocentric video into robot data involves five steps: (1) hand reconstruction (native headset tracking, gloves, or monocular MANO estimation [ 207 , 208 ] combined with camera SLAM); (2) retargeting the wrist pose and fingertips with joint-limit and collision constraints [ 209 , 210 , 52 ] ; (3) visual alignment by masking or inpainting the human hand and rendering the robot [ 211 , 51 ] ; (4) physical correction in simulation [ 212 , 49 ] ; and (5) co-training with paired and robot data. Geometric plausibility does not imply dynamic feasibility: in EgoEngine’s ablation, training directly on human video gave 0.03 success, adding an action branch 0.43, and the full pipeline 0.51 [ 212 ] . 2026 data engines therefore emphasize contact-aware and object-centric conversion from a single egocentric clip, followed by simulated RL and real deployment: EgoAERO checks the physical usability of a reconstruction online and decides at capture time whether to keep, repair or re-record [ 213 ] ; EgoMatrix [ 214 ] , EgoCPT [ 215 ] and HandMimicX [ 216 ] treat human motion as a spatial prior and search for robot-native contacts; DexRoam captures whole-body egocentric data without external tracking [ 217 ] ; and Human2Dex separates human semantics from embodiment-specific execution [ 218 ] .
blocks.zh: 将以自我为中心的视频转换成机器人数据涉及五个步骤:(1)手部重建(内置耳机跟踪,手套,或单视MANO估计[207,208]与相机SLAM结合);(2)将手腕姿势和指尖重新定位为具有联动限制和碰撞约束[209,210,52];(3)通过遮盖或涂抹人手,使机器人[211,51]];(4)模拟中的物理修正[212,49];以及(5)与配对和机器人数据进行协同训练. 在EgoEngine的发音中, 直接使用人体视频的训练取得了0.03成功, 增加了一个动作分支0.43, 以及整个管道0.51 [212]. 2026数据引擎因此强调接触感知和以物体为中心的转换, EgoAERO在线检查重建的物理可用性,并在捕获时决定是否保存,修复或重新记录[213];EgoMatrix [214],EgoCPT [215]和HandMimicX [216]将人类运动作为空间前置,并搜索机器人-内置接触;DexRoam在没有外部跟踪的情况下捕捉全身自负中心数据[217];Human2Dex将人类语义学与化身特定执行[218]区分开来.

blocks.en: 4.5 Simulation, generation and automation
blocks.zh: 4.5 模拟、生成和自动化

blocks.en: Simulation multiplies scarce real demonstrations: DexMimicGen generates large numbers of bimanual dexterous trajectories from a few human demonstrations [ 221 ] . Human-to-simulation-to-robot pipelines make human demonstrations physically feasible [ 222 , 223 , 224 , 49 ] , and video generation and editing replace the human hand with a robot hand in pixels [ 212 , 225 ] . Fully automatic real-world collection is emerging for structured tasks: AutoDex runs unattended grasp collection with perception, execution, annotation and reset, at 4.8 × \times teleoperation throughput [ 144 ] . Kinesthetic teaching with high-dimensional touch is another source of contact-rich labels [ 226 ] . We view these sources as amplifiers of real contact data rather than replacements.
blocks.zh: 模拟乘以稀少的真实演示:DexMimicGen从几场人类演示中产生大量的双人解脱轨迹[221]. 人对模拟-机器人管道使人体演示在物理上可行[222,223,224,49],视频生成和编辑将人手替换为像素中的机器人手[212,225]. 完全自动现实世界收藏正在出现,用于结构化的任务: AutoDex以4.8 ×\times 远程操作吞吐量 [144] 运行未注意的抓取集,带有感知,执行,注释和重置. 具有高维触觉的金美学教学是接触丰富的标签的另一个来源[226]. 我们认为这些来源是真实联系数据的放大器,而不是替代。

blocks.en: 4.6 What the scaling evidence says
blocks.zh: 4.6 国家 缩放证据说

blocks.en: Several 2025–2026 results allow tentative conclusions about how data sources should be combined.
blocks.zh: 2025-2026年的若干成果允许就如何合并数据来源作出初步结论。

blocks.en: 1. Human data scale log-linearly, but need a bridge. EgoScale reports a log-linear relation between hours of egocentric human data and validation loss, and task completion rising from 0.30 to 0.71 as human pretraining grows from 1k to 20k hours; a two-stage recipe (human pretraining, then mid-training on about 50 hours of aligned human data and 4 hours of robot data) improved average success by 54% over no pretraining and transferred to a three-finger hand [ 20 ] . 2. Measured hand motion beats raw video volume. Under identical post-training, Liber-0 reports that 10k hours of glove data outperform 2M hours of web human video on both pick-and-place and non-pick-and-place tasks; glove data plus 25% of the robot demonstrations surpassed 100% robot demonstrations (75.6 vs. 72.8 progress score); and glove data taught skills absent from robot data (non-pick-and-place progress rising from 2.2 to 47.5) [ 35 ] . These are blog-reported results without public code. 3. Diversity of collectors and environments matters. With a fixed number of glove demonstrations, increasing the number of collectors from 1 to 100 raised glove-only performance from 12.7 to 40.1 [ 35 ] ; DexWild finds similar benefits from environment diversity [ 17 ] . 4. Robot data remain the anchor. DexWild finds that a 1:5 robot-to-human ratio is worse than 1:2 [ 17 ] ; UniDex reports near-zero success without any robot data and that about two human demonstrations are worth one robot demonstration [ 51 ] . Physical Intelligence finds that human-to-robot transfer emerges as the robot-data diversity of VLA pretraining grows [ 227 ] . 5. Human-likeness of the robot amplifies human data. Liber-0’s robot, with a three-DoF human-like wrist and human-aligned chest and wrist cameras, outperformed a conventional arm by 28.3 points on average given the same glove data [ 35 ] .

DexWild finds that a 1:5 robot-to-human ratio is worse than 1:2 [ 17 ] ; UniDex reports near-zero success without any robot data and that about two human demonstrations are worth one robot demonstration [ 51 ] . Physical Intelligence finds that human-to-robot transfer emerges as the robot-data diversity of VLA pretraining grows [ 227 ] .
blocks.zh: 机器人数据仍是主播. DexWild发现1:5的机器人与人的比例比1:2 [17]更差;UniDex在没有任何机器人数据的情况下报告近乎零的成功,大约两次人类演示都值得一次机器人演示[51]. 物质 智能发现,随着VLA预训的机器人数据多样性增长[227],人对机器人的转移出现.

blocks.en: Human-likeness of the robot amplifies human data. Liber-0’s robot, with a three-DoF human-like wrist and human-aligned chest and wrist cameras, outperformed a conventional arm by 28.3 points on average given the same glove data [ 35 ] .

Their effects cannot be pooled, and none identifies a universally optimal source mix across hands. A useful follow-up would vary one factor while holding target embodiment, total training compute, collector diversity and test objects fixed.

blocks.en: 4.7 Tactile data
blocks.zh: 4.7 Tactile 数据

blocks.en: Tactile data were long described as the largest gap, and 2026 saw rapid growth. TouchScale releases 500 hours (about 87k episodes) of bimanual full-palm tactile glove data synchronized with egocentric and wrist video; it reports that visuo-tactile mid-training raised real success on four contact tasks from 22.5% to 57.5% and that zero-shot contact prediction on an unseen tactile sensor improved from 0.134 to 0.383 IoU [ 47 ] . Human-centric tactile pretraining corpora reach 160 hours [ 220 ] ; T-Rex collects 100 hours of tactile teleoperation [ 219 ] ; TactiDex aligns full-hand touch with kinematics and object state for 700+ sequences [ 228 ] ; and ART-Glove explores articulated tactile gloves that preserve human dexterity [ 229 ] . A 0.38 IoU on an unseen sensor is far from direct reuse; using the same tactile sensor at collection and deployment [ 15 , 18 ] remains the safest choice.
blocks.zh: Tactile数据被长期描述为最大差距,2026年出现了快速增长. 触摸 缩放500小时(约87k集)的双拍全拍触控手套数据与以自我为中心的和手腕的视频同步;它报告说,对接触控中试将四项接触任务的实际成功率从22.5%提高到57.5%,对一个隐形触控传感器的零镜头接触预测从0.134提高到0.383 IoU[47]. 以人类为中心的触觉前训练蝎子达到160小时[220];T-Rex收集了100小时触觉电传操作[219];TactiDex将全手触觉与动能和物体状态配合700+序列[228];ART-Glove探索清晰的触觉手套,以保持人类的机能[229]. 一个隐形传感器上的0.38 IoU远非直接再利用;在收集和部署时使用同样的触觉传感器[15,18]仍然是最安全的选择.

blocks.en: 4.8 Processing toolchain
blocks.zh: 4.8 处理工具链

blocks.en: Turning raw recordings into training data requires a chain of tools whose errors accumulate. Hand pose comes from native headset tracking (Vision Pro in EgoDex [ 19 ] ; on-device hand, head and eye tracking on research glasses [ 205 ] ), from gloves (electromagnetic gloves output a 25-node skeleton and fingertip positions without optical occlusion [ 230 ] ), or from monocular estimation of MANO parameters [ 207 , 208 ] , whose translation drifts and is usually corrected by dynamic-scene reconstruction and camera SLAM. Retargeting ranges from vector-optimization methods in the DexPilot tradition [ 40 , 152 ] to learned and calibration-free retargeters [ 209 , 210 ] , fingertip IK with a virtual floating base and iterative correction for coupled joints [ 51 ] , and topology-preserving methods that handle penetration for downstream RL [ 52 ] . Physical repair reconstructs the scene, corrects contacts with optimization or RL in simulation and renders robot observations [ 212 , 214 , 215 , 213 , 49 ] . The trend is from “copying the human hand” to “using the human hand as a prior and searching for robot-native contacts”. Synchronization of cameras, gloves, touch and wrist trackers must be at the millisecond level; AdvDex reports microsecond-level synchronization of a 29-encoder glove, Hall-effect touch and multi-view cameras [ 146 ] . Electromagnetic gloves lose accuracy near motors and metal and need on-site calibration.
blocks.zh: 将原始录音转化为培训数据需要一系列工具,其错误会累积。 手姿来自原生耳机跟踪(Vision Pro in EgoDex [19];研究眼镜上的手,头和眼睛跟踪[205]),手套(电磁手套输出一个25节骨架和指尖位置而不光学闭塞[230]),或对MANO参数的单体估计[207,208],其翻译漂移,通常通过动态场景重建与相机SLAM进行校正. 重新瞄准范围从DexPilot传统中的矢量优化方法[40,152],到学习和校准的无矢量重定向器[209,210],指尖IK具有虚拟浮基和偶联关节的迭代校正[51],以及处理下游RL渗透的地形保存方法[52]. 物理修复重建场景,在模拟中用优化或RL纠正接触,使机器人观测[212,214,215,213,49]. 趋势是从“复制人手”到“使用人手作为先验和搜索机器人-本地接触”。 相机,手套,触摸器和手腕跟踪器的同步必须处于毫秒级; AdvDex 报告29倍码手套,霍尔效应触摸器和多视相机的微秒同步[146]. 电磁手套失去靠近马达和金属的精度,需要现场校准.

blocks.en: 4.9 Collection hardware and the data industry
blocks.zh: 4.9 收集硬件和数据行业

blocks.en: Collection hardware spans three orders of magnitude. Research electromagnetic gloves cost roughly US$5k–6.3k per pair, and around US$7.5k–9.7k with haptic feedback, with lead times of weeks [ 230 ] ; a force-feedback glove with palm haptics launched at US$5,999 [ 235 ] ; research glasses with on-device tracking are distributed by application [ 205 ] ; at the low end, hardware-matched gloves sell for about US$200 [ 25 ] , and open designs have BOMs below US$500 for a tactile-feedback glove [ 159 ] and below US$150 for a handheld interface [ 142 ] .
blocks.zh: 收藏硬件跨越三个数量级. 研究电磁手套每对大约耗资5k-6.3k美元,7.5k-9.7k美元左右,有随机反馈,周期为[230]周;用手掌电磁筒发射的强力后卫手套为5,999 [235]美元;用探测器跟踪的研究眼镜通过应用分配[205];在低端,与硬件匹配的手套售价约为200 [25]美元,而开放式设计则有一个触摸式后卫手套的BOM低于500美元[159],手持接口的BOM低于150美元[142]。

blocks.en: In China, data collection is becoming an industry. Large teleoperation data centers produce standardized multi-embodiment datasets [ 46 ] ; tactile-sensor companies operate clusters of collection “factories” and a data cloud marketplace that advertises high-DoF human-hand data with six-axis touch [ 102 , 103 ] ; robot-free collection product families are sold through retail channels and paired with million-hour collection plans [ 198 ] ; companies pursuing human data report exoskeleton tactile gloves with in-the-wild pipelines and targets of a million hours [ 236 , 237 ] ; and the first embodied-intelligence dataset, containing video, joint angles and torques, was listed and traded on a provincial data exchange in January 2026 [ 238 ] . Estimates of the supply–demand gap vary widely: one provincial data bureau put compliant real-interaction data in China at about 500k hours against a commercial need of tens of millions [ 239 ] . Public research institutes advocate classification, grading and de-identification at the source and authorization, notarization and traceability at sharing time for industrial manipulation data [ 240 ] .
blocks.zh: 在中国,数据收集正在成为一个行业。 大型远程操作数据中心制作标准化的多表现数据集[46];触觉传感器公司运营集集集收集“要素”和一个数据云市场,广告高DoF人手数据,六轴触摸[102,103];无机器人采集产品家庭通过零售渠道销售,配以百万小时采集计划[198];追求人类数据的公司报告外奥斯凯莱顿触觉手套,装有百万小时的输油管和目标[236,237];首个包含视频,联合角度和拖拉机的内涵智能数据集于2026年1月上市并在省级数据交换台交易[238]. 对供需差距的估计差异很大:一个省级数据局以500k小时左右的速度在中国提供符合要求的实时交互数据,而商业需求则高达数千万[239]。 公共研究机构主张在源头进行分类、分级和去识别,并在分享工业操纵数据时授权、公证和可追踪性[240]。

blocks.en: 4.10 Quality, cost and governance
blocks.zh: 4.10 质量、成本和治理

blocks.en: As volumes grow, deciding what to keep sets the policy ceiling. Demo-SCORE trains a quality classifier from policy rollouts [ 241 ] ; DemInf scores demonstrations by state–action mutual information [ 242 ] ; SCIZOR removes suboptimal and redundant state–action pairs [ 243 ] ; influence functions estimate each trajectory’s contribution [ 244 ] ; and smoothness metrics provide zero-training filters [ 245 ] . A systematic evaluation cautions that metrics that detect bad demonstrations do not necessarily yield better policies, so curation should be judged by downstream policy performance [ 233 ] . In practice, online quality checks at capture time [ 213 , 141 ] keep bad data out of the corpus.
blocks.zh: 随着数量的增长,决定如何维持政策上限。 Demo-SCORE从政策推出中培训一个质量分类器 [241]; DemInf通过州-行动相互信息来评分演示 [242]; SCIZOR去除次优和冗余的州-行动对 [243]; 影响函数估计每个轨迹的贡献 [244]; 平滑度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度度值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值值 系统评价提醒人们,发现不良表现的衡量标准不一定能产生更好的政策,因此,应当通过下游政策业绩来判断监管情况[233]。 在实际操作中,捕捉时间的在线质量检查[213,141]将不良数据排除在官司之外.

blocks.en: Industry estimates for China put real-robot teleoperation at roughly CNY 500–1,000 per hour, egocentric capture at CNY 100–200 per hour, and UMI-style capture at US$0.6–1.2 per episode [ 246 ] ; these are order-of-magnitude figures from secondary sources. A crowdsourced egocentric-video gig economy has emerged, with pay from about US$1 to US$15 per hour depending on region and payment typically per accepted hour [ 247 , 248 ] .
blocks.zh: 中国的工业估计,实际机器人远程操作大约为每小时500-1 000美元,以自我为中心的捕获量为每小时100-200美元,UMI式的捕获量为每集0.6-1.2美元[246];这些都是二级来源的数值。 出现了以自我为中心、以影视为主的经济,每小时的工资从大约1美元到15美元不等,这取决于地区和通常每个接受小时的工资[247,248]。

blocks.en: China’s first quality standard for embodied-intelligence datasets, with eight quality dimensions (completeness, consistency, diversity, authenticity, usability, utility, extensibility and security), took effect on 1 November 2026 [ 234 ] , and an ISO work item on humanoid robot datasets was approved in 2026 [ 249 ] . Home egocentric video exposes interiors and habits even without faces; reports document collectors who are unsure how their data are stored or shared [ 247 , 248 ] . Informed consent, de-identification and deletion procedures should be designed in from the start, both for ethical reasons and to keep data tradable and reusable.
blocks.zh: 中国首个包含有8个质量维度(完整性,一致性,多样性,真实性,可用性,实用性,可扩展性和安全性)的内含智能数据集质量标准于2026年11月1日生效[234],国际标准化组织关于人造机器人数据集的工作项目于2026年获得批准[249]. 以家庭自我为中心的视频甚至不露面也暴露了内部和习惯;报告无法确定数据是如何存储或共享的文档收集者[247,248]. 从一开始就应设计出知情同意、消除识别和删除程序,既是出于道德原因,也是为了保持数据的可交易性和可重复使用性。

blocks.en: Takeaway. Several systems support a pyramid recipe: large-scale egocentric pretraining, tens of hours of paired human–robot mid-training, and a small amount of target-robot teleoperation for post-training. What decides success is less the capture device than kinematic, visual and tactile alignment between human and robot, and the quality-control pipeline.
blocks.zh: 外卖 一些系统支持一种金字塔式的配方:大规模自我中心预训、数十小时的双人机器人中训,以及少量用于培训后的目标机器人远程操作。 决定成功的原因,是捕捉装置比人类和机器人之间的运动、视觉和触觉协调以及质量控制管道要少。

blocks.en: 5 Human Hands as a Data Source
blocks.zh: 5 人手作为数据源

blocks.en: Because human data now dominate dexterous pretraining ( Section 4 ), the computer-vision infrastructure for perceiving human hands has become part of the robot-learning stack. This section reviews hand and hand–object perception, the human interaction datasets that underpin conversion pipelines, and the lineage of methods that learn robot dexterity from human video.
blocks.zh: 由于现在人类数据主导了狡猾的预训(第4节),透视人类手的计算机视觉基础设施已经成为机器人学习堆栈的一部分. 本节回顾了手和手对对象的感知,支撑转换管道的人类交互数据集,以及从人类视频中学习机器人解脱性的方法的线性.

blocks.en: 5.1 Perceiving human hands
blocks.zh: 5.1 观察人类的手

blocks.en: Parametric hand models, chiefly MANO [ 207 ] , provide the common output space. Early monocular systems such as FrankMocap regressed hand and body motion jointly at about 9.5 fps [ 250 ] ; transformer-based reconstruction (HaMeR [ 208 ] ) and WiLoR, which couples a real-time fully convolutional hand localizer with transformer reconstruction trained on more than 2M in-the-wild images and yields smooth tracking without temporal modules [ 251 ] , are today’s default front ends.
blocks.zh: 参数手型,主要是MANO [207],提供常见的输出空间. 早期的单体系统,如Frank Mocap在大约9.5英尺 [250] 时, 手和身体运动相继倒退; 变压器基于重建(HaMeR [208])和WiLOR, 将一个全革命性的手力本地化器与在超过2M 的浑浊图像上训练的变压器重建相配, 并产生平滑的跟踪, 没有时间模块 [251], 是今天的默认前端.

blocks.en: Egocentric videos involve a moving camera, so per-frame camera-space poses must be lifted to a world frame to serve as wrist actions. HaWoR separates camera-space hand motion from the camera trajectory using adaptive egocentric SLAM and infills frames where hands leave the view [ 252 ] ; Dyn-HaMR recovers 4D global motion of interacting hands from dynamic-camera video by multi-stage optimization with an interacting-hand prior [ 253 ] . Low-cost ground truth is obtained with back-mounted multi-camera rigs combined with headset cameras [ 254 ] . World-frame tracking accuracy is, in our assessment, the main perception bottleneck for turning egocentric video into actions.
blocks.zh: 爱果中心视频涉及移动的相机,因此每帧相机空间的姿势必须提升到世界框架,作为腕动. HaWOR将相机-空间手动与相机轨迹区分开来,使用适应性自我中心式的SLAM和填充框,使手离开视野[252];Dyn-HAMR通过多阶段优化手前的交互[253],从动态相机视频中恢复了交互手的4D全球运动. 低成本的地面真相是通过背架的多摄像机钻机与耳机相机相结合而获得的 [254]. 据我们评估,世界范围的追踪准确性是把以自我为中心的录像变成行动的主要瓶颈。

blocks.en: Robot conversion needs the object as well as the hand. HOLD reconstructs articulated hands and unknown objects from monocular interaction video without 3D annotations [ 255 ] ; MagicHOI uses novel-view diffusion priors to supervise unseen object regions in short clips [ 256 ] ; and G-HOP learns a category-conditioned diffusion prior over hand–object interaction from seven datasets spanning 155 categories, usable for both reconstruction and grasp synthesis [ 257 ] . Contact supervision comes from thermal imaging (ContactDB, 3,750 contact maps over 50 objects [ 258 ] ; ContactPose, 2,306 grasps from 50 participants [ 259 ] ) and from dense vertex-level contact estimators that address the strong imbalance between contact and non-contact regions [ 260 ] . These contact signals are exactly what contact-anchored retargeting needs ( Section 6.1 ), yet they are still rarely used in robot pipelines.
blocks.zh: 机器人转换需要对象和手. HOLD从单体交互视频中重建拼接的手和未知对象,没有3D注释[255]; MagicHOI使用新视觉传播前科,在短片中监督未见对象区域[256];和G-HOP在手前学习一个类条件传播 - 从七套数据中学习对象交互,跨越155个类别,既可用于重建又可用于把握合成[257]. 接触监督来自热成像(ContactDB,3,750张50个物体的接触地图[258];ContactPose,2,306张来自50名参与者[259])和密集的顶点级接触估计器,它们解决接触和非接触区域之间的强烈不平衡[260]. 这些接触信号正是接触-焦虑的重新定位需要(第6.1节),但是它们仍然很少用于机器人管道.

blocks.en: 5.2 Hand–object interaction datasets
blocks.zh: 5.2 手-对象交互数据集

blocks.en: Table 9 summarizes human hand–object datasets used for retargeting and pretraining. Classic datasets are small in object count and duration but precise: FPHA introduced first-person RGB-D with magnetic-sensor hand poses [ 261 ] ; HO-3D annotated 77,558 frames markerlessly [ 262 ] ; DexYCB benchmarks grasping of YCB objects and human-to-robot handover [ 263 ] ; GRAB captures whole-body grasping with contact [ 264 ] . Category-level and bimanual datasets followed: H2O [ 265 ] , HOI4D with 2.4M egocentric frames over 800 object instances [ 266 ] , OakInk with affordance-aware interactions over 1,800 objects [ 267 ] , OakInk2 [ 268 ] , ARCTIC [ 269 ] , TACO for bimanual tool use [ 270 ] , Assembly101 with 18M 3D hand poses over 4,321 procedural videos [ 271 ] , HOT3D [ 201 ] , GigaHands [ 272 ] and HOGraspNet, which labels the full grasp taxonomy and contact maps over 1.5M frames from 99 participants [ 273 ] . Recent work moves to in-the-wild scenes, including outdoors [ 274 ] . Several of these are the raw material of robot-data conversion: UniDex builds its 8-hand corpus from H2O, HOI4D, HOT3D and TACO [ 51 ] , and DexMachina and contact-anchored retargeting start from captured human–object interaction [ 224 , 232 ] . Compared with the tens of thousands of hours of robot-oriented egocentric data ( Figure 5 ), however, precisely annotated HOI data remain orders of magnitude smaller.
blocks.zh: 表9概述了用于重新瞄准和预训的人体手-物体数据集。 经典数据集在对象计数和持续时间上都很小,但精确:FPHA引入了第一人称RGB-D,磁传感器手举 [261];HO-3D无标记地标注了77,558帧 [262];DexYCB基准抓住YCB物体和人对机器人交接 [263];GRAB捕获全身抓住接触 [264]. 分类级别和双人数据集如下:H2O [265],HOI4D带2.4M自我中心框架800多个物体实例[266],OakInk带承受力-意识相互作用1 800个物体[267],OakInk2 [268],ARCTIC [269],TACO用于双人工具[270],Assembly101 配有18M 3D手持4 321个程序视频[271],HOT3D [201],GigaHands [272]和HOGraspNet,它们标注了99 [273]的全把握分类图和1.5M帧上的接触图。 近期的作品移动到包括户外在内的全景[274]. 其中一些是机器人数据转换的原材料: UniDex从H2O,HOI4D,HOT3D和TACO[51],以及DexMachina和接触-受干扰的重定向开始从捕获的人类-对象相互作用[224,232]开始,构建了它的8手体. 然而,与数以万计小时的面向机器人的自我中心数据(图5)相比,精确附加说明的HOI数据仍然较小。
