blocks.en: 5.3 Learning robot dexterity from human video
blocks.zh: 5.3 从人类视频中学习机器人的功能

blocks.en: The idea of learning dexterity from human video predates the foundation-model era, and its evolution explains today’s designs. DexMV recorded human videos of the same tasks as a multi-finger simulation, extracted 3D hand–object poses and converted them into robot demonstrations that solved tasks RL alone could not [ 275 ] ; VideoDex used visual, action and physical priors from internet hand-use video to guide an arm–hand system [ 276 ] ; and MimicPlay learned latent plans from human play data to condition low-level robot policies [ 277 ] . Two families have since emerged.
blocks.zh: 从人类视频中学习节制的想法在奠基时代之前就已经存在,其演变解释了今天的设计. DexMV录制了与多指模仿真相同的人类视频,提取了3D手 - 对象的姿势,并将其转换成机器人演示,单独解决任务RL无法[275]; Video Dex使用网络手动视频的视觉、动作和物理前科指导手动系统[276];MimicPlay从人类游戏数据中吸取了潜伏计划,以规范低级机器人政策[277]。 此后出现了两个家庭。

blocks.en: ViViDex uses reconstructed human trajectories as reward guidance for RL and distills state policies into point-cloud policies [ 278 ] ; HOP pretrains a hand–object interaction policy from video for later fine-tuning [ 279 ] ; DexH2R learns a residual policy on top of retargeted human motion and reports a 40% gain over prior state of the art across settings, without teleoperation [ 280 ] ; VIDEOMANIP reconstructs hand–object trajectories from monocular RGB without capture devices, reaching 62.86% average real success over seven LEAP Hand tasks, outperforming retargeting-based baselines by 15.87% [ 281 ] ; and X-Sim builds a photorealistic simulation from RGB-D human video, trains RL with object-centric rewards and matches behavior cloning with 10 × \times less collection time [ 282 ] . Embodiment-agnostic intermediate representations avoid joint-level correspondence altogether: Motion Tracks predicts 2D tracks lifted to 6D as a shared human–robot action space, reaching 86.5% average success over four real tasks with a gripper-type end effector [ 283 ] ; Dexterous Point Policy predicts 3D object and hand keypoints autoregressively from human video and reports 75.0% real success where a VLA baseline achieves 1.0% [ 284 ] . The Motion Tracks result uses a gripper-type end effector, so it is evidence for an intermediate representation rather than a direct multi-fingered-hand result.
blocks.zh: ViViDex将重建的人类轨迹作为RL的奖励指南,并将国家政策提炼成点云政策[278];HOP预留了视频中的手-对象交互政策,用于以后的微调[279];DexH2R在重新定向的人类运动之上学习了剩余政策,并报告超过之前各种场合的艺术水平的40%,没有远程操作[280];VIDEOMANIP从单一的RGB中重建手-对象的轨迹,没有捕获设备,超过7个LEAP手任务的平均实际成功率达到62.86%,比基于重定向的基线高15.87%[281];X-Sim从RGB-D人类视频中构建了一种摄影现实模拟,用以对象为中心的奖励来训练RL,并将行为克隆比10xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx Embodiment-agnostic 中间表示完全避免了联合级别的对应: Motion Tracks预测2D轨道被提升到6D作为一个共享的人类-机器人动作空间,在4项真正任务上平均成功达到86.5%,并带有抓取式终端效应器[283]; Dexterous Point 预测3D对象和手键点自动从人类视频中递归,以及报告75.0%的实际成功率,而VLA基线达到1.0%[284]. Motion Tracks结果使用抓取式终端效应器,因此它是中间表示法的证据,而不是直接的多手指结果.

blocks.en: Phantom estimates hand pose, inpaints the human arm and overlays a rendered robot, enabling zero-shot policies without robot data with up to 92% success on deformable-object, sweeping and insertion tasks [ 285 ] ; Masquerade edits 675k egocentric frames into bimanual robot views to pretrain visual encoders, gaining 5–6 × \times over baselines with log-scaling in edited data [ 286 ] . These are precursors of the generative “robot try-on” methods discussed in Section 6.1 [ 212 , 225 ] .
blocks.zh: Phantom估计手摆姿势,涂抹人体手臂,并覆盖一个制成的机器人,使得零射政策没有机器人数据,在可变形对象,扫瞄和插入任务上取得高达92%的成功[285];Masquerade将675k个自我中心框架编辑成双人机器人视图,以预演视觉编码器,在基线上获得5–6×x=时间,在编辑的数据中进行日志缩放[286]. 这些是第6.1节[212,225]所讨论的基因“机器人试验”方法的前体。

blocks.en: Research glasses with on-device hand tracking simplify capture: EgoZero trains gripper policies (on a Franka arm) from about 20 minutes of glasses data per task with 70% zero-shot success [ 287 ] , and AINA extends this to multi-fingered hands with no robot data, simulation or RL across nine everyday tasks [ 288 ] . EgoVLA predicts wrist and hand actions from egocentric video and fine-tunes on a few robot demonstrations [ 289 ] ; web-video skill policies for gripper robots cover open, close, pour, cut and stir families zero-shot [ 290 ] ; and co-training human video with robot data nearly doubles performance on generalization settings present only in human data, but only once pretraining is sufficiently diverse [ 291 , 227 ] .
blocks.zh: 带有探测器手迹追踪的研究眼镜简化捕获: EgoZero从每件任务约20分钟的眼镜数据中(在Franka臂上)训练抓手政策,70%的零射门成功[287],AINA将这一点延伸至没有机器人数据的多指手,模拟或RL跨越9个日常任务[288]. EgoVLA预测手腕动作来自以自我为中心的视频,并对一些机器人演示进行微调[289];针对抓手机器人的网络视频技能政策覆盖开放,关闭,倒灌,切剪和搅动家庭的零镜头[290];与机器人数据共同训练的人类视频在仅存在于人类数据中的归纳设置上的性能几乎翻了一番,但只有一次预训足够多样化[291,227].

blocks.en: Generative models of hand–object interaction provide priors and augmentation: text-to-HOI generation via contact maps [ 292 ] , two-stage grasp-then-manipulate diffusion [ 293 ] , hand synthesis from object trajectories [ 294 ] , and FlowHOI, which generates hand poses, object poses and contact states from egocentric observations and language with flow matching and executes them on real dexterous robots [ 295 ] . Closing the loop from such generators to robot execution remains rare.
blocks.zh: 手-对象相互作用的基因模型提供了前兆和增强:通过联系地图[292]生成文本到HOI,两阶段的抓取-当时的操纵扩散[293],从物体轨迹的手合成[294],以及FlowHOI,它从以自我为中心的观察和语言中产生手姿,物体的姿势和接触状态,与流匹配,并在真正的离心机器人上执行[295]. 关闭从这种发电机到机器人执行的循环仍然很少。

blocks.en: Takeaway. Human-hand perception has become robot infrastructure. The weakest links are world-frame hand tracking in egocentric video, object reconstruction from short clips and the scarcity of contact labels. Methods split between lifting to 3D (then retargeting, RL or keypoint policies) and editing pixels; the former gives control over physics, the latter over appearance, and the strongest recent systems combine both.
blocks.zh: 外卖 人手感知已经成为机器人基础设施. 最薄弱的链接是在以自我为中心的视频中进行世界范围手迹追踪,从短片中重建物体以及缺少接触标签. 方法分为升至3D(当时是重定向,RL或键点政策)和编辑像素;前者赋予物理控制,后者赋予外观,最强的近代系统两者结合.

blocks.en: 6 Layer 3: Cross-Embodiment Transfer
blocks.zh: 6 层 3: 交叉 转让

blocks.en: Two gaps overlap in dexterous manipulation. The human-to-robot gap separates a human hand with about 27 DoF, compliant skin and full-hand touch from robot hands with 6–24 active DoF, rigid links and different proportions; human video does not directly provide executable actions, the hand looks different in images, and contact points do not correspond. The robot-to-robot gap arises because hands differ in finger count (three to five), DoF, coupling, joint ordering, thumb design and actuation, so action vectors do not share dimension or meaning. Both are compounded by differences in camera and tactile configuration, dynamics, and timing. Being-H0.5, for instance, introduces a dedicated asynchronous chunking scheme because embodiments with different latencies and control rates otherwise produce jittery chunk transitions [ 21 ] . Solutions operate at three levels—data, representation and model ( Table 10 )—and practical systems combine them.
blocks.zh: 两个漏洞在狡猾的操纵上重叠. 人对机器人间隙将人手与约27 DOF分开,与6–24活跃的DOF,刚性链接和不同比例的机器人手相适应的皮肤和全手触摸;人视频不直接提供可执行动作,画面中的手看起来不同,接触点也不对应. 机器人对机器人间隙的产生是因为手在手指计数(3-5),DoF,耦合,关节订购,拇指设计和激活方面不同,所以动作矢量并不共享维度或意义. 相机和触觉配置、动态和时间方面的差异使两者更为复杂。 例如,Being-H0.5引入了一个专门的同步块化方案,因为有不同延迟和控制率的化身,否则会产生紧张的块化过渡[21]。 解决办法在三个层面运作——数据、代表性和模式(表10),而实际系统则将它们结合起来。

blocks.en: Figure 7: From human observations to target-hand actions: a conceptual synthesis of reconstruction, representation, physics grounding and adaptation [ 20 , 51 , 49 , 232 ] . The lower row identifies the failure each stage must diagnose. Not every method implements every stage, and physics replay is a feasibility test under a model rather than proof of real-world safety.
blocks.zh: 图 7:从人类观测到目标行动:重建、表现、物理定位和适应的概念综合[20、51、49、232]。 下行识别每个阶段必须诊断的失败. 并不是每个方法都执行每个阶段,物理重播是在模型下的可行性测试,而不是真实世界安全的证据.

blocks.en: Figure 7 separates four transformations that are often conflated under “retargeting”. Preserving a wrist trajectory, reproducing an image and maintaining stable object contact are different objectives. A useful comparison must specify which objective is optimized and which constraints are tested on the target embodiment.
blocks.zh: 图7将四个常常在“重新瞄准”下组合的转变分开。 保持手腕轨迹,复制图像并保持稳定的物体接触是不同的目标. 必须进行有益的比较,说明哪些目标得到优化,哪些限制在目标体现上得到检验。

blocks.en: 6.1 Data level: making human data executable
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 数据级别: 使人类数据可执行

blocks.en: Retargeting maps human keypoints or glove joint angles to robot joints and underlies almost every pipeline. The classic approach optimizes fingertip and keypoint vectors [ 40 , 152 ] ; GeoRT learns an unsupervised neural retargeter running at 1 kHz [ 209 ] ; AnyDexRT needs no calibration [ 210 ] ; and CrossDex approximates retargeting with a network to speed up RL [ 48 ] . EgoScale found joint-space retargeted actions to be a better pretraining representation than wrist-only or fingertip-only actions [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 将人类的指针或手套合角重新定位到机器人关节上,并成为几乎所有管道的基础。 经典方法优化了指尖和键点矢量[40,152];GeoRT学习了一个运行在1千赫[209]的无监督神经重定向器;AnyDexRT不需要校准[210];以及CrossDex大约用网络重定向以加速RL[48]. EgoScale发现,联合空间重定目标动作比只手腕或只指尖动作更好的预训表现[20].

blocks.en: The 2026 trend is contact- and physics-preserving retargeting. TopoRetarget builds a hand–object interaction mesh and solves a Laplacian optimization, reducing contact error to 7.71 mm and raising downstream RL pen-spinning success from 46.9% to 87.5% [ 52 ] . SPIDER uses sampling-based optimization in parallel physics simulation with curriculum-style virtual contact guidance to turn kinematic human demonstrations into dynamically feasible trajectories for nine embodiments and releases thousands of simulated demonstrations [ 49 ] . OmniHOI reconstructs hand–object interaction from monocular video and transfers it to five hands of 6–22 DoF with 39–89% success, versus at most 31% for prior transfer methods [ 53 ] . Contact-anchored retargeting argues that what survives the human-to-robot mapping is the contact structure (which finger segment touches which part of the object, in what order) rather than joint motion; refining the human hand in simulation, retargeting to hand-agnostic contact anchors and learning a residual policy raised single-hand success from 7.3% to 59.3% across 25,454 trajectories and transferred one human dataset to four hands [ 232 ] . ManipTrans [ 222 ] and Human2Sim2Robot [ 223 ] use residual learning or RL in simulation to the same end.
blocks.zh: 2026年的趋势是接触和物理保持重定向. TopoRetarget构建了手-对象交互网格,并解决了Laplacian优化,将接触误差降低到7.71毫米,并将下游RL笔击成功率从46.9%提高到87.5% [52]. 天基信息平台在平行物理模拟中采用以抽样为基础的优化方法,并采用课程式虚拟接触指导,将动能人类演示转化为9个浮雕的动态可行轨迹,并释放数千个模拟演示[49]。 欧尼 HOI从单视视频中重建手 - 对象交互,并将它转移到6–22 DOF的5个手,成功率为39–89%,而之前的传输方法最多为31 % [53] 。 接触者重新定位认为,人类对机器人的绘图所幸存的是接触结构(指段触及物体的哪一部分,顺序如何),而不是联合运动;在模拟中精炼人类的手,重新瞄准手不可知接触锚,学习残余政策,使25 454个轨道上的单手成功率从7.3%提高到59.3%,并将一个人类数据集转移到四手[232]。 马尼普Trans [222] 和 Human2Sim2 Robot [223] 在模拟到同一目的时使用剩余学习或RL.

blocks.en: UniDex converts H2O, HOI4D, HOT3D and TACO into about 52k trajectories for eight hands (6–24 DoF), removing the human hand and rendering the robot hand into point clouds [ 51 ] . Do as I Do [ 296 ] , DexCast [ 309 ] , Dex-X [ 310 ] and DexStitch [ 297 ] reconstruct interactions from everyday video, the latter segmenting long videos into composable skills. Generative methods close the visual gap: EgoEngine generates robot-embodied observation videos with feasible action trajectories and reports a zero-shot deployable dexterous visuomotor policy trained without real robot demonstrations [ 212 ] ; RoboTryOn frames the conversion as virtual try-on, translating keyframes to a target robot and labeling actions with an inverse dynamics model [ 225 ] . Generated pixels can, however, depict grasps that the robot cannot physically form, so feasibility checks remain necessary.
blocks.zh: UniDex将H2O,HOI4D,HOT3D和TACO转换成约52k的轨距,用于8只手(6–24 DOF),移除人手,使机器人手成为点云[51]. 照我做 [296], DexCast [309], Dex-X [310] 和 DexStitch [297] 从日常视频中重建互动, 后一种将长视频分割成可调和的技能. 遗传方法缩小视觉差距: EgoEngine生成具有可行动作轨迹的机器人健壮观察视频,并报告在没有真正机器人演示的情况下训练的零射可部署的dexterous visuomotor政策[212];RoboTryOn将转换设定为虚拟尝试,将键框翻译为目标机器人,并用反向动态模型标注动作[225]. 然而,生成的像素可以描绘机器人无法物理形态的把握,因此可行性检查仍然是必要的.

blocks.en: HRDexDB records humans and multiple robot hands grasping the same 100 objects with 3D reconstructions and success labels [ 311 ] , a rare resource for studying human-to-robot contact transfer. Paired robot-to-robot data for the same tasks remain scarce.
blocks.zh: HRDexDB记录人类和多个机器人手抓住相同的100个物体,并带有3D重建与成功标签[311],这是研究人对机器人接触转移的罕见资源. 用于同样任务的Paired机器人对机器人数据仍然很少。

blocks.en: 6.2 Representation level: a common language for hands
blocks.zh: 6.2 代表级别:手语通用

blocks.en: Joints with the same function share a dimension, and missing joints are masked. UniDex’s FAAS uses 82 dimensions (18 for wrists, 64 for joints, of which 21 base slots are shared across hands) [ 51 ] ; DexFormer uses a 20-D canonical finger space aligned by anatomical role and infers morphology from history rather than an embodiment ID [ 298 ] ; Being-H0.5 maps 30 robots and the human MANO hand into semantically aligned slots, treating the human hand as one more embodiment [ 21 ] ; AcrossDEX shares the wrist representation and distinguishes fingers with embodiment fields and validity masks [ 299 ] . A sphere-based unified hand action space with cascaded IK reports zero-shot transfer to unseen hands for in-hand reorientation [ 312 ] .
blocks.zh: 具有相同功能的关节具有一个维度,缺失的关节被遮掩. UniDex的FAAS使用82维(腕部18个,关节64个,其中21个基位位跨手共享)[51];DexFormer使用一个由解剖作用对齐的20-D犬形手指空间,推断出来自历史的形态,而不是一个浮雕的ID[298];Being-H0.5地图将30个机器人和人类的MANO手插入成星形对齐的插槽,将人类的手再当作一个浮雕[21];CrossDEX共用腕部代表,并将手指与浮雕场和有效性面具区分[299]. 基于球体的统一手动空间,带有级联的IK报告零射转动到看不见的手进行手动重定向[312].

blocks.en: One Hand to Rule Them All parses any URDF into a canonical hand (up to five fingers and 22 DoF) and learns a 16-D morphology latent from 65,536 synthetic hands; a policy conditioned on it grasps with an unseen three-finger hand at 81.9% success in simulation [ 302 ] . DexGrasp-Zero aligns graph-network policies to shared mechanical semantics and, trained on four hands, reaches 85% zero-shot grasping on two unseen hands in simulation and 82% on three real platforms [ 303 ] ; this is among the strongest real zero-shot results between multi-fingered hands, albeit limited to grasping. The D(R,O) representation encodes grasps as robot–object distance matrices [ 313 ] .
blocks.zh: 一手决定他们 将任何URDF分解为犬类手(最多5个手指和22个DoF),并从65,536个合成手中学习出一种16D的形态学潜伏;其政策条件为它以81.9%的模拟成功率抓住一个看不见的三指手[302]. DexGrasp-Zero将图网络政策对应于共享机械语义,经过四手训练,在模拟中达到85%的无镜头抓住两只看不见的手,在3个真实平台上达到82%[303];这是多手指手之间最强的实拍零镜头结果之一,虽然仅限于抓取. D(R,O)的表示编码为机器人-对象距离矩阵 [313] 。

blocks.en: CrossDex outputs human eigengrasp weights that are then retargeted to each robot [ 48 ] ; DexWM uses MANO keypoint displacements as actions and even builds virtual keypoints for parallel grippers [ 308 ] .
blocks.zh: CrossDex输出人类eigengrasp重量,然后重新瞄准每个机器人[48];DexWM使用MANO键位移作为动作,甚至为平行抓取器构建虚拟键位[308].

blocks.en: The wrist’s relative pose change is the most easily shared part of an action. GR00T N1.7 adopts a relative end-effector (EEF) action space shared between humans and robots and attributes much of its cross-embodiment performance to it [ 314 ] ; Being-H0 reaches a similar conclusion [ 301 ] . π 0.7 \pi_{0.7} , in contrast, reports in supplementary experiments no clear benefit of EEF control for cross-embodiment transfer and uses joint space [ 28 ] . The embodiment sets differ, so the results need not conflict, but the choice of action space remains open.
blocks.zh: 手腕的相对姿势变化是最容易分享的动作部分. GR00T N1.7采用了人类和机器人之间共享的相对最终效应器(EEF)动作空间,并将它的许多交叉化性能归属于它[314];Being-H0得出类似的结论[301]. 0.7\pi_{0.7],相比之下,补充实验中的报告并没有明显的EEF控制交叉化转移和使用联合空间[28]. 其表现形式不同,因此结果不需要冲突,但行动空间的选择仍然开放。

blocks.en:
Motion alone does not transfer contact. “Transferring Contact, Not Just Motion” pairs a glove motion latent with calibrated joint torques to derive fingertip force descriptors, enabling compliant grasping across hands even when vision is masked [ 304 ] .

For touch, UniTacHand projects glove and robot tactile signals onto the UV map of the MANO surface, a morphology-consistent 2D canvas, and reports zero-shot tactile policy transfer from human to robot with 10 minutes of paired data [ 231 ] . TactAlign aligns human glove and robot touch with rectified flow without paired data, achieving zero-shot light-bulb screwing; removing alignment drops average success to 28% [ 50 ] . AnyTouch learns sensor-agnostic visuo-tactile features [ 315 ] . GOTT is object-centric: given robot-agnostic object trajectories, a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive establishes stable contact and a pose-conditioned controller tracks the object [ 305 ] .
blocks.zh:
单是动议不能转移联系人。 “转移接触,而不只是移动”将手套运动与校准的关节扭矩成对,以得出指尖力描述符,即使在视力蒙蔽的情况下,也能在手掌之间实现一致的把握[304]。

对于触摸,UniTacHand将手套和机器人触觉信号投射到MANO表面的紫外线地图上,一个形态学与2D相容的画布,并报告零射触觉政策从人到机器人的转移,并配对数据10分钟[231]. TactAlign将人类手套和机器人触摸与没有对齐数据的修正流进行对齐,实现零射光泡螺旋;去除对齐平均成功率降至28%[50]. Any Touch 学习感官-不可知的粘着-激活特性 [315]. GOTT以物体为中心:给定机器人不可知物体轨迹,单一的交叉化接触-获取原始建立稳定的接触,并设置一个姿势控制器跟踪物体[305].

blocks.en: Latent actions learned from consecutive frames act as pseudo-labels for unlabeled video, with embodiment-specific input and output layers re-initialized at post-training [ 316 , 22 ] . OPFA learns geometry-aware action latents with a unified decoder across 11 end-effectors; joint training improves success by more than 50%, and about eight demonstrations on a new embodiment approach the result of 72 [ 306 ] . Gemini Robotics 1.5’s Motion Transfer shares one VLA across ALOHA, bimanual Franka and a humanoid without explicit action alignment [ 317 ] .
blocks.zh: 从连续帧中学习到的Latent动作作为无标签视频的伪标签,在训练后重新初始化了特异性输入和输出层[316,22]. OPFA学习几何感知行动潜伏,在11个终端效应器上统一编解码器;联合培训成功率提高了50%以上,在72 [306] 的结果下,大约8次关于新的化身方法的演示。 双子机器人 1.5 的运动转移在ALOHA、双子弗兰卡和人形上共享一个VLA,

blocks.en: 6.3 Model level: one model, many hands
blocks.zh: 6.3 模型级别:一个模型,许多手

blocks.en: The dominant pattern is a shared VLM backbone with an action expert (flow matching or diffusion) and lightweight embodiment-specific state encoders and action heads, as in EgoScale’s GR00T-style model [ 20 , 29 ] , UniDex-VLA (point-cloud encoder on a π 0 \pi_{0} backbone; 81% average progress on tool use versus 38% for π 0 \pi_{0} ) [ 51 , 26 ] and GR00T N1.7 [ 300 ] . Being-H0.5 separates shared motion primitives from embodiment experts with a mixture-of-flow head to reduce negative transfer between embodiments [ 21 ] . World-action models absorb unlabeled data and reduce dependence on a unified action space: LDA-1B assigns data roles by quality (clean trajectories train the policy, noisy ones only dynamics, unlabeled human video only visual prediction) and was evaluated on hands of 10 and 22 DoF [ 307 ] ; DreamZero adapts to a new robot with 30 minutes of play data and gains more than 42% on unseen tasks from 10–20 minutes of human or other-robot video [ 31 ] . Morphology-randomized RL in simulation trains one policy across hundreds of hands [ 298 , 302 ] . Finally, hierarchical systems keep the cross-embodiment “what and where” in the large model and leave embodiment-specific high-frequency contact control to a dedicated layer ( Section 8.6 ).
blocks.zh: 主流模式是共享的VLM主干线,拥有动作专家(流量匹配或扩散)和轻量级的浮雕特有状态编码器和动作头,如EgoScale的GR00T型模式[20,29],UniDex-VLA(主干线上的点-云编码器;工具使用的平均进度为81%,而零\pi_{0})[51,26]和GR00T N1.7[300]. Being-H0.5将共享运动原始物与流头混合的浮雕专家分离,以减少浮雕之间的负转移[21]. 世界动作模型吸收无标签的数据,减少对统一动作空间的依赖:LDA-1B通过质量来分配数据角色(干净的轨迹训练政策,只有噪音的轨迹,没有标签的人类视频只进行视觉预测),并在10和22 DOF[307]的手上得到评价; Dream 0适应30分钟播放数据的新机器人,从10–20分钟的人机或其他机器人视频[31]获得超过42%的隐形任务. 妄想症 模拟中的RL训练一项政策跨越数百人手[298,302]. 最后,分级系统将大型模型中的交叉化“什么和在哪里”保留起来,将具体化的多频接触控制留给一个专门层(第8.6节)。

blocks.zh: 6.4 (中文(简体) ). 决策指南

blocks.en: Takeaway. The mainstream recipe is “human data as the main ingredient, a unified or alignable hand action space, large-model pretraining, and a small amount of target-hand data”. Adaptation cost dropped from hours to minutes or a handful of demonstrations in 2026, but most zero-shot evidence is between grippers and arms; zero-shot transfer between multi-fingered hands is convincing mainly for grasping. Contact and touch are the next transfer anchor.
blocks.zh: 外卖 主流的食谱是“人类数据作为主要成分、统一或可调合的手动空间、大型模型预训和少量目标手数据”。 适应成本在2026年从数小时降至数分钟或几场示威,但大多数零镜头证据介于抓手和手臂之间;多手指手之间的零镜头传输主要可以令人信服于抓手. 接触和触摸是下一个转移锚.

blocks.en: 7 Touch Across the Stack
blocks.zh: 7 触摸横跨堆积

blocks.en: Touch appears in every layer of our taxonomy: as sensor hardware (L1), as a data modality (L2), as a transfer anchor (L3) and as a policy input (L4). Because it is widely regarded as the decisive missing ingredient for contact-rich dexterity, and because the 2024–2026 literature on it grew very quickly, we devote a cross-cutting section to it. A companion review organizes tactile robot learning by the functional role of touch [ 320 ] ; here we focus on what matters for multi-fingered hands.
blocks.zh: 触摸出现在我们分类学的每个层:作为传感器硬件(L1),作为数据模式(L2),作为传输锚(L3),作为政策投入(L4). 因为它被广泛认为是接触力丰富的弹性的决定性的缺失成分,并且由于2024–2026年有关它的文献发展得非常快,所以我们专门用一个交叉的章节来讨论它. 一个伴奏评论组织触摸机器人通过触摸[320]的功能作用来学习;在这里,我们侧重于多指手的要紧之处.

blocks.en: 7.1 Sensors for hands
blocks.zh: 7.1 手感应器

blocks.en: Camera-based sensors image the deformation of an elastomer and offer the highest spatial resolution. DIGIT made such sensors compact and cheap enough to mount on multi-fingered hands and was used for in-hand marble manipulation [ 321 ] ; Digit 360 is a multimodal fingertip with about 8.3M taxels, 7 μ \mu m spatial features, about 1 mN normal and shear force resolution, and sensing of vibration up to 10 kHz, heat and odor [ 322 ] ; 9DTact reconstructs 3D shape and regresses 6D force without markers, trained on about 100k image–force pairs [ 323 ] . Their drawbacks for hands are size, curvature constraints, bandwidth and the cost of covering more than the fingertips.
blocks.zh: 基于相机的传感器描绘一个弹性体的变形,并提供最高的空间分辨率。 DIGIT使这种传感器紧凑而廉价,可以挂在多指手脚上,用于手提大理石操纵[321];Digit 360是一个多式指尖,有大约8.3M的分类,7 μ \ mu m 的空间特征,大约1 mN 的正常和剪力分辨率,并感知到高达10千赫兹的振动,热和气味[322];9DTact重建3D形状和退缩6D力,没有标记,训练了大约100k 图像-力对[323]. 它们对于手的缺点是尺寸,曲率限制,带宽和覆盖超过指尖的费用.

blocks.en: Magnetic skins separate electronics from a replaceable passive elastomer. ReSkin introduced this design with learning that is robust to batch variation [ 324 ] ; AnySkin made it plug-and-play and reported the first uncalibrated sensor whose learned policies generalize across sensor instances [ 325 ] ; eFlesh 3D-prints magnetic cut-cell microstructures in arbitrary convex shapes for under US$5 in magnets, with 0.5 mm localization error, 95% slip detection on unseen objects and a 40% gain of visuo-tactile over vision-only policies [ 326 ] . Piezoresistive skins dominate mass-produced humanoid hands for cost reasons [ 327 ] , and Hall-effect arrays provide dense coverage at moderate cost [ 102 ] .
blocks.zh: 磁性皮肤将电子与可替换的被动弹性体分离。 ReSkin引入了这种具有强力的学习能力的设计,以进行批量变异[324]; AnySkin使其进行了插值和播放,并报告了第一个未校准的传感器,其学习到的政策在传感器中通用[325];eFlesh 3D-印刷磁切细胞微结构在磁铁中为5美元以下的任意对流形状,磁铁中出现0.5毫米局部化误差,在隐形物体上发现95%的滑动现象,并获得了40%的粘着电动优于视政策[326]。 由于成本原因,Piezoresisitive皮肤主导了大量生产的人造手[327],霍尔效应阵列以中等成本提供密集覆盖[102].

blocks.en: F-TAC Hand embeds high-resolution sensing (0.1 mm) over 70% of the hand surface; in 600 real trials its tactile-equipped system significantly outperformed non-tactile alternatives [ 328 ] . Pretrained encoders now exist for skins distributed over fingertips, phalanges and palm (Sparsh-skin, on an Allegro Hand with magnetic sensors), improving over prior work by more than 41% [ 329 ] . Industry has moved in the same direction ( Section 3.5 ), and investment in tactile sensor companies surged in 2025–2026 [ 134 ] .
blocks.zh: F-TAC (法语) 手嵌高分辨率感应(0.1毫米)于手表面的70%以上;在600次实际试验中,其触觉设备系统明显超过非触觉替代品[328]. 对分布在指尖、针头和棕榈上的皮肤(Sparsh-skin,在具有磁感应器的Allegro Hand上),现在已有预先训练的编码器,比以前的工作提高了41%以上[329]。 工业朝同一方向发展(第3.5节),2025-2026年对触觉传感器公司的投资激增[134].

blocks.en: The evidence is split. Dense binary contact over palm, links and fingertips suffices for blind in-hand rotation with zero-shot transfer [ 330 ] , while other work pushes resolution to millions of taxels [ 322 ] or 0.1 mm skin [ 328 ] . A plausible resolution is task dependence: coarse, wide coverage for grasp stability and reorientation, and high resolution for slip, texture and sub-millimeter insertion.
blocks.zh: 诸证分明. 手掌上的深色二进制接触,连结和指尖足以以零射转动进行盲眼手动旋转[330],而其他工作则将分辨率推向数百万个分类物[322]或0.1毫米皮肤[328]. 一种可行的解决办法是任务依赖性:粗糙、覆盖范围广泛,以掌握稳定性和调整方向,以及高分辨率的滑动、纹理和次毫米插入。

blocks.en: 7.2 Simulating touch
blocks.zh: 第7.2条 模拟触摸

blocks.en: Four strategies compete. Rendered optical simulation reproduces vision-based sensor images: TACTO renders at hundreds of frames per second and supported grasp-stability learning on one million simulated grasps [ 331 ] ; Taxim calibrates an example-based GelSight model from fewer than 100 examples [ 332 ] ; and TacSL renders visuotactile images and force fields in Isaac more than 200 × \times faster than prior work, with an asymmetric actor–critic distillation scheme for sim-to-real [ 333 ] . Physics-based simulators model the elastomer: DiffTactile is differentiable and handles elastic, elastoplastic and cable-like objects [ 334 ] , and Taccel parallelizes incremental-potential contact to run 18 × \times faster than real time across thousands of environments [ 335 ] . Virtual touch computes contact signals from kinematics and motor currents instead of rendering sensor images, which enabled zero-shot force-based grasping and reorientation [ 336 , 337 ] . Finally, some work avoids tactile simulation altogether : PTLD collects real data with privileged sensors and distills a tactile state estimator, improving an in-hand rotation benchmark by 182% over a proprioception-only policy [ 338 ] . Results remain sobering for hands: a tactile-only LEAP Hand grasping policy trained via real-to-sim calibration and RL achieved 27% real success over 20 objects [ 339 ] . Unified simulated tactile interfaces across 12 hands [ 340 ] are a step towards comparable evaluation, but their authors explicitly do not assume simulated touch can replace real touch.
blocks.zh: 四种策略竞争. 渲染光学模拟复制基于视觉的传感器图像: TACTO以每秒数百帧的速度使100万个模拟抓取器上支持的把握性学习 [331]; 出租车校准一个以实例为基础的GelSight模型,从不到100个实例 [332]; TacSL使艾萨克的成像和力场比以前的工作更快200xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 基于物理的模拟器模型 弹性体: diffTactile是不同的,它处理弹性,弹性和有线状物体[334],Taccel将增量-潜在接触平行,在数千个环境中运行18×\时速比实时快[335]. 虚拟触摸计算来自动能和运动电流的接触信号,而不是渲染传感器图像,这使得零射力的抓取和重定向[336,337]成为可能. 最后,一些工作完全避免了触觉模拟: PTLD用特权感应器收集真实数据,并提炼出一个触觉状态估计器,比单自旋政策提高182%的手动旋转基准[338]. 对手来说,结果仍然是清醒的:只有触觉的LEAP 通过真实到图像校准训练的手握策略和RL在20个物体上取得了27%的实际成功[339]. 跨越12只手的统一模拟触觉接口[340]是向可比评价迈出的一步,但其作者明确认为模拟触觉不能取代真实触觉.

blocks.en: 7.3 Tactile representations and foundation models
blocks.zh: 7.3 Tactile 说明和基础模型

blocks.en: Tactile representation learning followed the trajectory of vision, one step behind. Paired in-the-wild visuo-tactile data collected by humans enabled the first self-supervised visuo-tactile features [ 341 ] . UniTouch aligned touch embeddings with pretrained image embeddings, and thereby with language and sound, using sensor-specific tokens [ 342 ] . T3 introduced a shared trunk with sensor-specific encoders, pretrained on over 3M samples from 13 sensors, and improved sub-millimeter multi-pin insertion by 25% over training from scratch and 53% over policies without touch [ 343 ] . Sparsh pretrained self-supervised encoders on more than 460k tactile images and outperformed task- and sensor-specific models by 95.1% on average on the six-task TacBench [ 344 ] ; Sparsh-X extended this to image, audio, motion and pressure from Digit 360 and raised policy success by 63% [ 345 ] . At policy scale, FTP-1 pretrains on about 3,000 hours from 21 sensors and reports gains over baselines of 17.2% on seen and 31% on two unseen sensor setups [ 346 ] . Full-hand benchmarks pair egocentric vision with millions of tactile frames over hundreds of tasks [ 347 ] . Together with canonical surface representations [ 231 ] and unpaired alignment [ 50 , 315 ] ( Section 6.2 ), these results suggest that cross-sensor transfer is feasible but far from solved.
blocks.zh: Tactile 代表学习遵循了视觉的轨迹,落后了一步. 人类收集的Paired in-the-wild visuo-actile数据使得第一个自我监督的粘着物特征[341]. UniTouch对齐的触摸嵌入式,带有预先训练的图像嵌入式,因此也带有语言和声音,使用传感器特有的符号[342]. T3引入了带有传感器专用编码器的共享树干,在13个传感器的3M以上样本上进行了预训,并改进了从零开始培训的分毫米多管插入率25%,在不接触的政策上53%[343]。 Sparsh在超过460k的触觉图像上预先训练了自我监督的编码器,并在六任务Tac Bench [344] 上平均比任务和传感器特定模型多出95.1%;Sparsh-X将其扩展至来自Digit 360的图像,音频,运动和压力,使政策成功率提高了63% [345]. 在政策规模上,从21个传感器开始的约3 000小时的FTP-1预摄,并报告在所见的基线上增加17.2%,在两个看不见的传感器装置上增加31%[346]。 全手基准将自我中心愿景与成百上千个任务上的触摸框配对 [347]. 这些结果加上犬形表面表示[231]和未发火的对齐[50,315](第6.2节),表明交叉传感器转移是可行的,但远未解决.

blocks.en: 7.4 Touch in perception and control
blocks.zh: 7.4 触摸感知和控制

blocks.en: The most mature use of touch is perception. NeuralFeels fuses vision and touch on a multi-fingered hand to reconstruct and track objects online with neural fields, reaching 4.7 mm average pose drift and up to 94% better tracking than vision alone under heavy occlusion [ 348 ] .
blocks.zh: 触觉最成熟的用途是知觉. 神经感应引信的视觉和触摸多指手,以便用神经场在线重建和跟踪物体,平均可达4.7毫米的漂移量,在重隐蔽下,比单视的跟踪率高达94% [348].

blocks.en: Touch enables multi-axis and orientation-invariant in-hand rotation [ 349 , 350 , 351 , 330 ] . In imitation learning, 3D-ViTac fuses dense flexible tactile pads (3 mm 2 per unit) with vision in a 3D representation and outperforms vision-only diffusion policies on fragile and in-hand tasks [ 352 ] ; Reactive Diffusion Policy pairs a slow latent diffusion policy with a fast tactile tokenizer for high-rate closed-loop control [ 353 ] . The slow–fast split , also found in T-Rex [ 219 ] and in industrial contact layers ( Section 8.6 ), recurs because high-rate touch disrupts slow pretrained models.
blocks.zh: 触摸可以使多轴和定向偏振的手动旋转[349,350,351,330]. 在仿真学习中,3D-ViTac将具有3D代表器中视觉的密集柔性触控垫(每台3毫米2)引信,并在脆弱和手头任务上超越了唯视传播政策[352]; Reactive Difusion Policy 配对了一种缓潜扩散政策,并配以快速触控信号器用于高速闭路控制[353]. T-Rex [219] 和工业接触层(第8.6节)中也发现的缓慢-快速分裂,由于高率触摸干扰了慢的前期训练模型,故复发.

blocks.en: Vision–tactile–language–action models multiplied in 2025–2026. VTLA fine-tunes with preference optimization for fingertip insertion and exceeds 90% on unseen pegs [ 354 ] ; Tactile-VLA combines touch with hybrid position–force control and argues that VLM priors already encode physical semantics [ 355 ] ; ForceVLA fuses six-axis force through a mixture of experts and gains 23.2% over π 0 \pi_{0} -based baselines on contact-rich tasks [ 356 ] ; OmniVTLA’s dual-path tactile encoder reaches 100% pick-and-place success on dexterous hands (+6.2% over the baseline) with a 135k-sample tri-modal dataset [ 357 ] ; TacVLA activates tactile tokens only on contact, reporting a 60% improvement over baselines on in-box picking (the summarized source does not specify whether this is relative or percentage-point improvement) and 2.1 × \times robustness under occlusion [ 358 ] ; and UniTacVLA predicts future touch inside the VLA with a tactile chain of thought [ 359 ] . Two recent models target dexterous scale: STAR pretrains on about 200 hours of bimanual data (69.5% of tasks multi-fingered) and reaches 61% on four real tasks with 100 post-training trajectories each [ 360 ] , and N0-VTLA pretrains latent tactile tokens at scale and adds advantage-conditioned offline RL, reaching 63.8% on a 20-task simulation suite versus 44.0% for the strongest baseline [ 361 ] . Hierarchical tactile systems add tactile sub-goals, residual refiners and tactile world models [ 362 ] .
blocks.zh: 愿景-tactile-language-action models 在2025–2026年翻倍. VTLA精细调整指尖插入的偏好优化,在隐形钉上超过90%;Tactile-VLA将触摸与混合位置-力控结合,并主张VLM前身已经编码物理语义[355];ForceVLA通过专家混合而导出六轴力,增益23.2%大于XXX0\pi\\0}-基于接触量任务的基线[356];OmniVTLA的双路径触控编码器在脱氧手上达到100%的接触和定位成功率(比基线高6.2%),而一个135k-sample三模式数据集[357];TacVLA激活触觉信号,仅在接触上,报告比盒中选取的基线改善60%(汇总来源没有具体说明这是相对的还是百分比的改进)和2.1xxxx时间在隔离[358];以及UnTacVLA预测未来触觉链中的触觉[359]。 近期的两个模型都瞄准了Dexterous规模:STAR预留了大约200小时的双人数据(69.5%的任务多指),并在四个真正的任务上达到61%,每个任务有100个训练后轨迹[360];N0-VTLA预留了规模的潜伏触觉符,并增加了优势条件的离线RL,在20任务模拟套件上达到63.8%,而最强基线的则达到44.0%[361]. 等级触觉系统增加触觉子目标,残余精炼器和触觉世界模型[362].

blocks.en: Human tactile demonstrations scale: UVTA records images, touch and hand motion with tactile motion capture and predicts both future actions and touch, reaching 70% average success versus 29% for the strongest visuo-tactile baseline, with no saturation up to 1,000 human demonstrations per task [ 363 ] . Injecting glove touch into a video diffusion transformer reduces underestimation of hand motion in egocentric prediction from 23% to 9%, and helps even when touch is absent at inference [ 364 ] . Handheld UMI-style devices with fingertip touch report corpora above 10k hours, though with gripper-like end effectors [ 365 ] .
blocks.zh: 人体触觉演示尺度:UVTA记录图像,触觉和手动与触觉运动的捕捉和预测未来动作和触觉,相对于最强的触觉活动基线,平均成功率达到70%,29%,每个任务不会饱和到1000人的演示[363]. 在自我中心预测中将手动率从23%降至9%, 手持UMI型设备,指尖触摸报告蝎子在10k小时以上,虽然带有像抓手一样的终端效应器[365].

blocks.en: Table 12: Tactile representation and policy models with cross-sensor or dexterous evidence (as reported).
blocks.zh: 表12:具有跨传感器或直截了当证据(如所报告)的毒性表述和政策模式。

blocks.en: Takeaway. Touch has moved from sensor papers to pretrained encoders and tactile VLAs, but three obstacles remain: sensor heterogeneity (cross-sensor gains are real but partial), tactile simulation fidelity (sim-to-real touch for hands is still weak), and thin evidence on 20+-DoF hands, since most tactile VLAs are validated on insertion or gripper tasks. Slow–fast designs and contact-gated tactile tokens are the recurring architectural answer.
blocks.zh: 外卖 触摸从感应纸转移到了预先训练的编码器和触觉VLA,但仍有三个障碍:感应异质性(交叉感应增益是真实的但部分的),触觉模拟忠心性(手部的感应到真实的触觉仍然很弱),20+-DoF手部的薄证据,因为大多数触觉VLA都是在插入或抓取任务上验证的. 慢速设计和触觉符号是反复出现的建筑学答案。

blocks.en: 8 Layer 4: Learning and Foundation Models
blocks.zh: 8 第4层:学习和基础模式

blocks.en: 8.1 Simulation infrastructure
blocks.zh: 8.1 模拟基础设施

blocks.en: GPU-parallel simulation made large-scale RL for hands practical. Isaac Gym keeps physics and policy training on one GPU and reports a speed-up of two to three orders of magnitude over CPU-simulation pipelines [ 366 ] ; Orbit turned it into a modular framework with reusable robots, sensors and actuators [ 367 ] ; and Isaac Lab, its successor, adds GPU rendering, actuator and sensor models, data collection and domain randomization, with application areas including whole-body control, manipulation and learning from human demonstrations [ 368 ] . The JAX lineage offers an open alternative: Brax provides massively parallel differentiable rigid-body simulation [ 369 ] , and MuJoCo Playground trains sim-to-real policies in minutes on a single GPU [ 370 ] . The SAPIEN/ManiSkill line scales object diversity, with ManiSkill2 providing 20 task families, more than 2,000 objects and over 4M demonstration frames [ 371 , 372 ] , while RoboVerse wraps multiple simulators behind one interface [ 373 ] . Two gaps remain. First, none of these platforms benchmarks contact fidelity for dexterous hands directly, and tendon-driven or underactuated hands with sheath friction and joint coupling are hard to model; learned actuator models, introduced for legged robots [ 374 ] , and joint-wise neural dynamics [ 375 ] partly compensate. Second, tactile simulation lags behind rigid-body simulation ( Section 8.8 ).
blocks.zh: GPU-并行模拟使得手的大规模RL实用. Isaac Gym持续进行一个GPU的物理和政策培训,并报告在CPU模拟管上加速2到3个数量级[366]; Orbit将其转化为一个模块框架,其中可重复使用的机器人,传感器和激活器[367];其继任者Isaac Lab增加了GPU渲染,激活器和传感器模型,数据收集和域随机化,应用领域包括全身控制,操纵和从人类演示中学习[368]. JAX线程提供了一个开放的替代品:Brax提供了大规模平行的异形刚性体模拟[369],MujoCo Playground在几分钟内在单张GPU[370]上进行sim-to-real政策. SAPIEN/ManiSkill线标对象多样性,ManiSkill2提供20个任务家庭,2000多个对象和超过4M的演示帧[371,372],而RoboVerse则将多个模拟器包裹在一个接口后[373]. 仍然存在两个差距。 首先,这些平台中没有任何一个基准直接接触直立手的忠诚度,而且手的斜向驱动或受力不足,与 Sheath 摩擦和联合耦合难以建模;为腿部机器人引进的学习型动因子模型[374],以及关节神经动力学[375]部分补偿. 第二,触觉模拟落后于刚体模拟(第8.8节).

blocks.en: 8.2 Reinforcement learning and sim-to-real
blocks.zh: 8.2 强化学习和实事求是

blocks.en: RL in simulation remains the workhorse for in-hand reorientation, hand–arm grasping and force-controlled skills, where demonstrations are hard to provide.
blocks.zh: 模拟中的RL仍然是手动调整方向、手握武器以及武力控制技能的劳动马匹,在那里,示威很难提供。

blocks.en: The lineage starts with OpenAI’s Shadow Hand reorientation and Rubik’s cube work using massive domain randomization [ 6 , 7 ] , continues with DeXtreme’s GPU-parallel training and robust pose estimation on the Allegro Hand [ 8 ] and Visual Dexterity’s point-cloud teacher–student distillation for downward-facing reorientation of novel shapes [ 9 ] . HORA showed that proprioception alone suffices for z-axis rotation: an adaptive policy trained only on simulated cylinders transfers without fine-tuning and rotates dozens of real objects by inferring object properties from proprioceptive history [ 376 ] . Later work added touch and multiple axes: RotateIt distills a privileged oracle into a visuotactile transformer [ 349 ] ; Robot Synesthesia merges touch and vision in a point-cloud representation [ 350 ] ; AnyRotate performs gravity-invariant multi-axis rotation with dense simulated touch and zero-shot transfer [ 351 ] . Dynamic skills benefit from combining simulation with small real data: pen spinning pretrains on oracle-generated simulated trajectories and fine-tunes on fewer than 50 real trajectories to spin more than ten pen-like objects [ 377 ] . More recent work closes the reality gap systematically with joint-wise neural dynamics learned from autonomously collected real data [ 375 ] , domain randomization in a 3D Gaussian representation for monocular RGB reorientation under hard lighting [ 378 ] , and fingertip-only reorientation on hydraulic hands [ 87 ] .
blocks.zh: 世系起源于OpenAI的影子手调整和Rubik的立方体工作,使用大面积域随机化[6,7],继续DeXtreme的GPU平行训练和对Allegro Hand[8]和Visual Dexterity的点云教师的强势姿势估计——学生蒸馏,用于向下调整小说形状[9]. HORA表明,单是自動就足以进行z轴旋转:一种适应性政策只训练于模拟气瓶的转动而无需微调,并且通过从自動歷史中推断物体属性来旋转数十个真物体[376]. 后来的工作增加了触摸和多轴: 旋转 它将一个特权的甲骨文蒸馏成粘着式变压器[349]; 机器人Synesthesia将触觉和视觉结合到一个点-圆形代表物[350]; AnyRotate执行重力不变量的多轴旋转,同时进行密集的模拟触觉和零射转动[351]. 动态技能得益于模拟与小型真实数据相结合:在甲骨文生成的模拟轨迹上用笔旋转前纹,在不到50个真轨迹上用微调旋转超过10个笔状物体[377]. 更近期的工作以从自主收集的真实数据中吸取的共通神经动力学系统地弥合了现实差距[375],在硬照明下单聚RGB重定向的3D高斯代表中域随机化[378],在液压手上仅指尖重定向[87].

blocks.en: DexPBT uses decentralized population-based training for one- and two-arm hand systems [ 379 ] ; DextrAH-G distills a teacher acting through geometric fabrics, a structured and safe action space, into a depth-based student for fast grasping and transport with a 23-motor arm–hand system [ 380 ] , and DextrAH-RGB achieves competitive transfer from RGB alone [ 381 ] . Bimanual sim-to-real RL now twists lids off unseen bottles [ 382 ] and performs humanoid bimanual tasks with automatic real-to-sim tuning, generalizable reward design and divide-and-conquer distillation [ 383 ] ; curricula with decaying virtual object controllers handle bimanual articulated objects [ 224 , 384 ] . Tool use combines simulation with real refinement: articulated tools such as scissors, pliers and staplers are handled by a simulation-trained base policy refined on hardware [ 385 ] or by coarse-to-fine motion synthesis [ 386 ] , and contact-rich tasks such as nut fastening and screwdriving use simplified-object RL in simulation as a prior for teleoperated tactile demonstrations [ 387 ] . Fast tactile simulation with current-to-torque calibration achieved the first zero-shot sim-to-real controllable grip-force tracking [ 336 ] ; skill chaining extends horizons [ 388 ] .
blocks.zh: DexPBT对一臂和二臂手系统采用分散的人口培训[379];DextraH-G将一位教师通过几何结构的织物,一个结构化和安全的行动空间,演练成一个深层学生,用23机动臂手系统快速抓取和运输[380],DextraH-RGB实现单RGB的竞争性转移[381]. Bimanual sim-to-Real RL现在扭开看不见的瓶子的盖子[382],执行人造双人任务,自动进行真实到sim的调制,通用的奖励设计以及分割和征服蒸馏[383];课程中带有衰变的虚拟对象控制器处理双人化的拼接对象[224,384]. 工具使用将模拟与真正的精细化结合起来:剪刀,钳子和定点针等明晰工具通过精炼于硬件[385]的模拟训练基础政策或粗到细运动合成[386]处理,在模拟中通过坚果紧固和螺丝化使用简化对象RL等接触丰富的任务作为远程操作触控演示的前置任务[387]. 快速触觉模拟与对流对调校准实现了首个零射的Sim-to-Realable hand-force跟踪[336];技能链路延长了视野[388].

blocks.en: Teacher–student distillation with privileged information is nearly universal for hands [ 376 , 349 , 380 , 377 , 389 ] . LLMs now write reward functions: Eureka’s evolutionary reward search outperforms expert-written rewards on 83% of 29 environments, with an average normalized improvement of 52%, and enables simulated Shadow Hand pen spinning [ 390 ] ; DrEureka additionally designs domain-randomization distributions and matches human-designed configurations for dexterous manipulation [ 391 ] . Active exploration collects informative real data for system identification [ 392 ] . RL also produces data and controllers for other layers: sampling in simulation for retargeting [ 49 ] , amplification of a few exoskeleton demonstrations [ 393 ] , and low-level controllers for teleoperation [ 164 ] .
blocks.zh: 教师-学生的蒸馏法带有特权信息,对于手几乎是普遍的[376,349,380,377,389]. LLMs 现在写奖励功能: Eureka的进化奖励搜索在29个环境的83%上超过了专家撰写的奖励,平均常态化改进了52%,并能够模拟Shadow Hand笔旋转[390]; Dreureka额外设计了域域随机分布,与人为设计的配置相匹配,用于 dexterous的操纵[391]. 积极探索收集信息性真实数据进行系统识别[392]. RL还生成其他层的数据和控制器:在模拟中进行采样,以重新瞄准[49],放大一些exoskeleton演示[393],以及远程操作的低级控制器[164].

blocks.en: 8.3 Grasp synthesis and grasp policies
blocks.zh: 8.3 集中综合和掌握政策

blocks.en: Grasping is the most mature dexterous skill, and its data scale has grown from millions to hundreds of millions of synthetic grasps ( Table 13 ). Three paradigms coexist. Optimization-based synthesis directly searches for physically valid grasps: DexGraspNet generated about 1.32M grasps with differentiable force closure [ 394 ] ; differentiable grasp-wrench-boundary estimation aligns the grasp wrench space with a task wrench space and is 50 × \times faster than DexGraspNet at comparable quality [ 395 ] ; BODex uses bilevel optimization with realistic contact models to synthesize more than 49 grasps per second on one GPU, with above 75% simulated success and below 1 mm penetration on three hands and 81% on a real Shadow Hand [ 396 ] ; and SpringGrasp plans compliant grasps under shape uncertainty [ 397 ] . Learned generative samplers amortize this search: early samplers generated grasps from RGB-D in about a second [ 398 , 399 ] ; DexDiffuser combines a diffusion sampler with an evaluator, gaining 9.1% in simulation and 19.4% in the real world over a prior generative baseline [ 400 ] ; DexGrasp Anything injects physics constraints into diffusion training and sampling and releases more than 3.4M poses on 15k objects [ 401 ] ; Get a Grip trains vision-based evaluators on 3.5M grasps over 4.3k objects and shows that performance degrades as the dataset shrinks [ 402 ] ; and DexGraspNet 2.0 learns a two-stage diffusion model from 427M grasps in 8,270 cluttered scenes, reaching 90.7% real success in clutter with zero-shot transfer [ 403 ] . RL policies distilled from specialists close the loop: UniDexGrasp++ reaches 85.4% and 78.2% success on train and test objects [ 404 , 405 ] ; UniGraspTransformer distills thousands of per-object policies into a transformer and improves on completely unseen objects by 10.1% over UniDexGrasp++ [ 389 ] ; and RobustDexGrasp reports 97.0% success over 247,786 simulated objects and 94.6% over 512 real objects with disturbance-resistant dynamic grasping [ 406 ] .
blocks.zh: 格拉斯平是最成熟的曲折技能,其数据规模已经从数百万次增加到数亿次的合成抓取(表13). 三种范式并存. 基于优化的合成直接搜索物理上有效的抓取: DexGraspNet 生成了约1.32M的抓取器,具有不同的强性关闭[394]; 不同的抓取-扳手的边界估计使抓取的扳手空间与任务扳手空间相匹配,并且以可比的质量比 DexGraspNet 更快 [395]; BO Dex使用有现实接触模型的双层优化,在一个GPU上合成超过49个每秒的抓取,在三只手上模拟成功率超过75%,在1毫米以下的穿透率,在真影手上则低于81%[396];SpringGrasp计划在形状不确定性下符合抓取[397]. 学习的基因采样者分期进行这一搜索:早期的采样者在大约1秒[398,399]中从RGB-D生成了抓获;DexDiffuser将扩散采样者与评价者合并,在模拟中获得9.1%,在以前基因基线中获得19.4%;DexGrasp 任何在扩散培训和取样中注入物理约束,并在15千个物体上释放超过3.4M的姿势[401]; 让一个基于3.5M的Grip列车的视觉评价员在4.3k物体上抓住并显示,随着数据集收缩[402],性能会退化; DexGraspNet 2.0从8,270杂乱场景中的427M抓取中学习到一个两阶段的传播模型,在零射转录[403]中达到90.7%的实际成功. 从专家中提取的 RL 政策 关闭循环: UniDexGrasp++在列车和测试对象上取得了85.4%和78.2%的成功 [404, 405]; UniGraspTransformer将数千个每个对象的政策蒸馏成一个变压器,并且比 UniDexGrasp++ [389] 改进了完全看不见的对象;和 RobustDexGrasp 报告 97.0%成功超过247 786个模拟物体,94.6%成功超过512个具有防扰动态抓取能力的真物体[406]。

blocks.en: Grasping is also becoming task- and taxonomy-aware . Dexonomy synthesizes 31 GRASP-taxonomy grasp types [ 112 ] from one annotated template per hand and type, producing 9.5M grasps over 10.7k objects and 82.3% real success for a type-conditional model [ 407 ] ; AffordDexGrasp performs open-set language-guided grasping with affordance and grasp flow matching [ 408 ] ; and hand-agnostic synthesis through contact maps [ 318 ] and test-time adaptation of human grasps [ 409 ] connect grasping to cross-embodiment transfer ( Section 6 ). Because simulators, friction and penetration settings differ, success rates across these papers are not comparable; a shared real-world grasping protocol with standard object sets remains missing.
blocks.zh: 格拉斯平也开始意识到任务和分类。 Dexonomy从每手和每类型一个附加说明的模板中合成了31种GRASP-taxonomy抓取类型[112],产生了超过10.7k对象的9.5M抓取和82.3%的型态条件模型实际成功[407];AffordDexGrasp以承受力和抓取流量匹配[408]进行开放式语言引导抓取;通过接触图进行手动不可知性合成[318],以及人类抓取的试验时间调整[409]将抓取与交叉嵌入转移联系起来(第6节)。 由于模拟器,摩擦和穿透设置不同,这些论文的成功率无法比较;一个带有标准对象集的共享现实世界把握协议仍然缺失.

blocks.en: 8.4 Imitation learning
blocks.zh: 8.4 模仿学习

blocks.en: Behavior cloning with expressive action models made demonstration-based dexterous learning practical: action chunking transformers [ 410 ] , diffusion policies in image [ 411 ] and point-cloud space [ 412 ] , and hierarchical VLM-plus-diffusion systems such as DexGraspVLA, which grasps in thousands of unseen cluttered scenes at above 90% success [ 413 ] . Typical budgets are a few hundred demonstrations per task [ 17 , 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 具有表现性行动模式的行为克隆使基于示范的离散性学习实用:动作块变压器[410],图像[411]和点云空间的传播政策[412],以及分级的VLM-+扩散系统,如DexGraspVLA,它以90%以上的成功率在上千个看不见的杂乱场景中抓住[413]. 典型的预算是每项任务的几百个示范[17,15].

blocks.en: Several architectural refinements matter specifically for high-DoF hands. 3D representations help with occlusion and viewpoint change: the improved 3D diffusion policy iDP3 controls a 25-DoF humanoid upper body from egocentric LiDAR point clouds, was evaluated in more than 2,000 real rollouts, and generalizes from single-scene training data to new settings with onboard compute only [ 414 ] . Symmetry improves data efficiency: an SO(2)-equivariant diffusion policy improves average success by 21.9% over Diffusion Policy on 12 MimicGen tasks [ 415 ] , but we found no equivariant policy designed for multi-fingered kinematics. Fast inference becomes critical as action dimension and control rate grow: Consistency Policy distills a diffusion policy into a few-step model that is about an order of magnitude faster [ 416 ] , and the FAST tokenizer compresses high-frequency action chunks so that autoregressive VLAs train up to 5 × \times faster than the π 0 \pi_{0} setup [ 417 ] . Fine-tuning recipes also matter: OpenVLA-OFT combines parallel decoding, action chunking and continuous actions to raise LIBERO success from 76.5% to 97.1% with 26 × \times higher throughput [ 418 ] . A different route uses tracking controllers : DexTrack learns a neural controller that tracks human hand–object references, improving success by more than 10% over baselines in simulation and on a real hand [ 419 ] . Imitation alone, however, inherits the demonstrations’ ceiling, which motivates the post-training methods below.
blocks.zh: 一些建筑改良对于高手来说是特别重要的。 3D表达有助于隐蔽和观点变化:改进后的3D传播政策iDP3从以自我为中心的LiDAR点云控制了25-DoF人上体,在2000多个真实的展开中得到了评价,并且从单场训练数据概括到只有机载计算的新设置[414]. 对称性提高了数据效率:SO(2)-等效的传播政策在12个MimicGen任务[415]的传播政策上提高了21.9%的平均成功率,但我们发现没有为多指运动学设计的等效政策. 随着动作层面和控制率的增长,快速推论变得至关重要: 一致性政策将扩散政策提炼成一个几步模型,这个模型大约是一个数量级的更快[416],FAST的标注器压缩高频动作块,使自递性VLA的训练速度达到5×××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××× 微调配方也很重要: OpenVLA-OFT结合了并行的解码,动作块和连续动作,将LIBERO的成功率从76.5%提高到97.1%,同时有26×次更高的吞吐量[418]. 不同的路线使用跟踪控制器 : DexTrack学习了一个跟踪人类手的神经控制器 — — 对象参考,在模拟和真实的手上,成功率比基线提高了10%以上 [419] 。 然而,仅模仿本身就继承了示威的上限,这促使下面的培训后方法。

blocks.en: 8.5 Vision-language-action foundation models
blocks.zh: 8.5 愿景语言-行动基础模式

blocks.en: Generalist VLAs pair a pretrained VLM with an action decoder and are trained on multi-embodiment data [ 420 , 421 , 422 , 423 , 424 ] . Flow-matching action experts [ 26 ] and co-training with web and multi-source data [ 27 ] improved open-world generalization; π 0.7 \pi_{0.7} conditions on subtasks, metadata, control modality and visual subgoals to absorb heterogeneous and even failed data, and transfers laundry folding zero-shot to a new robot platform [ 28 ] . GR00T N1 [ 29 ] and N1.7 [ 300 ] add a “data pyramid” of web video, synthetic and real data and, in N1.7, 20k hours of human egocentric video (EgoScale), with Apache-2.0 code [ 314 ] ; Gemini Robotics [ 30 , 317 ] and Gemini Robotics 2 [ 425 ] extend to whole-body and multi-finger control. Dexterity-specific systems include ByteDance’s GR-3 [ 426 ] and GR-Dexter, which couples a 21-DoF hand, hundreds of hours of egocentric video and cross-embodiment data [ 427 ] , as well as X Square Robot’s WALL-OSS [ 428 ] and Being-H0/H0.5 [ 301 , 21 ] . Architecturally, most VLAs used with hands follow the “VLM plus diffusion action head” pattern popularized by CogACT, which decouples a 7B cognition module from a diffusion action transformer and outperforms OpenVLA by more than 35% in simulation and 55% in real experiments [ 429 ] . DexVLA scales a plug-in diffusion expert to 1B parameters and trains it in three stages (cross-embodiment expert pretraining, embodiment alignment, task post-training); it is one of the few VLAs evaluated explicitly on a dexterous hand [ 430 ] . Latent-action pretraining from video offers a cheaper route: UniVLA learns task-centric latent actions in DINO feature space and outperforms OpenVLA with less than 1/20 of the pretraining compute and 1/10 of the downstream data [ 319 ] ; Humanoid-VLA uses human motion data and unlabeled video for whole-body control [ 431 ] . A caveat comes from benchmarks: DexVerse finds that web-scale pretraining gives no generalization advantage for high-DoF hand control [ 56 ] ( Section 9 ). Most public VLA results are on grippers, and dexterous evidence is still thin.
blocks.zh: 一般的VLAs将预训的VLM配以动作解码器,并接受多化数据培训[420,421,422,423,424]. GR00T N1 [29]和N1.7 [300] 添加一个网络视频、合成和真实数据的“数据金字塔”,并在N1.7中添加一个20k小时的以人为中心的视频(Egoscription),其中Apache-2.0代码[314];双子机器人[30,317]和双子机器人2[425]扩展至全身和多指控制。 Dexterity的特异性系统包括ByteDance的GR-3 [426]和GR-Dexter,它们与21-DOF手配对,数百小时的自我中心视频和交叉化数据[427],以及X Square Robot的WALL-OSS [428]和Being-H0/5 [301,21]. 在结构上,大多数手动使用的VLA遵循了CogACT普及的"VLM+扩散动作头"模式,它从扩散动作变压器中拆解了一个7B认知模块,在模拟中比OpenVLA高出35%以上,在实际实验中超过55%[429]. DexVLA将插件传播专家比例提高到1B参数,并分三个阶段对其进行培训(交叉化专家预训,化身配对,任务后训练);它是少数明确通过脱节手评价的VLA之一[430]. 提供更便宜的路线: UniVLA在DINO中学习以任务为中心的潜在动作特征空间,并且优于OpenVLA,预训计算值低于1/20,下游数据为1/10[319];Humanoid-VLA使用人类运动数据和无标签视频进行全身控制[431]. DexVerse发现,网络规模的预训没有给高 doF手控提供一般化的优势[56](第9节). 大多数公开的VLA结果都是针对抓手的,而狡猾的证据仍然很薄.

blocks.en: 8.6 Fast–slow hierarchies with a contact layer
blocks.zh: 8.6 具有接触层的快速-低级结构

blocks.en: Figure 8: Reference architecture separating semantic intent, chunked motion and local contact response, motivated by the hierarchies in Table 14 [ 33 , 34 , 96 , 219 ] . The constraint filter is a proposed deployment component, not a verified feature of all cited systems. The fast feedback path uses touch and proprioception; visual/state feedback supports replanning. S0 can include whole-body tracking and is not synonymous with a tactile controller.
blocks.zh: 图8 参考架构 将语义意图,块状运动和局部接触反应分开,动机为表14[33,34,96,219]中的分级. 制约过滤器是一个拟议部署部分,而不是所有引用系统的可核实特征。 快速反馈路径使用触摸和自主;视觉/状态反馈支持重新规划. S0可以包括全身跟踪,不是触觉控制器的同义词.

blocks.en: Figure 8 separates an architectural hypothesis from the results of named systems. Its practical question is whether contact feedback should enter the main policy, a fast local controller, or both. A fair ablation must hold sensing, compute and delay fixed; nominal controller frequency alone does not measure end-to-end reaction latency.
blocks.zh: 图8将一个建筑假设与命名系统的结果区分开来. 其实际问题是联系反馈应输入主要政策,快速本地控制器,还是两者兼而有之. 公平衰减必须使感知,计算和延迟固定;名义控制频率单是不能测量端对端反应延迟.

blocks.en: A single network running at one frequency struggles to both “decide what to do” and “modulate force at the moment of contact”. A clear 2026 trend is a hierarchy in which semantic planning is slow, trajectory generation runs at an intermediate rate and contact reaction is fast ( Table 14 ). Figure’s Helix 02 uses a semantic S2, an S1 transformer outputting whole-body joint targets including every finger at 200 Hz, and a 10M-parameter learned S0 whole-body controller at 1 kHz trained on more than 1,000 hours of retargeted human motion plus simulated RL [ 33 ] . Sharpa’s CraftNet splits a Motion Brain (S1) from an Interaction Brain (S0) that governs contact with objects [ 34 ] . AGILINK’s DUET separates a manipulation layer from a contact layer driven by real-time touch on 16–20-DoF hands [ 96 ] ; AgiBot’s GO-2 uses an action chain-of-thought and asynchronous dual systems [ 432 ] . Hierarchy also appears in the time domain in T-Rex, whose mixture-of-transformers combines a low-rate action expert with a high-rate tactile expert and improves 12 contact-rich tasks by more than 30% [ 219 ] . These industrial designs have academic precursors without touch: HiRT runs a slow VLM and conditions a fast visuomotor policy on its latents, doubling control frequency on static tasks at comparable success and raising success on novel dynamic tasks from 48% to 75% [ 433 ] ; RoboDual pairs a generalist VLA with a 20M-parameter specialist trained on 5% of the demonstrations, gaining 26.7% in the real world and running 3.8 × \times faster [ 434 ] ; Hi Robot adds a language-reasoning high level that incorporates user feedback [ 435 ] ; and Hume lets System 2 sample candidate actions and pick one with a learned value head while System 1 reacts quickly [ 436 ] . RoboDual’s numbers quantify the case for small, fast, specialized layers that the contact layer in dexterous systems takes further. The appeal for hand makers is clear: contact control depends on hardware dynamics and sensor timing, making its interface to general foundation models an important co-design question.
blocks.zh: 一个以一个频率运行的单一网络在“决定该做什么”和“接触时调节力量”两方面都挣扎着。 2026年的明显趋势是语义规划缓慢,轨迹生成以中间速率运行,接触反应迅速(表14. Figure的Helix 02使用一个语义S2,一个S1变压器输出全体联合目标,包括每个手指在200赫兹,以及一个10M参数在1千赫兹学习的S0全体控制器,训练了超过1000小时的重定向人类运动和模拟RL[33]. Sharpa的手工业网络将一个运动脑(S1)从一个控制与物体接触的相互作用脑(S0)中分割出来[34]。 AGILINK的DUET将操纵层与由16–20-DoF手的实时触动驱动的接触层分开[96];AgiBot的GO-2使用一个动作链思维和同步双系统[432]. T-Rex中的时间域中也出现了分级,其混合变速器将低速动作专家与高速触觉专家相结合,并将12项接触丰富的任务改进30%以上[219]. 这些工业设计具有学术前体,没有触摸: HIRT运行一个缓慢的VLM,并附加条件,对其潜伏状态采取快速的Vuomotor政策,将静态任务的控制频率翻一番,取得类似成功,并将新动态任务的成功率从48%提高到75%[433];RoboDual配对一个通用的VLA,一个20M参数专家接受5%的演示培训,在现实世界中获得了26.7%,运行速度更快的3.8×\时[434]; Hi Robot增加了一个包含用户反馈[435]的语言推理高水平;和Hume让System 2对候选动作进行抽样,并选择一个有学习价值头的动作,而System 1反应迅速[436]. RoboDual的数可以量化小的,快速的,专门化的层层,这些层层的接触层在离心系统中会进一步增加. 对手工制造者的吸引力是明确的:接触控制依赖于硬件动力学和传感器时间,使其与一般基础模型的接口成为重要的共设计问题.

blocks.en: 8.7 World-action models
blocks.zh: 8.7 世界行动模式

blocks.en: World models entered the policy backbone in 2026. We distinguish (i) models that jointly predict future observations and actions and act directly, (ii) models that predict in a latent space only, and (iii) world models used as evaluators or RL environments . In group (i), DreamZero is a 14B autoregressive video-diffusion world-action model running closed-loop at 7 Hz [ 31 ] ; Liber-0 uses a mixture-of-transformers [ 437 ] with language, vision and action experts, an embodiment-as-context representation and a first pretraining stage of pure video prediction [ 35 ] ; PAD jointly denoises future images and actions [ 438 ] ; LDA-1B models dynamics in a DINO latent space [ 307 ] ; and industrial programs report similar designs [ 237 , 439 , 440 , 441 ] . 1X generates future video with a text-conditioned diffusion model and extracts actions with inverse dynamics [ 442 ] . This group has a longer academic lineage: UniPi framed policies as text-conditioned video generation followed by inverse dynamics [ 443 ] ; the Unified Video Action model learns a joint video–action latent with separate lightweight heads so that actions can be decoded without generating video [ 444 ] ; WorldVLA unifies image and action generation in one autoregressive model [ 445 ] ; and large video generators can be adapted into policies with little demonstration data [ 446 ] . Instead of acting through generated pixels, Video Prediction Policy feeds predictive representations of a fine-tuned video diffusion model to the policy and reports 31.6% higher success on complex real-world dexterous tasks [ 447 ] . World models are also used to synthesize data : DreamGen fine-tunes a video world model, generates new videos, recovers pseudo-actions with a latent action model or inverse dynamics, and enables a humanoid to perform 22 new behaviors from teleoperation data of a single pick-and-place task [ 448 ] , on top of open world-foundation-model platforms [ 449 ] . In group (ii), Being-H0.7 inserts learnable latent queries between perception and action, aligned during training with a posterior branch that sees the future and discarded at inference, keeping latency in the few-millisecond-per-step range [ 32 ] ; DexWM plans with MPC in a latent world model pretrained on human video [ 308 ] , and V-JEPA 2 pretrains an action-free joint-embedding predictor on more than 1M hours of video and post-trains an action-conditioned variant on less than 62 hours of robot video for zero-shot planning on arms [ 450 ] . In group (iii), Genie Envisioner [ 451 ] and 1X’s world model [ 442 ] are used to rank policy versions and run imagined RL. The open questions are inference cost, how to evaluate physical consistency, and whether pixel-level prediction is necessary for contact-rich hand control.
blocks.zh: 世界模式于2026年进入政策支柱. 我们区分:(一) 共同预测未来观测和行动并直接行动的模型,(二) 只在潜在空间预测的模型,(三) 用作评价员或参考水平环境的世界模型。 DreamZero在组(一)中是一个14B自旋式视频扩散世界行动模型,运行在7Hz [31];Liber-0使用混合变频器[437],配有语言,视觉和行动专家,化装成像代表以及纯视频预测的第一个预训阶段[35];PAD联合曝光未来图像和行动[438];DINO潜伏空间的LDA-1B模型动态[307];以及工业方案报告类似的设计[237,439,440,441]. 1X生成未来视频,配以文字为条件的传播模式,并提取带有反向动态的动作[442]. 这个团体具有较长的学术血统: UniPi将政策设定为文本条件的视频生成,然后是反向动态[443];United Video Action模式学习了带有单独轻量级头像的联合视频-动作潜伏,这样动作就可以解码而不产生视频[444]; World VLA将图像和动作生成统一在一个自动递归模型中[445];大型视频生成器可以被改造成政策,几乎没有演示数据[446]. 视频预测政策没有通过生成的像素采取行动,而是将微调后的视频传播模型的预测表述提供给政策,并报告在复杂的现实世界破碎任务上取得了31.6%的成功[447]。 世界模型也用于综合数据: DreamGen微调视频世界模式,生成新视频,以潜在动作模式或反向动态恢复伪动作,并使人偶能够从单挑位置任务的远程操作数据中实现22个新行为[448],在开放的世界奠基-模式平台之上[449]. 在第(二)组中,Being-H0.7插入了感知与行动之间的可学习的潜在询问,在培训期间与后视未来的分支对接,并在推论中丢弃,将静态保持在几毫秒的步程范围[32];DexWM计划与MPC在潜伏的世界模型中预先在人机视频中训练[308],V-JEPA 2预留了1M多小时视频上的无动作联合嵌入预测器,并在后视距机器人视频不到62小时进行武器零镜头规划[450]。 在第(三)组中,Genie Envisioner [451]和1X’s的世界模型[442]被用于对政策版本进行排序,运行想象中的RL. 开放式的问题有推论成本,如何评价物理一致性,以及像素水平的预测对于接触丰富的手控是否必要.

blocks.en: 8.8 Touch inside the model: VTLA
blocks.zh: 8.8 型号内触:VTLA

blocks.en: Vision–tactile–language–action (VTLA) models treat touch as a first-class input. CraftNet optimizes its training data by mapping tactile signals onto human video and glove data [ 34 ] ; Figure 03 feeds palm cameras and fingertip force into S1 [ 99 , 33 ] ; TouchScale shows that visuo-tactile mid-training on human glove data improves real contact tasks [ 47 ] ; and tactile kinesthetic teaching provides contact-aware supervision [ 226 ] . Tactile simulation fidelity and sensor heterogeneity are the main barriers; Section 7 reviews tactile VLAs and the supporting sensors, simulators and representations in detail.
blocks.zh: 视觉 -tactile - 语言 - 动作(VTLA)模型将触摸作为一流输入. CraftNet通过将触觉信号映射到人类视频和手套数据来优化其培训数据[34]; 图03 向S1[99,33]输入手掌相机和指尖力; 触摸 规模显示,人手套数据可操作性中级培训可改进真正的接触任务[47];触觉性亲子美学教学可提供接触感知监督[226]。 Tactile模拟忠诚度和传感器异质度是主要障碍; 第7节详细审查了触觉VLA以及辅助传感器,模拟器和表达.

blocks.en: 8.9 RL post-training, self-improvement and prompting
blocks.zh: 8.9 RL 培训后、自我改进和激励

blocks.en: After imitation, policies improve through RL and failure recycling. Three recipes are converging. (i) Online policy-gradient RL on the VLA itself , enabled by vectorized simulation and new infrastructure: VLA-RL [ 452 ] , SimpleVLA-RL, which reports emergent behaviors absent from the demonstrations [ 453 ] , RLinf-VLA, with 98.1% on 130 LIBERO tasks [ 454 ] , and π RL \pi_{\text{RL}} , which makes flow-matching VLAs trainable with RL [ 455 ] . (ii) Diffusion-specific RL : policy-gradient fine-tuning of diffusion policies [ 456 ] and steering a frozen policy by RL in its latent-noise space [ 457 ] . (iii) Residual refinement on a frozen base : ResiP adds a closed-loop residual RL policy to a chunked imitation policy for precise assembly [ 458 ] , and Policy Decorator refines large imitation policies online, including on the Adroit dexterous-hand tasks [ 459 ] . In the real world, human-in-the-loop RL trains vision-based policies in 1–2.5 hours [ 460 ] , and ConRFT reaches 96.3% average success on eight real tasks after 45–90 minutes of online fine-tuning of a VLA with a consistency head [ 461 ] ; interactive imitation interfaces let a human take over and hand back control during bimanual tasks [ 191 ] . Almost all of this evidence is on grippers; scaling real-world RL to 20+-DoF hands, with their wear and safety constraints, is open. ByteDance’s GR-RL targets precise long-horizon dexterous manipulation [ 462 ] ; π 0.7 \pi_{0.7} turns failed autonomous episodes into useful training data through metadata conditioning [ 28 ] ; and DITTO-X uses reverse teleoperation for human interventions [ 148 ] . Generalist’s GEN-1.5 shows in-context “physical prompting”: placing a 3–12 s demonstration in a 30 s context lets the model perform a new task without gradient updates, with 59% average success over ten tasks from one demonstration and 83% after ten gradient steps on five minutes of data [ 23 ] . Its hardware is pincer-style rather than multi-fingered.
blocks.zh: 模仿后,政策通过RL和故障回收改进. 三种食谱渐趋一致. (i) 关于VLA本身的在线政策升级RL,由矢量化模拟和新的基础设施提供:VLA-RL [452],SimpleVLA-RL,报告示威中未出现的行为[453],RLinf-VLA,在130个LIBERO任务上占98.1%[454],以及 πRL\pi_{\text{RL}},使流匹配的VLA可以与RL[455]进行训练. (二)针对扩散的RL:对扩散政策进行政策级微调[456],并指导RL在潜在噪声空间中实施冻结政策[457]。 (三)对冻结基座的剩余完善: ResiP在精确装配[458]的块状仿真政策中增加了封闭式剩余RL政策,政策装饰者在线完善了大型仿真政策,包括Adroit dexterous-hand任务[459]. 在现实世界中,Human-in-toop RL在1–2.5小时[460]内执行基于视觉的政策,ConRFT在使用一致性头号的VLA进行45–90分钟的在线微调后,在8项实际任务上平均取得了96.3%的成功;交互式仿真接口让一个人在双人任务期间接手并交回控制权[191]. 几乎所有的这些证据都是关于抓手的;将真实世界的RL缩放到20+-DoF手,并带有磨损和安全限制,是开放的. ByteDance的GR-RL目标精确的长视距操纵 [462]; ^ 0.7\pi_{0.7] 通过元数据调制将失败的自主事件转化为有用的培训数据; DITTO-X 使用逆向远程操作进行人类干预 [148] 。 GEN-1.5 显示“物理提示 ” : 在30 个背景中设置一个 3-12 个演示,让模型在没有梯度更新的情况下执行新的任务,一个演示在10个任务中的平均成功率为59%,在5分钟数据上10个梯度步骤后的平均成功率为83% [23] 。 其硬件为披针式而非多指式.

blocks.en: 8.10 Whole-body and mobile dexterity
blocks.zh: 8.10 联合国 全身和移动脱节

blocks.en: Dexterous hands are increasingly mounted on humanoids and mobile bases, so hand policies must coexist with whole-body control. The prevailing structure is a general whole-body tracking controller trained with RL in simulation, below which hands are often treated as simple end effectors, and above which teleoperation or learned policies issue targets. H2O performs real-time whole-body teleoperation from an RGB camera with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and filters infeasible retargeted human motion in simulation [ 463 ] ; HOVER unifies multiple command modes (e.g., root velocity and upper-body joint angles) in one controller [ 464 ] ; ExBody2 uses teacher–student training on filtered motion capture and documents a trade-off between tracking generality and fine-tuned motions [ 465 ] ; TWIST trains a single RL-plus-BC controller from motion capture for whole-body teleoperation [ 466 ] ; AMO expands the manipulation workspace of a 29-DoF humanoid with adaptive motion optimization [ 467 ] ; and ResMimic adds a residual policy for object loco-manipulation on top of a tracker pretrained on human motion, using object-tracking and contact rewards and a virtual-object curriculum similar to DexMachina [ 468 , 224 ] . Simulation data generation with LLM-reasoned task plans produces bimanual dexterous humanoid demonstrations on which 2D and 3D diffusion policies scale [ 469 ] . For mobile bimanual manipulation, Mobile ALOHA showed that 50 demonstrations per task plus co-training with static data raise success by up to 90% [ 470 ] ; equivalent results with multi-fingered hands are still scarce, and the interface between whole-body controllers and high-frequency finger contact control is largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: Dexterous手越来越多地挂在人造物和移动基座上,因此手政策必须与全身控制并存. 普遍的结构是一般的全体跟踪控制器,在模拟中受过RL的训练,在模拟下,手常常被作为简单的终端效应器处理,在远程操作或学习到的政策上会发出目标. H2O使用RGB相机进行实时全体电动操作,在模拟[463]中进行零射光成真转移和滤波器不可行的重定向人类运动;HOVER将一个控制器的多个指令模式统一起来(如根速度和上体联合角度);ExBody2使用教师-学生关于滤波运动捕捉的培训,并记录跟踪一般运动和微调运动之间的权衡结果[465];TWIST从运动捕获中培训一个单一的RL-plus-BC控制器,用于全身电动[466];AMO将29-DoF人造物的操纵工作空间扩大,并进行适应性运动优化[467];以及Resmic增加了对在人类运动上预先训练的跟踪器顶部上进行物体定位操纵的残余政策,利用物体跟踪和接触奖励以及类似于DexMachina [468, 224]的虚拟弹道课程。 使用LLM合理任务计划模拟数据生成产生双人性脱氧核糖核酸演示,在2D和3D扩散政策上进行[469]. 对于移动双人操纵,Mobile ALOHA显示,每任务50个演示加上带有静态数据的协同训练,成功率高达90%[470];多指手的等效结果仍然很少,全身控制器和高频手指接触控制之间的接口基本上没有得到探索.

blocks.en: Takeaway. For high-DoF contact-rich tasks, recent results motivate adding touch and testing fast local feedback. Neither the necessity of touch for every task nor the universal superiority of a separate contact layer has been established. Human data provide scale if hardware is matched or the conversion is reliable; RL and failure recycling push beyond the demonstration ceiling; world models are increasingly used to evaluate and accelerate training, while their role inside the real-time control loop is still debated.
blocks.zh: 外卖 对于高水平的DoF接触丰富的任务,最近的结果激励增加触摸,测试快速的本地反馈. 既没有确定每一项任务都需要接触,也没有确定单独接触层的普遍优越性。 如果硬件匹配或转换可靠,人类数据提供尺度;RL和故障回收推力超过演示天花板;世界模型越来越多地用于评价和加速培训,而它们在实时控制循环中的作用仍然在争论之中.

blocks.en: 9 Layer 5: Evaluation and Applications
blocks.zh: 9 第5层:评价和应用

blocks.en: 9.1 A skill taxonomy
blocks.zh: 9.1 国家 技能分类

blocks.en: We group dexterous behaviors into eight atomic skills, ordered roughly by maturity: grasping (stable and functional grasps of arbitrary objects; deployed in logistics and machine tending [ 394 , 405 , 413 ] ); in-hand reorientation (lab-mature through RL [ 6 , 8 , 9 , 375 , 378 ] but with little direct industrial demand); tool use (hammers, tweezers, syringes, power tools [ 386 , 55 , 340 , 57 ] ); bimanual coordination [ 472 , 269 , 268 , 272 , 473 ] ; articulated objects such as lids, doors and scissors [ 474 , 224 ] ; deformable and fragile objects such as cables, cloth, eggs and pills, which need touch and fast reaction [ 219 , 57 ] ; insertion and precision assembly with sub-millimeter tolerance [ 219 , 56 ] ; and force-controlled dosing such as powder weighing, pipetting and writing [ 475 , 476 , 336 ] . A grasp taxonomy [ 112 ] and the Kapandji opposition test remain the standard descriptors of hand capability.
blocks.zh: 我们把狡猾的行为分成八种原子技能,大致按成熟程度排序:抓住(对任意物体的稳定和功能把握;部署在物流和机器调节[394、405、413]]);手动方向调整(通过RL[6、8、9、375、378],但工业需求很少);工具使用(手提箱、wee子、注射器、动力工具[386、55、340、57]);双人协调[472、269、268、272、473];盖盖、门和剪刀[474、224];电缆、布、鸡蛋和药丸等可变形和脆弱的物体,需要触摸和快速反应[219、57];插入和精密计耐力的组装[219、56];以及强制控制的火药重、自控和写[475、476、336]。 把握分类[112]和卡潘吉反对测试仍然是手力的标准描述符.

blocks.en: 9.2 Benchmarks and datasets
blocks.zh: 9.2 基准和数据集

blocks.en: Table 16 lists benchmarks and human–object datasets. Before 2025, benchmarks focused on grasping, reorientation and bimanual RL in simulation [ 472 , 394 , 477 , 474 , 372 ] , while human–object datasets provided motion priors [ 269 , 268 , 272 ] . TeleOpBench compared four teleoperation modalities in mirrored simulation and real settings [ 54 ] . Between May and October 2026 at least nine new dexterous benchmarks appeared. Four patterns stand out.
blocks.zh: 表16列出了基准和人类对象数据集。 在2025年之前,基准侧重于在模拟 [472, 394, 477, 474, 372] 中把握、调整方向和双手RL, 而人-对象数据集提供了运动前传 [269, 268, 272]. Telep Bench在镜像模拟和真实设置中比较了四种远程操作模式[54]. 在2026年5月至10月期间,至少出现了9个新的灵活基准。 四种图案突出.

blocks.en: DexJoCo focuses on tasks that only a dexterous hand can do, such as tool use, reasoning, bimanual coordination and long horizons, with 1.1k demonstration trajectories [ 55 ] ; DexVerse defines 100 tasks decoupled from embodiment [ 56 ] ; Bench2Dex offers 26 bimanual tasks on 12 hands with a unified simulated tactile interface [ 340 ] ; BiDex-100 and HandsOn (18k demonstrations across 5 arms and 6 hands) scale task counts further [ 473 , 57 ] .
blocks.zh: DexJoCo专注于只有一手能完成的任务,如工具使用,推理,双人协调和长视野,有1.1k演示轨迹[55];DexVerse定义了100项任务与浮雕脱钩[56];Beach2Dex提供了26项双人任务,12只手有统一的模拟触觉界面[340];BiDex-100和HandsOn(18k演示横跨5个手臂和6只手)规模任务进一步计数[473,57].

blocks.en: DexVerse evaluates DP, DP3, OpenVLA and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and finds no generalization advantage from web pretraining for high-DoF hands, with near-universal failure on fine contact tasks [ 56 ] . On HandsOn, a general-purpose frontier model without fine-tuning reaches 5.2% on demonstration-learning tasks and 1.9% on transfer tasks [ 57 ] .
blocks.zh: DexVerse评价DP,DP3,OpenVLA 和 ^ 0.5\pi_{0.5},没有从网络预训中发现对高手的概括化优势,在精细接触任务上几乎普遍失败[56]. On HandsOn,一个没有微调的通用前沿模式在示范学习任务上达到5.2%,在转移任务上达到1.9%[57].

blocks.en: TactiDex moves evaluation from “moving like a human” to “making contact like a human” [ 228 ] ; Bench2Dex and T-Rex make touch a first-class signal [ 340 , 219 ] .
blocks.zh: TactiDex将评价从“像人类一样移动”转移到“像人类一样进行接触”[228];Bench2Dex和T-Rex使一等信号[340,219]。

blocks.en: Labimus encodes an organic-chemistry weighing procedure with particle-based powders and instrument read-outs and finds that task completion and experimental validity diverge [ 475 ] ; LabDex structures real and simulated demonstrations into atomic, composite and long-horizon chemistry tasks [ 476 ] ; DexBioLab adds flames, vapor and bubbles [ 478 ] . Laboratories have standardized procedures, human-designed tools and quantifiable precision, which make them attractive test beds.
blocks.zh: Labimus用颗粒粉末和仪器读出编码一个有机化学衡量程序,发现任务完成和实验有效性存在差异[475]; LabDex结构真实和模拟地演示原子、复合体和长视化学任务[476]; DexBioLab添加火焰、蒸汽和气泡[478]。 实验室有标准化的程序、人设计的工具和可量化的精确度,使它们具有吸引力。

blocks.en: The dexterous-hand event of the 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing comprised eight five-minute tasks (picking beans with tweezers, opening bottles, weighing 20 g ± \pm 0.5 g of powder, building blocks, nailing, connecting cables, assembling with a power tool, unboxing), with autonomous runs weighted twice as heavily as teleoperated ones; autonomous solutions proved much harder to qualify [ 479 ] . Such scoring rules are beginning to act as de facto acceptance criteria.
blocks.zh: 北京2026年世界人文机器人运动会的巧妙活动包括8个5分钟的任务(挑豆用wee子,开瓶,重20g±\pm0.5g的粉末,构件,钉钉,连接电缆,用电动工具组装,拆箱),自主运行的加权量是电动运行的两倍;自主解决方案证明更难合格[479]. 这种评分规则开始成为事实上的接受标准。

blocks.en: 9.3 Evaluation methodology
blocks.zh: 9.3 评价方法

blocks.en: Dexterous papers typically report 10–20 real trials per condition without confidence intervals, and use heterogeneous metrics. Methodology developed for generalist gripper policies can be adopted. Statistical rigor: STEP is a sequential test with near-optimal stopping that needs up to 32% fewer trials than prior procedures while avoiding p-hacking [ 480 ] ; anytime-valid sequential comparisons with partial-credit and continuous metrics reduce evaluation burden by up to 70% relative to batch methods and show that progress metrics separate policies faster than binary success [ 481 ] , which supports progress scores for long-horizon dexterous tasks if they are reported alongside success. Protocol design: blinded, randomized evaluation in simulation and the real world quantified the benefits of large behavior-model pretraining with statistical confidence [ 482 ] ; RoboArena distributes double-blind pairwise comparisons across seven institutions and more than 600 real episodes [ 483 ] ; and RoboEval adds coordination, safety/stability and stage-wise failure metrics that separate policies with similar success rates [ 484 ] . Scalable proxies: SIMPLER showed that simulation aligned in control and appearance correlates strongly with real performance for gripper policies [ 485 ] ; video-derived digital twins with VLM scoring extend this idea [ 486 ] ; and AutoEval automates queueing, success detection and resets around the clock [ 487 ] . None of these has yet been validated for in-hand manipulation, where dropped objects require re-staging and contact-rich behavior is hard to simulate faithfully; a dexterous analog of SIMPLER and of automatic reset is an open need ( Section 11 ).
blocks.zh: Dexter的论文通常报告每个条件10-20个真实试验,没有信任间隔,并使用不同的衡量标准。 可以采用为一般政策制定的方法。 统计严谨度:STEP是一种近乎最佳的停止试验,需要比先前程序减少32%的试验,同时避免打入[480];随时与部分信用和连续的衡量标准进行有效的连续比较,使评价负担相对于批量方法减少多达70%,并表明进展衡量标准将政策分开,速度快于二进制成功[481],如果报告成功,则支持长距离三角任务的进展分数。 协议设计:在模拟和现实世界中盲目,随机评价 以统计自信量化大型行为模型预训的好处 [482]; RoboArena在7个机构和600多个真实事件中分配双盲对比 [483]; RoboEval增加了协调,安全性/稳定性和阶段性失败度量度,将成功率类似的政策分开 [484]. 可缩放代理:SIMPLER显示,在控制和外观上一致的模拟与抓取政策的实际性能密切相关[485];视频衍生的带VLM评分的数字双胞胎扩展了这一想法[486];AutoEval自动排队,成功检测和24小时重播[487]. 尚未对其中任何一项进行人工操作验证,因为投放的物体需要重新固定,而且富接触的行为很难忠实地模拟;SIMPLER和自动重置的模拟是公开的需要(第11节)。

blocks.en: 9.4 A minimum evaluation record
blocks.zh: 9.4 国家 最低评价记录

blocks.en: The following record is a proposed protocol for future comparisons, not a claim that existing benchmarks already provide all fields. Report each task–hand pair separately before computing an aggregate. Split unseen objects, tasks, environments and embodiments into distinct tests; “zero-shot” must state whether target-hand calibration, demonstrations, simulator tuning or interventions were allowed. For binary success, report successful trials and the denominator with an interval and its method. For heterogeneous tasks or repeated trials on the same object, account for clustering rather than treating every attempt as independent. Progress scores require their scoring rule and should remain separate from binary completion.
blocks.zh: 以下记录是未来比较的拟议协议,而不是声称现有基准已经提供了所有领域。 在计算集合前分别报告每个任务 - 手对 。 将看不见的物体、任务、环境和表现分为不同的测试;“零射”必须说明是否允许目标手校准、演示、模拟调制或干预。 为了二进制的成功,报告成功的试验和分母的间隔及其方法。 对于同一目标上的不同任务或重复试验,要说明是分组,而不是将每一项尝试视为独立。 进步分数需要他们的积分规则,应该与二进制完成分开.

blocks.zh: 表17: 低度评价拟议最低记录。

blocks.en: For deployment, choose acceptance thresholds before testing and tie them to the task’s consequences and workload. A short trial with no observed incidents does not establish a zero incident rate. Likewise, a controller running at 1 kHz can still react slowly if perception and communication dominate the delay. These distinctions prevent nominal rates and attractive headline percentages from substituting for physical reliability.
blocks.zh: 对于部署,在测试前选择接受阈值,并将其与任务的后果和工作量挂钩。 没有观察到任何事件的短暂审判不能确定事件率为零。 同样,如果感知和通信主导延迟,运行于1千赫的控制器仍然可以缓慢反应. 这些区别使名义费率和有吸引力的标题百分比无法取代物理可靠性。

blocks.en: 9.5 Safety
blocks.zh: 9.5 安全问题

blocks.en: Collaborative-robot safety standards were written for arms. Biomechanical studies behind them show that most ISO/TS 15066 limits are preliminary because they rest on unverified literature data, with pain thresholds measured across 28 body locations in 112 participants [ 488 ] ; impact thresholds also drop markedly for sharp contact (e.g., about 168 N for a wedge versus 272 N for a cylinder at the deltoid, 75th percentile) [ 489 ] , which matters for fingertips and tools held by hands. We found no standard that addresses pinch and crush hazards specific to multi-fingered hands. On the learning side, constrained RL for VLAs reduced cumulative safety-violation cost by 83.6% while slightly improving success in mobile manipulation [ 490 ] , and dynamic human-to-robot handover with dexterous hands now has a real-world benchmark [ 491 ] . Practical deployments therefore pair learned policies with deterministic safety layers (speed and force limits, keep-out zones), as in the kitchen design of Section 10.5 .
blocks.zh: 为武器制定了协作机器人安全标准。 其背后的生物力学研究表明,大多数ISO/TS 15066限值都是初步的,因为它们依赖于未经验证的文献数据,在112名参与者的28个身体位置上测得疼痛阈值[488];对于尖锐的接触,撞击阈值也明显下降(例如,在三角形上,一个楔子约168 N,一个圆柱约272 N,75 百分位)[489],这对指尖和手持的工具都很重要. 我们没有找到任何标准 解决多指手脚特有的危险 在学习方面,VLA的受限RL将累计安全违规成本降低83.6%,同时移动操纵的成功度略有提高[490],动态的人工对机器人交接手手力现在具有现实世界基准[491]. 因此,如第10.5节的厨房设计一样,实际部署将学到的政策与确定性安全层(速度和部队限制、戒备区)结合起来。

blocks.en: 9.6 Applications and deployment maturity
blocks.zh: 9.6 应用程序和部署期限

blocks.en: Table 18 gives our assessment of maturity by domain, based on the evidence above. Industrial deployments first appear in semi-structured fine work : electronics and automotive part assembly, micro-motor assembly with cycle times of about 9–10 s, and parcel and pharmaceutical sorting in logistics centers [ 91 ] ; humanoids with dexterous hands entered automotive plants for logistics [ 99 ] ; and foundation-model companies demonstrate part kitting, phone boxing and box folding [ 23 , 151 ] . Home tasks such as loading a dishwasher are mostly demonstrations [ 33 ] . The best-documented long-duration home studies still use grippers: Dobb-E collected 13 hours in 22 homes and reached 81% success over 109 tasks in 10 homes during about 30 days [ 492 ] ; robot utility models with verifier-triggered retries achieved about 90% zero-shot success in unseen environments [ 493 ] ; and RL from experience with interventions more than doubled throughput and roughly halved failures on hard real-world tasks such as laundry folding and espresso making [ 494 ] . Mobile bimanual dexterous systems that convert human hand motion with RL are emerging [ 495 ] , but without comparable long-duration statistics. In medicine, imitation learning on surgical robots achieved fully autonomous steps of gallbladder removal on eight unseen ex vivo specimens [ 496 , 497 ] , and a teleoperated humanoid with a commercial six-DoF hand performed laparoscopic cholecystectomy on live pigs as a feasibility study [ 498 ] . We found no peer-reviewed economic or return-on-investment study of dexterous manipulation; deployment economics are documented only in vendor and analyst material. Industry reports suggest that most customers are still at the proof-of-concept stage [ 91 ] .
blocks.zh: 表18按领域列出了我们根据上述证据对成熟程度的评估。 工业部署首先出现在半结构精细的工程中:电子和汽车零件组装、循环时间约为9-10秒的微型机动车组装以及物流中心的包裹和药物分拣[91];手伸手的人体进入汽车工厂进行物流[99];基金会模型公司展示部分打包、电话拳击和盒式折叠[23,151]。 家庭任务,如装上洗碗机,大多是示威[33]. 记录最好的长期家庭研究仍然使用抓刀: Dobb-E在22个家庭收集了13个小时,在10个家庭的109项任务中,在大约30天的时间里取得了81%的成功[492];具有验证器-触发式复刻机的机器人公用事业模型在不见踪影的环境中取得了约90%的零射成功[493];从干预经验中得出的RL吞吐量增加了一倍以上,在洗衣折叠和咖啡制作等硬现实世界任务上的失败率大致减半[494]. 以RL转换人类手动的移动双动分解系统正在出现[495],但没有可比较的长期统计. 在医学上,外科机器人的仿真学习在8个隐形前体标本上实现了完全自主的胆囊切除步骤[496,497],一个带有商用六DoF手的远程操作人造人机在活猪身上进行了膝盖切除术,作为可行性研究[498]. 我们发现没有经过同行审议的经济或投资回报研究,而只能用供应商和分析材料记录部署经济学。 行业报告显示,大多数客户仍处于概念证明阶段[91].

blocks.en: Field requirements are demanding. Operators in food service, for instance, typically expect more than 95% task reliability before committing to long-term use, whereas a reported bimanual food-assembly system reached 75% full-task success after 26 hours of training [ 499 ] . For a commercial-kitchen assistant, we propose illustrative acceptance targets of task success above 95%, at most about one human takeover per operating hour at peak, availability near 98%, cycle times within 1.2–1.5 × \times those of a skilled worker, mean time between failures in the hundreds of hours, food-safe washable hand covers, and robustness to steam, grease and wet surfaces. Two architectural lessons follow: dexterous hands should be reserved for steps that truly need them (pairing a tactile 20+-DoF hand with a quick-change tool hand reduces failure points), and quantities that vision estimates poorly, such as dosing liquids or powders, should be closed with additional sensors (e.g., a scale) in the contact layer rather than left to the visuomotor policy.
blocks.zh: 外地需求很高。 例如,食品服务运营商在承诺长期使用之前通常期望95%以上的任务可靠性,而报告的双人食品组装系统在26小时培训后实现了75%的全任务成功[499]。 对于一名商业厨房助理,我们提出95%以上的任务成功的示范性接受目标,最多在高峰时段,每人每一次接管,可用率接近98%,周期时间在1.2 - 1.5 × 以内,熟练工人在数百小时内失败之间的平均时间,可以安全食品的手盖,以及蒸汽、油脂和湿表面的坚固度。 接下来是两个建筑学教训:应当为真正需要的步子(用快速变换工具手支撑触觉20+-DoF手减少故障点)预留精巧的手,视差估计的数量,如吸液体或粉末,应当用接触层中的额外传感器(如比例尺)关闭,而不是留待维乌莫托尔政策.
