blocks.zh: 表18:按技能和领域分列的成熟度(我们的评估):研究活动、基准覆盖面、工业部署(3高、2中、1低)。

blocks.en: 10 Full-Stack Case Studies
blocks.zh: 10 全面案例研究

blocks.en: The preceding sections analyzed each layer separately. In this section we examine five systems that span several layers, to show how design decisions propagate through the stack and where the evidence is strong or weak.
blocks.zh: 前几节分别分析了每一层。 在本节中,我们研究了跨越几层的五个系统,以显示设计决定是如何通过堆栈传播的,以及证据强弱之处。

blocks.en: 10.1 Human video to an open humanoid stack: EgoScale and GR00T
blocks.zh: 10.1 人类视频到一个开放的人体堆栈: 电子规模和GR00T

blocks.en: EgoScale [ 20 ] is the clearest public example of a data-first stack. Data: 20,854 hours of egocentric human video with estimated 21-keypoint hand poses (including EgoDex [ 19 ] ), plus an aligned set of about 50 hours of human data recorded with gloves, wrist trackers and wrist cameras arranged as on the robot, and about 4 hours of robot data. Representation: keypoints are retargeted per frame into the joint space of a 22-DoF Sharpa Wave hand [ 42 ] ; joint-space actions outperform wrist-only or fingertip-only pretraining targets. Model: a GR00T-style VLM with a diffusion-transformer action expert and embodiment-specific adapters [ 29 ] . Training: human pretraining, then human–robot aligned mid-training, then task post-training. Evidence: validation loss falls log-linearly with human hours; task completion rises from 0.30 at 1k hours to 0.71 at 20k hours; average success improves by 54% over no pretraining; and transfer to a three-finger Unitree hand still yields large gains. The corpus was subsequently folded into GR00T N1.7 [ 300 ] , whose code is released under Apache-2.0 and which uses relative end-effector actions [ 314 ] , and a reference humanoid pairs a Unitree H2-series body with two Sharpa Wave hands [ 500 ] . What this case shows: human data can drive dexterous learning at scale, in a demonstrated setting with a small, carefully aligned bridge dataset and a hand whose kinematics are close to human. Open questions: how far the log-linear trend extends, how much of the gain depends on the human-like 22-DoF target, and whether the recipe works equally well for strongly non-anthropomorphic hands.
blocks.zh: Ego Scale [20] 是数据第一堆最明显的公开实例 。 数据:20,854小时的以自我为中心的人类视频,估计有21个键点的手姿(包括EgoDex [19]),外加一套用手套,手腕跟踪器和手腕相机排列在机器人上的对齐的人类数据,以及大约4小时的机器人数据. 说明:将每个框的键点重新定位到一个22-DoF的联合空间 夏玛 波手[42];联合空间动作优于只手腕或只指尖前训练目标. 型号:一种GR00T风格的VLM,配有扩散传导动作专家及特异化适配器[29]. 培训:人力预训,然后人力机器人调整中训,然后任务后训练。 证据:验证损失随人时数而下降;任务完成时间从1k小时的0.30升至20k小时的0.71;平均成功率比无预训提高54%;转入三指Unitree手仍然产生很大收益. 物状后来折叠成GR00T N1.7 [300],其代码在Apache-2.0下发布,使用相对的末端效应动作[314],一个参考人形对一个Unitree H2系列体,两只夏帕波手[500]. 这个案例所显示的是: 人类数据可以推动在规模上, 在一个显示的环境下,用一个小的, 仔细的对齐的桥梁数据集, 以及一个手的动能接近人类。 开放式问题:对数线性趋势延伸了多少,收益多少取决于类似人类的22-DoF目标,食谱对强烈的非人类形态手是否同样有效.

blocks.en: 10.2 Glove, human-like robot and world-action model: Liber-0
blocks.zh: 10.2 (韩语). 手套,类似人类的机器人和世界行动模型: 解放者 0

blocks.en: Liber-0 [ 35 ] combines three components that each address one component of the human-to-robot gap. For the supervision gap , a 131 g, 0.3 mm skin-colored glove records measured hand pose together with one egocentric and two wrist cameras, without a robot present. For the visual gap , the robot (LEO) has a slim forearm, a three-DoF human-like wrist, an adjustable waist, and chest and wrist cameras mounted where the glove’s cameras are; the hand is a commercial WUJI2 hand. For the embodiment gap , the model conditions action prediction on a shared encoding of human and robot geometry and kinematics. The model is a world-action model built on a mixture-of-transformers [ 437 ] with language, vision and action experts; it is pretrained in three stages (video-only prediction, joint world–action pretraining, then manipulation-focused pretraining that upweights glove and teleoperation data) on more than 2.2M hours of human experience, and co-trained on VQA, segmentation, image editing and video understanding.
blocks.zh: Liber-0 [35] 结合了三个组件,每个组件处理人对机器人间隙的一个组件. 对于监督漏洞,一个131克,0.3毫米皮肤颜色的手套记录 测量的手与一个自我中心 和两个手腕相机 一起,没有机器人在场。 对于视觉差距来说,机器人(LEO)有一个微弱的前臂,一个三指手腕,一个可调节的腰部,以及安装在手套摄像头所在的胸部和手腕相机;手是一个商业的WUJI2手. 模型为人类和机器人几何学和动能学的共享编码提供了动作预测条件。 该模型是一个世界行动模型,以具有语言、愿景和行动专家的转换器[437]为基础;它分三个阶段进行预先培训(仅进行视频预测、联合世界-行动前培训、然后进行以操纵为重点的提高手套和远程操作数据质量的预先培训),在超过2.2M小时的人类经验中进行联合培训,并进行VQA、分区、图像编辑和视频理解方面的培训。

blocks.en: The value of this report lies in its controlled comparisons. Under identical post-training, 2M hours of web video reach 64.6/51.2 progress on pick-and-place/non-pick-and-place tasks, both below the scores obtained with only 10k hours of glove data; glove plus 25% of the robot demonstrations reaches 75.6 versus 72.8 for all robot demonstrations; glove data alone (60.3) beats a quarter of the robot data (50.0); skills that exist only in glove data rise from 2.2 to 47.5 progress (54.6 with all glove data), approaching full teleoperation (56.3); more diverse collectors help at fixed volume (12.7 → \to 40.1 glove-only); and the human-like robot beats a conventional arm by 28.3 points with the same glove data. Zero-shot success over 60 tasks (600 trials) is 36.0% overall, but only 10.5% on multi-step tasks.
blocks.zh: 本报告的价值在于其有控制的比较。 在相同的培训后,2M小时的网络视频达到64.6/51.2,在选址/非选址任务上取得进展,均低于只获得10k小时手套数据的得分;手套加25%的机器人演示达到75.6比72.8;仅手套数据(60.3)就击败四分之一的机器人数据(50.0);只存在于手套数据的技能从2.2升至47.5进步(54.6与所有手套数据并列),接近全程操作(56.3);更多样化的采集器在固定体积(12.7 ~\=40.1只手套)中帮助;类似人的机器人用同样的手套数据击败一个常规臂28.3分。 60项任务(600项试验)的零射成功率总体为36.0%,但多步骤任务只达到10.5%.

blocks.en: Several caveats limit what can be concluded. The report is a blog post without code, weights, parameter count, control frequency or latency; most internal metrics are progress scores, which are more lenient than binary success; per-task trial counts are small (3–10); the zero-shot baseline is a reasoning agent rather than a VLA; manipulation-focused pretraining may overlap with the evaluation task families, which would inflate the claim that post-training adds little (81.4/72.3 before versus 83.6/73.8 after); and the glove carries no touch, which the authors identify as the next step. Genesis AI pursues a similar full-stack route, pairing its own hand with a 1:1 sensorized glove [ 197 ] ; together with Liber-0’s use of a third-party hand, this suggests an emerging division of labor between model companies and hand makers.
blocks.zh: 几个警告限制了可以得出的结论。 该报告是一个没有代码、权重、参数计数、控制频率或延迟的博客文章;大多数内部衡量标准是进步分数,比二进制成功更宽大;每个任务审判计数都小(3-10);零射线基线是推理代理而不是甚高射线;以操控为重点的预训可能与评价任务家族重叠,这会激化关于培训后增加不多的说法(前81.4/72.3比后83.6/73.8);手套没有触摸,作者认为下一步就是这一举动。 Genesis AI追求类似的全链路,将自己的手与1:1感应手套配对[197];再加上Liber-0使用第三方手,这表明模范公司和手工业者之间正在出现分工.

blocks.en: 10.3 Hardware-matched gloves at scale: Sunday and Generalist
blocks.zh: 10.3 与硬件相称的手套:星期日和通用

blocks.en: Two US companies pursue the most aggressive form of robot-free capture. Sunday’s Skill Capture Glove shares the geometry and sensor layout of its robot hand, and a Skill Transform pipeline removes human-specific features; the company reports that glove data are converted into robot data with a 90% success rate and that the resulting ACT-1 model performs long-horizon chores such as clearing a table into a dishwasher without any robot training data [ 150 ] , while press reports state that the glove sells for about US$200 and was sent to more than 2,000 contributors [ 25 ] . Generalist distributes wearable pincer-style “data hands” isomorphic to its own end effectors with press reports of more than 270k hours at the time of GEN-0 and more than 500k hours for GEN-1 [ 24 ] ; GEN-1 is pretrained primarily on human-demonstration data and reportedly needs about one hour of robot data per task [ 151 ] , and GEN-1.5 introduces in-context learning from 3–12 s demonstrations [ 23 ] . Both cases show that isomorphism plus volume can substitute for teleoperation, but neither uses a 20+-DoF multi-fingered hand at scale, and neither has released data or models for independent evaluation.
blocks.zh: 两家美国公司追求最具有攻击性的无机器人捕捉形式. Skill Captal Glove分享其机器人手的几何学和传感器布局,一个Skill Transform管道消除了人类特有的特征;该公司报告说,手套数据被转换为机器人数据,成功率达到90%,由此产生的ACT-1模型进行长距离的杂务,如将一张桌子清理成一个没有机器人训练数据的洗碗机[150],而新闻报道则称手套售价约200美元,并被送往超过2000名贡献者[25]. GEN-1在GEN-0时超过270k小时, GEN-1则超过500k小时; GEN-1主要通过人演示数据进行预训,据说每个任务需要大约一小时的机器人数据[151], GEN-1.5从3–12的演示中引入了内文字学习[23]. 这两个案例都表明,异态主义加体积可以替代远程操作,但两者都不使用规模的20+-DoF多指手势,也没有为独立评价发布数据或模型.

blocks.en: 10.4 A vertically integrated tactile stack: Sharpa
blocks.zh: 10.4 对 垂直集成的触觉堆栈 : 夏玛

blocks.en: Sharpa illustrates the hand-maker route into algorithms. The Wave hand has 22 active DoF at human scale with a dynamic tactile array and torque sensing per finger [ 42 ] ; the AE01 glove (22 DoF) provides haptic feedback for training-data collection and remote operation [ 101 ] ; CraftNet is a hierarchical vision–tactile–language–action model whose Interaction Brain (S0) governs contact with objects while a Motion Brain (S1) directs movement, and which optimizes its training data by mapping tactile signals onto human video and glove data [ 34 ] ; Dex-X learns visuo-tactile manipulation from human video with simulated interaction and transfers zero-shot to a 29-DoF hand–arm platform [ 310 ] . The company also became the hand supplier of the GR00T reference humanoid ( Section 10.1 ). The lesson is that contact control depends on hardware and sensor timing, so hand makers can contribute a distinct co-design point while still using general-purpose foundation models for scale.
blocks.zh: 夏帕将手工制作的路由说明为算法. 波手有22个人类规模的主动DoF,每个手指有动态触觉阵列和扭矩感知[42];AE01手套(22 DOF)为培训和远程操作提供随机反馈[101];CraftNet是一个等级视觉-tactile-语言-动作模型,其交互脑(S0)在运动脑(S1)引导运动时控制与物体的接触,它通过将触觉信号映射到人类视频和手套数据来优化其训练数据[34];Dex- X通过模拟互动从人类视频中学习粘着-tactile操控,并将零射入29-DoF手-arm平台[310]. 该公司还成为GR00T参考人造物(第10.1节)的手工供应商. 教训是,接触控制依赖于硬件和传感器的时间安排,因此手工业者可以贡献一个独特的共设计点,同时仍然使用通用基础模型来进行规模化.

blocks.en: 10.5 Designing a deployment: a commercial-kitchen assistant
blocks.zh: 10.5 (中文(简体) ). 设计部署:一名商业厨房助理

blocks.en: We close with a deployment design exercise for a wheeled dual-arm robot with dexterous hands in a chain-restaurant kitchen, to illustrate how the requirements of a real setting constrain every layer. Automated stir-fry machines are already deployed at scale in some Chinese restaurant chains [ 501 ] , and research on kitchen robots has so far focused on recipe-level planning and dishware perception with grippers [ 502 , 503 ] ; the open opportunity is the connecting work between machines and people. Table 19 rates kitchen steps by how much they need a dexterous hand and how hard they are.
blocks.zh: 我们结束对一个双臂轮式机器人的部署设计工作,该机器人在连锁-备用厨房中手持柔软的手,以说明真正设定的要求如何限制每一层。 自动搅拌机已经在部分中国餐馆连锁店中大规模部署[501],对厨房机器人的研究至今一直关注食谱层面的规划和用抓手的菜具感知[502,503];开放的机会是机器与人之间的连接工作. 表19按厨房台阶需要多少柔软的手和困难程度计算。

blocks.en: Table 19: Commercial-kitchen steps: need for a dexterous hand, difficulty and suggested phase (P1 = first deployment). Illustrative analysis.
blocks.zh: 表19:商业 -- -- 厨房步骤:需要防腐的手、困难和建议阶段(P1=首次部署)。 释义分析.

blocks.en: A compact base (footprint around 0.6 × \times 0.7 m) with a lift, two 7-DoF arms with at least 5 kg payload, a 20+-DoF tactile, backdrivable main hand and a low-DoF gripper with quick-change tools (spoon, tongs, scraper) as the second hand. Using the dexterous hand only where it is necessary reduces wear and failure points ( Section 3.7 ); food-safe, washable silicone covers protect the hand and separate raw from cooked food. Palm cameras compensate for steam and occlusion; a workstation scale closes dosing loops.
blocks.zh: 一个紧凑的基座(脚印在0.6×\times 0.7 m左右),有升降机,两只7-DoF臂,至少有5公斤有效载荷,一个20+-DoF触控器,可反向驾驶的主手和一个带有速变工具的低DoF抓刀(spoon,tongs,scraper)作为第二手. 只有在需要降低磨损和故障点时,才使用柔软的手(第3.7节);食物安全、可洗的硅酮盖保护手,并将原料与熟食分开。 棕榈相机可以补偿蒸汽和闭塞;一个工作站尺度可以关闭做成循环.

blocks.en: A task agent connected to the point-of-sale and kitchen display systems turns orders into steps; an S2 VLM tracks sub-task progress and counts portions; an S1 VLA produces whole-body action chunks; an S0 contact layer at 0.5–1 kHz handles grip force, slip and weight-based stopping; and a rule-based safety layer, independent of learning, enforces hot zones, speed limits near people and force limits. World models are used for version ranking and imagined RL, not in the real-time loop ( Sections 8.6 and 8.7 ).
blocks.zh: 一个与售点和厨房显示系统相连的任务代理将订单变为步骤;一个S2 VLM轨迹子任务进度和计数部分;一个S1 VLA产生全身动作块;一个0.5–1 kHz的S0接触层手握力,滑动和重力停止;以及一个规则安全层,独立于学习,执行热区,速度限制接近人和力限. 世界模式用于版本排名和想象中的RL,而不是实时循环(第8.6和8.7节).

blocks.en: Cooks wear egocentric glasses and a tactile glove isomorphic to the main hand during normal service; teleoperation is reserved for failure-prone steps; a digital twin of each kitchen supports RL and evaluation; and autonomous episodes, failures and takeovers flow back for targeted retraining. Following the collector-diversity evidence [ 35 ] , collection should span many cooks and sites rather than many hours from a few people.
blocks.zh: 厨师在正常服役期间戴着以自我为中心的眼镜和与主手的触觉手套异形;远程操作为容易故障的步骤保留;每个厨房有一个数字双胞胎支持RL和评价;自主事件、故障和接管回流,用于定向再培训。 根据收集者的多样性证据[35],收集工作应跨越许多厨师和场地,而不是从少数人那里跨越数小时。

blocks.en: Operators typically demand more than 95% task success before committing [ 499 ] . The following thresholds are proposed design targets, not a published standard or a validated deployment result. A staged rollout (test kitchen → \to one store off-peak → \to peak hours → \to multiple stores) with gates on success ( ≥ \geq 95% then ≥ \geq 98%), takeovers ( ≤ \leq 2 then ≤ \leq 1 per hour), availability ( ≥ \geq 98%), cycle time ( ≤ \leq 1.5 × \times then ≤ \leq 1.2 × \times a skilled worker), dosing error and zero food-safety incidents makes “deployment-ready” measurable. Subscription pricing, as used for kitchen packing robots [ 504 ] , lowers the upfront cost for restaurants. The exercise shows how deployment pushes the stack towards hybrid hand configurations, explicit contact layers, sensor-closed dosing and evaluation by takeovers and availability rather than success rate alone.
blocks.zh: 运营商通常在承诺[499]之前要求完成95%以上的任务。 以下阈值是拟议设计目标,而不是公布的标准或经核实的部署结果。 分阶段推出(测试厨房 —— 离峰的一家商店 —— 高峰时段 —— —— 多家商店),大门成功( —— 95% 然后是—— 98%), 接管( \ leq 2 然后是 \ Leq 1 每小时), 可用性( \ geq 98%), 周期时间( \ \ + 1.5 \ 时间 然后是 \ \ \ Leq 1.2 \ ), 做错事和零 食品安全事件 使“ 部署准备” 可衡量。 用于厨房包装机器人的订阅定价[504],降低了餐厅的预付费用. 演习显示,部署如何将堆栈推向混合手式配置、明确的接触层、传感器闭路剂量和通过接管和可用性评估,而不仅仅是成功率。

blocks.en: 11 Open Problems and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 11 未决问题和未来方向

blocks.en: We close the review with eleven open problems, each tied to the layers it spans.
blocks.zh: 我们以11个公开问题结束审查,每个问题都与其所跨越的层次联系在一起。

blocks.en: Dividing a reported 300k-cycle rating by an illustrative 8k–10k grasps/day gives about 30–38 operating days, but this is a duty-cycle calculation, not a measured replacement interval; test loads and failure definitions may differ [ 92 ] . The community needs load-specified, standardized endurance tests, field failure statistics, and designs for quick replacement of fingers, tendons and tactile skins [ 41 , 70 ] . Research directions include accelerated-life testing protocols with realistic grasp loads, wear-aware control that redistributes load across fingers, prognostics building on motor-current and tendon-tension sensing of contact and stiffness [ 80 , 82 ] , and designs that are robust to collisions by construction, as pursued long ago with antagonistic elastic drives [ 60 ] .
blocks.zh: 以说明性的8k-10k抓取/天的分解报告300k周期的评分大约为30-38个操作日,但这是一个值班周期的计算,而不是一个测量的替换间隔;测试负荷和故障定义可能不同[92]. 社区需要负载规格的标准化耐力测试、实地故障统计,以及快速更换手指、手柄和触觉皮肤的设计[41、70]。 研究方向包括:具有现实把握载荷的加速寿命测试协议,在手指之间重新分配载荷的磨损感控制,在运动电流和趋势延展感基础上对接触和强度进行预测[80,82],以及对建筑碰撞具有强力的设计,这些设计是很久以前用对立弹性驱动力所追求的[60].

blocks.en: Total and active DoF, fingertip force, and cycle life are reported inconsistently. A minimal hardware datasheet (active DoF, coupling map, continuous and peak fingertip force, backdrivability, tactile resolution, endurance test conditions) would make results comparable across hands. Grasp-taxonomy coverage has saturated as a metric [ 110 , 72 ] , so the community should agree on discriminative capability tests, for example combinations of Kapandji opposition, fingertip-force profiles, in-hand reorientation benchmarks and tool-use tasks.
blocks.zh: 报告的总和活跃度、指尖力和周期寿命不一致。 一种最低限度的硬件数据表(活性DoF,耦合图,连续和高峰指尖力,后驾性,触觉分辨率,耐力测试条件)将使结果在手之间具有可比性. Grassp-taxonomy的覆盖范围已经饱和,作为一种度量[110,72],因此社区应该就歧视能力测试达成一致,例如卡潘吉反对的组合,指尖力简介,手头重定向基准和工具使用任务.

blocks.en: Evidence that robots resembling humans benefit more from human data [ 35 ] , and that deployed-hand collection removes the gap [ 18 ] , suggests designing the hand, its cameras and its collection device together. How much anthropomorphism is needed, and for which tasks, is an open quantitative question [ 128 ] , and the literature disagrees on whether anthropomorphism helps in-hand manipulation at all [ 118 ] . Controlled experiments that vary one design factor at a time (thumb range, palm articulation [ 111 ] , wrist DoF, finger length, camera placement) while holding data and models fixed would resolve much of this debate.
blocks.zh: 有证据表明,类似人类的机器人更多地受益于人类数据[35],部署的手集可以消除差距[18],建议将手,其摄像机和收集设备一起设计. 需要多少人类形态学,对于哪些任务,是一个开放式的量化问题[128],文献对于人类形态学是否有助于手动操纵到底[118]存在分歧. 一次改变一个设计系数的受控实验(Thumb范围、棕榈伸缩[111]、手腕DoF、手指长度、照相机放置),而把数据和模型固定起来,将解决大部分的辩论。

blocks.en: Log-linear scaling has been observed for egocentric data up to about 20k hours [ 20 ] , and collector diversity matters [ 35 ] , but there is no predictive theory of how to allocate a budget between egocentric, wearable, teleoperated and simulated data, or of when reconstruction quality rather than volume becomes the bottleneck. Controlled, open studies across multiple hands are needed, including the marginal value of an hour of each data type, the effect of reconstruction noise, and the interaction between data type and model size. The emergence of human-to-robot transfer only with sufficiently diverse robot pretraining [ 227 , 291 ] suggests that these factors interact strongly.
blocks.zh: 以自我为中心的数据的日志线性缩放已经观测到,最长可达20k小时[20],收集者的多样性很重要[35],但是对于如何在以自我为中心、可穿戴、远程操作和模拟数据之间分配预算,或者何时重建质量而不是体积成为瓶颈,没有预测理论。 需要跨越多个手进行可控的开放研究,包括每个数据类型一个小时的边值,重建噪声的效果,以及数据类型和模型大小之间的相互作用. 人类对机器人的转移的出现仅与足够多样的机器人预训[227,291],表明这些因素相互作用很强.

blocks.en: Tactile sensors differ in principle, resolution and layout far more than joints differ in kinematics. Candidate canonical spaces include the MANO UV surface [ 231 ] and unpaired latent alignment [ 50 , 315 ] , but cross-sensor transfer remains weak [ 47 ] . Shared tactile data formats and paired multi-sensor datasets would accelerate progress, as would sensor-instance generalization of the kind demonstrated for replaceable magnetic skins [ 325 ] and cross-sensor pretraining at policy scale [ 346 , 343 ] . Tactile simulation needs validation protocols comparable to SIMPLER for vision [ 485 ] .
blocks.zh: 触控传感器在原则上、分辨率和布局上的差异远远大于动因学上的关节差异。 候选的犬形空间包括MANO UV表面[231]和未发光的潜在对齐[50,315],但跨传感器转移仍然很弱[47]. 共享的触觉数据格式和配对的多传感器数据集将加快进展,为可替换的磁性皮肤所展示的传感器-传感器一般化[325]和在政策尺度[346,343]的跨传感器预训也将加快进展。 Tactile模拟需要与SIMPLER相当的验证协议,用于视觉[485].

blocks.en: Real zero-shot results above 80% exist for grasping [ 303 ] , while transfer for in-hand manipulation and tool use is far less established, and much of the cross-embodiment evidence for generalist models comes from grippers [ 28 , 317 , 23 ] . Benchmarks that report zero-shot and N N -shot adaptation curves across hands of very different morphology (e.g., a 6-DoF linkage hand, a 16-DoF four-finger hand and a 22-DoF anthropomorphic hand) would clarify where we stand.
blocks.zh: 超过80%的实际零射结果用于抓取[303],而用于手动操纵和工具使用的转移则远未确定,泛论模型的交叉化证据大多来自抓取器[28,317,23]. 报告零射和N射的适应曲线跨越非常不同的形态(例如,6-DoF联系手、16-DoF四指手和22-DoF人类形态手)的基准将澄清我们的立场。

blocks.en: Relative EEF versus joint-space actions [ 300 , 28 ] , explicit slots versus latent actions [ 51 , 306 ] , and pixel-space versus latent world-action models [ 31 , 32 ] are all unresolved. Controlled ablations on dexterous (not only gripper) tasks are scarce. So are studies of action tokenization and inference speed at 20+ action dimensions and high control rates [ 417 , 416 ] , where the cost of each design choice grows with the hand’s DoF.
blocks.zh: 相对的EEF相对于联合-空间行动[300,28],明确位置相对于潜在行动[51,306],像素-空间相对于潜在世界行动模式[31,32]均未解决. 受控制地破坏(不仅仅是抓手)的任务很少。 对20+动作维度和高控制率[417,416]的动作示意和推论速度的研究也一样,其中每个设计选择的成本随着手的DOF而增加.

blocks.en: Hierarchical systems put high-frequency contact control in a dedicated layer [ 33 , 34 , 96 ] , while end-to-end models aim to learn it implicitly. Which split generalizes better, and how to train the interface between layers, are open questions. Academic dual systems without touch [ 433 , 434 ] and tactile slow–fast policies [ 353 , 219 ] provide components, but no public system yet couples a pretrained VLA with a learned tactile contact layer on a 20+-DoF hand and reports ablations of the interface. A related question is whether generated training data introduce “looks right but cannot be done” biases [ 225 , 212 ] .
blocks.zh: 分级系统将高频接触控制放入专用层[33,34,96],而端对端模型则旨在隐含地学习. 哪个分裂概括起来更好, 如何训练层之间的接口, 是开放的问题。 没有触觉的学术双层系统[433,434]和触觉缓慢的快速政策[353,219]提供了组件,但是没有公共系统配对,而是在20+-DoF手上用一个有学识的触觉接触层进行预训的VLA,并报告界面的崩盘. 一个相关的问题是,生成的培训数据是否带有“看似正确但不能做”的偏见[225,212]。

blocks.en: Completion rates hide failures of precision, force and damage, as Labimus shows for chemistry [ 475 ] . Benchmarks should report precision, applied force, object damage and human takeovers alongside success, use real-world counterparts with reported trial counts and confidence intervals, and validate that simulation scores predict real performance [ 54 ] .
blocks.zh: 完成率掩盖了精确度,强度和破坏的失败,正如拉比穆斯对化学的显示[475]. 基准应报告准确性、运用武力、物体损害和人类接管以及成功情况,并使用实际世界对口单位报告审判数和信任间隔,验证模拟分数预测实际业绩[54]。

blocks.en: Safety standards lack hand-specific pinch and crush limits [ 488 , 489 ] ; automatic resets and success detection exist for tabletop grippers [ 487 ] but not for in-hand tasks; and there is no peer-reviewed evidence on the economics of dexterous deployment. All three hinder the transition from demonstrations to products.
blocks.zh: 安全标准缺乏针对手的挤压和压压限制[488,489];对台顶握手器存在自动重置器和成功检测[487],但对于手头的任务则没有;也没有同行评审的关于dexterous部署经济学的证据. 三者都妨碍从示威向产品过渡。

blocks.en: Large-scale egocentric and glove capture in homes and workplaces raises privacy, consent and labor questions [ 247 , 248 ] . Emerging dataset standards [ 234 , 249 ] provide quality criteria, but provenance tracking, consent management and de-identification for manipulation data are still immature.
blocks.zh: 家庭和工作场所的大规模自我中心和手套捕捉引起了隐私、同意和劳工问题[247,248]。 新出现的数据集标准[234、249]提供了质量标准,但来源跟踪、同意管理和对篡改数据的识别仍然不成熟。

blocks.en: 11.1 Cross-layer conclusions and decisive tests
blocks.zh: 11.1 跨部门结论和决定性检验

blocks.en: A survey should distinguish repeated observations from assumptions that still need a controlled test. Table 20 links the principal conclusions to their evidence and limits. The common theme is conditionality: alignment can make human data useful, but its value depends on embodiment; contact feedback can improve difficult tasks, but the best architectural split is unresolved; and a high completion score can coexist with unacceptable force, damage or intervention rates.
blocks.zh: 调查应区分重复观察和仍需进行控制测试的假设。 表20将主要结论与证据和限度联系起来。 共同的主题是条件性:调和可以使人类数据有用,但其价值取决于表现;接触反馈可以改善困难的任务,但最佳的建筑分拆尚未解决;高完成分数可以与不可接受的力,损坏或干预率共存.

blocks.en: Table 20: Cross-layer synthesis: what the evidence supports, what remains unresolved, and which comparison would be decisive. Tests in the final column are proposed experiments.
blocks.zh: 表20 跨层综合:证据所支持的,尚未解决的,以及哪些比较将是决定性的. 最后一栏的试验是提议的试验。

blocks.en: Recommendations by stakeholder
blocks.zh: 利益攸关方的建议

blocks.en: Table 21: Recommendations by stakeholder, derived from the evidence reviewed in this survey.
blocks.zh: 表21:利益攸关方根据本调查审查的证据提出的建议。

blocks.en: Table 21 summarizes recommendations by stakeholder.
blocks.zh: 表21按利益攸关方汇总了建议。

blocks.en: For practitioners building a dexterous stack today, the evidence suggests: (1) store raw sources (MANO keypoints or glove angles, 6D wrist poses, raw video and depth, touch, camera calibration and object meshes and poses) and treat retargeted actions as recomputable derivatives; (2) adopt a function-aligned slot action space with masks, and run an explicit ablation of relative-EEF versus joint-space wrist actions on your own embodiments; (3) make retargeting contact-preserving and filter converted data with physics replay; (4) plan for tens of hours of paired human–robot data and a few hours of target-hand data, and start adaptation experiments at the “30 minutes or ten demonstrations” scale suggested by recent results [ 31 , 306 ] ; (5) include touch in the data specification from day one; and (6) evaluate across at least two hands of different morphology.
blocks.zh: 对于今天建立装饰堆的从业人员来说,证据表明:(1) 储存原始来源(MANO键位或手套角、6D腕姿、原始视频和深度、触觉、相机校准和物体夹层和姿势),并将重定向行动视为可共读衍生物;(2) 采用功能相匹配的插槽动作空间,并用口罩对相对的EEEF动作与您自己模具上的联合空间手腕动作进行明确区分;(3) 用物理重播重新瞄准保持接触和过滤转换的数据;(4) 计划数十小时的配对人机器人数据和几个小时的目标手数据,并按近期结果所建议的 " 30分钟或10个演示 " 规模开始适应实验[31,306];(5) 从第一天开始在数据规格中进行接触;以及(6) 至少在两个不同形态的手之间进行评价。

blocks.en: 12 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 12. 结论

blocks.en: Progress in dexterous robotics is best understood through the interfaces between hardware, data, representations, policies and evaluation. Lower-cost hands and larger human-data corpora expand the design space, but neither price nor recording hours alone predicts usable dexterity. The reviewed within-study comparisons support the value of alignment, contact information and targeted robot adaptation under their respective protocols. They do not establish a universal data mixture, action space or control hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 通过硬件、数据、表述、政策和评价之间的接口,最能了解机械化方面的进展。 成本较低的手和更大的人数据公司扩展了设计空间,但光是价格和录制时数都无法预测可用的dexterity. 经审查的学习内部比较支持了各自协议下的对齐、联系信息和定向机器人适应的价值。 它们没有建立通用的数据混合物、行动空间或控制等级。

blocks.en: Three priorities follow. First, retain raw observations, calibration, action semantics and embodiment metadata so that transfer errors can be diagnosed and corrected. Second, compare shared foundation policies and embodiment-specific contact controllers under matched sensing, compute and latency, including hand types that differ substantially in morphology. Third, evaluate physical correctness and long-duration reliability alongside completion, with trial counts, intervention budgets and explicit failure definitions. The strongest unresolved claims concern zero-shot contact-rich transfer across hands, cross-sensor tactile generalization, and sustained deployment economics. Addressing these gaps with controlled experiments and transparent reporting would turn a rapidly expanding catalog of systems into a cumulative science of dexterity.
blocks.zh: 以下三个优先事项。 一,保留原始观测,校准,动作语义和演化元数据,使传输错误得到诊断和纠正. 第二,在匹配的感知、计算和纬度下,比较共享的基础政策和具体表现式接触控制器,包括形态差异很大的手型。 第三,在完成工作的同时评估物理正确性和长期可靠性,包括审判盘点、干预预算和明确的失败定义。 尚未解决的最强烈的主张涉及零镜头接触量丰富的跨手转移、跨传感器触觉通论和持续的部署经济学。 利用有控制的实验和透明的报告来弥补这些差距,将使迅速扩大的系统目录变成一种累积性的科学。
